schemes.name: The Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella Scheme)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Manufacturing units (mainly micro and small) in Goa; framework for target incentive schemes
schemes.eligibility: Units must submit Udyog Aadhar Memorandum, Permanent Registration Certificate from DITC, or Entrepreneurs Memorandum-II. Target schemes apply to micro and small manufacturing units; medium/large and service units only if specified in a target scheme. Eligible classes (unless target scheme says otherwise): units going into production on/after 1-10-2017; units in production on/after 1-10-2007 that have not availed benefits under old schemes (Schedule B); units in production on/after 1-10-2007 that have not exhausted old-scheme benefits (to extent specified); units that availed old-scheme benefits and carry out substantial expansion (cumulative investment from 1-10-2017 at least 25% of gross investment as on 30-09-2017) during scheme validity. Hinterland eco-tourism projects in lesser developed talukas eligible for Interest Subsidy and Employment Subsidy schemes. Lesser developed talukas: Pernem, Satari, Bicholim, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona, Dharbandoda.
schemes.benefit: Framework; specific incentives under separately notified target schemes. Maximum cumulative financial benefit: 50% (70% in lesser developed talukas) of Cumulative Capital Investment at original value for new units/units not availing old schemes; maximum 10% additional benefit to all women and SC/ST entrepreneurs; for substantial expansion, 50% (70% in lesser developed talukas) of the substantial expansion investment; for units with unexhausted old benefits, as per Schedules C and D.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to the Director, Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce in the prescribed proforma for each target scheme, within the timeline in Schedule A; applications scrutinised by Task Force Committee (chaired by CEO, Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board); payment within 15 days of sanction with affidavit-cum-self-declaration.
schemes.valid_period: From 01-10-2017 for five years unless extended; old-scheme applications accepted only up to 31-12-2017
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 28 dated 12-10-2017, Notification 3/10/2017-IND/268. Schedules A-D appear as blank pages (likely images, not captured). Same gazette includes Atal Asra Yojana extension to OBC/SC (Social Welfare, Not. 61-22-2017-BC-DSW) but text is cut off mid-eligibility (family income up to Rs. 1.50 lakhs p.a.), so no separate row made.

schemes.notes: Items 9-15 only; items 3-8 cut by trimming.

schemes.name: State concessions to Ex-Servicemen and widows (fees, taxes, reservations)
schemes.target: Ex-servicemen, widows and their dependents
schemes.eligibility: Ex-servicemen and widows of ex-servicemen; documents/properties for personal benefit and not for commercial/business/real estate activities (two properties).
schemes.benefit: Exemption from registration fees for documents (two properties); exemption from House Tax; exemption from stamp duty (two properties); 2% reservation in Group 'C' and 'D' posts; 1% seats for children of ex-servicemen in Medical, Dental, Engineering, B.Pharm, B.Arch, Nursing, B.Ed and ITI/Polytechnic; exemption from application/examination fees for State Civil Service recruitment (ex-servicemen and families of those killed/disabled in action); 'Green Card' for next of kin of martyrs for priority treatment in Govt offices; 3% quota for Fair Price Shops; 2% quota for Goa Housing Board plots/flats.
schemes.notes: Non-cash concessions. House tax exemption implies local body (panchayat/municipality) waiver but delivery mechanism not stated.

schemes.name: Welfare schemes provided by Kendriya Sainik Board
schemes.target: Ex-servicemen (mostly up to Havildar/non-pensioners), widows and wards
schemes.eligibility: Penury: non-pensioner ESM/widows aged 65+. Education: up to two children up to graduation, widows for PG (not professional/technical courses). Daughter's marriage: pensioner/non-pensioner ESM up to Havildar or equivalent, max two daughters, marriages after 01 Apr 2016. Medical: non-pensioner ESM up to Havildar without other income and in penury. Serious diseases: non-pensioner ESM (all ranks)/widows. Mobility equipment: disabled ESM (all ranks). Home loan interest subsidy: war widows/war bereaved/war disabled/attributable peace-time casualties. PMSS: 5500 wards/widows per year (2750 boys, 2750 girls).
schemes.benefit: 1. Penury: Rs 4,000/- per month (paid annually) for life (wef 01 Apr 2017); 2. Education: Rs 1000/- per month per child; 3. 100% disabled child: Rs 3000/- per month per child (paid annually) wef 1 Aug 2021; 4. Marriage grant Rs 50,000/- per daughter (max two daughters) / widow re-marriage; 5. Medical treatment of non-pensioner ESM: one-time grant Rs 50,000/- (revised Aug 2023); 6. Orphan children: Rs 3,000/- pm paid annually wef 01 Apr 2022; 7. Vocational training of widows: one-time grant Rs 20,000/-; 8. Treatment of serious diseases (cancer, renal failure, heart) - amount not stated; 9. Mobility equipment for disabled ESM - amount not stated; 10. Interest subsidy on home loan: 50% of interest, loan upper limit Rs 1,00,000/-; 11. Prime Minister Special Scholarship: Rs. 2500/- p.m. (boys), Rs. 3000/- p.m. (girls) for 2-5 years.
schemes.notes: Funded from Armed Forces Flag Day Fund (AFFDF)/KSB; funding labelled '100% Central'. Document ends with a second copy of the gallantry award table.

schemes.name: Schemes provided by the State Government to Ex-Servicemen, widows and their dependents
schemes.target: Ex-servicemen, their widows and dependents; gallantry award winners; families of defence personnel killed/disabled
schemes.eligibility: Ex-Servicemen/widows/dependents belonging to the State (registered with Department of Sainik Welfare for some benefits). Conditions per item: WW-II veterans/widows not in receipt of any pension; war widows whose husbands were killed in action prior to Jan 2000; document/stamp duty exemptions only for personal (not commercial/real estate) use.
schemes.benefit: (a) Cash Grant, Cash in lieu of Land and Annuity to Gallantry and Distinguished Service Award winners; (b) special package: Rs. 10.00 lakhs to NOK of deceased in enemy action/action against militants etc., Rs. 3.00 lakhs to disabled in such action; Rs. 8.00 lakhs to NOK / Rs. 2.00 lakhs to disabled for accidents attributable to military service; Rs. 8.00 lakhs to NOK / Rs. 2.00 lakh to disabled from acts of violence by terrorists/anti-social elements; (c) Rs. 8000/- per month to WW-II Veterans and widows not in receipt of pension; (d) Rs. 2500/- per month to War Widows (killed in action prior to Jan 2000); (e) registration fee exemption; (f) house tax exemption; (g) stamp duty exemption; (h) 2% reservation in Group C and D posts; (i) 1% seats for children in professional colleges/ITI/Polytechnic; (j) exam fee exemption for State Civil Service; (k) Green Card for NOK of martyrs; (l) 3% quota for Fair Price Shop; (m) 2% quota in Goa Housing Board plots/flats; (n) free KTCL bus travel for WW-II veterans and widows; (o) 50% VAT exemption on motor car purchase for registered ex-servicemen.
schemes.notes: Summary list from OCR (minor OCR damage in numbering). Monthly pensions: Rs. 8000/month (WW-II) and Rs. 2500/month (war widows). Could be split into components; kept as one row as it is a summary list without application procedure. Undated.

schemes.name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Funeral and Religious Ceremonies related to last rites of a person of ST Community)
schemes.target: ST families in which a death has occurred
schemes.eligibility: ST family with income not exceeding Rs. 2.00 lakhs per annum; resident of Goa for last 15 years; not covered under any other Government scheme; claim within 6 months of death by next of kin.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 20,000/- or actual cost whichever is less for funeral and last-rite religious ceremonies (incl. 12th/30th day rites) in Goa.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to Tribal Welfare Department within 6 months with caste certificate, income certificate, death certificate, bills/receipts; enclosures ration card, election card, residence certificate.
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/55, Official Gazette Series I No. 29 dated 18-10-2012. Document also contains fragments of an unrelated 2012 scheme notification (DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51) and hospital empanelment order.

amendments.name: Amendment to Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (2015)
amendments.benefit: Unchanged.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13; date OCR-damaged ('Panaji, May, 2015'); gazette Series I No. 8 dated 21-05-2015 per later reference.

amendments.name: Amendment to Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (2018)
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/Amendment/2018-19, Official Gazette Series I No. 11 dated 14-06-2018.

amendments.name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana
amendments.benefit: Financial assistance (amount not visible in extracted text).
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13 in Official Gazette Series I No. 8 dated 21-5-2015; signature line reads 'Panaji, May, 2015' (day missing). Amends Sr. Nos. 3, 4 and 8 of the scheme; the assistance amount is not visible (text partly trimmed).

amendments.name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Funeral and Religious Ceremonies of Scheduled Tribe families under Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana Scheme
amendments.benefit: Not changed by this amendment (amount not stated).
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/SAT/PC/2021-22/64/4307, Official Gazette Series I No. 36 dated 08-12-2022. Also amends Clause 7: Monitoring Committee of Secretary Tribal Welfare (Chairman), Director Tribal Welfare (Member), Dy. Director Tribal Welfare (Member Secretary). Rest of gazette is unrelated (CZMA fees, recruitment rules).

schemes.name: Ashraya Adhar Scheme (Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Ltd.)
schemes.target: ST members needing repair/renovation/reconstruction of house
schemes.eligibility: Any person of Scheduled Tribe community having a house (including mundcarial house) owned individually or jointly; where jointly owned with separate family units residing separately, each unit eligible (family = husband, wife, unmarried children, plus dependent parents and unmarried siblings staying with applicant). Age not more than 55 years on date of application (relaxed to 58 for employees of State/Central Government, Government Corporation/Board or aided institute).
schemes.benefit: Loan up to Rs. 5,00,000/- at 2% simple interest per annum for repair/renovation/reconstruction of house; released in two instalments: Rs. 3,75,000/- on sanction and Rs. 1,25,000/- on utilisation of first (work to start within 3 months). Repayment in 120 EMIs over 10 years with 3-month moratorium (interest charged during moratorium); applicants above 50 repay by age 60; govt employees by retirement + 6 months; 2% interest on overdue instalments; life and property insurance premium borne by loanee.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed loan application form with 2 passport photos to the Corporation, with ST certificate, age proof, notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper, latest house tax receipt, NOC from co-owner, income proof, 2 sureties (one if govt-employed surety; none if applicant is govt employee), estimate of cost, photos of house, Aadhaar, bank mandate; physical verification by Corporation officer; approved by Chairman with a Director and sanctioned by Managing Director.
schemes.valid_period: Implemented by GSSTFDC Ltd. for five years from date of issue
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/ADMN/GSSTFDCL/171/2018-19/LA/6911, Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018; signing date not in text. Benefit is a concessional loan, not a grant. Recoverable as land revenue arrears on default.

schemes.name: Ashraya Adhar Scheme (Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Ltd., Panaji)
schemes.target: Scheduled Tribe members owning a house needing repair/renovation/reconstruction
schemes.eligibility: Any person belonging to Scheduled Tribe Community having his house (including mundcarial house) owned individually or jointly; if jointly owned with different family units residing separately, each unit eligible (family = husband, wife, unmarried children, plus dependent father, mother and unmarried brothers/sisters staying with applicant). Age not more than 55 years on date of loan application, relaxed up to 58 years for employees of State/Central Government/Government Corporation/Board or aided Institute.
schemes.benefit: Loan up to Rs. 5,00,000/- at 2% simple interest per annum for repair/renovation/reconstruction of house, released in two installments: Rs. 3,75,000/- immediately after sanction, Rs. 1,25,000/- on utilization of first installment. Repayment in 120 equated monthly installments within 10 years with 3-month moratorium (interest charged during moratorium); repayment re-fixed till age 60 if applicant above 50, or till retirement + 6 months for government employees. 2% interest on overdue installments. Life and property insurance premium borne by loanee.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed loan application form with 2 passport photos to the Corporation; scrutiny and physical verification by Corporation officer; approval by Chairman with one Director, sanction by Managing Director. Documents: ST certificate, age proof, self affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper (notarized), latest house tax receipt, NOC from co-owner (if any) on Rs. 50 stamp paper, income proof, 2 sureties (one govt-employee surety suffices; none needed if applicant is govt employee), estimated cost of work (as per format), photos of house, Aadhar copy, two photos, bank mandate form. Work to commence within 3 months of release.
schemes.valid_period: Implemented by Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Limited for five years from the date of issue
schemes.notes: Notification No. DTW/ADMN/GSSTFDCL/171/2018-19/LA/6911 in Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018; signing date not visible (text cut). It is a loan scheme, not a grant. Funding source not stated. Not the portal-title scheme; included as complete in text.

schemes.name: Assistance for construction of retaining wall for soil conservation
schemes.target: Farmers needing soil/field protection through retaining walls
schemes.eligibility: Farmer should be registered under Krishi Card Programme; apply in prescribed format indicating approximate length and height of proposed retaining wall; existing structures are not eligible.
schemes.benefit: Assistance @ 50% of cost for construction of retaining wall of average width 0.4 mt and height upto 1.5 mts. Random masonry with hard laterite stones: standard rate Rs. 285/- per sq m, assistance Rs. 142/-; masonry with river pebble stones: standard rate Rs. 340/- per sq m, assistance Rs. 170/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agriculture Officer before commencement of work with photo (with natural reference point); ZAO/District Agriculture Office scrutinizes, inspects site and issues administrative approval; after completion submit photo, bills/vouchers to ZAO, claim forwarded to District Agriculture Office. Documents: copy of Krishi Card, GAR-32 in duplicate, bills and vouchers.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect; in force till withdrawn or amended
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Agriculture (Not. 3/4/Agron/PPG/3-2(3)/2015-16/D.Agri/115) in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because the portal file is filed under Atal Asra Yojana. Assistance is per sq m; no overall ceiling stated. 'State' funding inferred from Finance Dept concurrence only.

schemes.name: Assistance to traditional/Artisanal Fishermen for (a) Procurement of FRP boats up to 10 meters OAL as a replacement for traditional/wooden boats including net (b) Procurement of insulated fish and ice holding boxes
schemes.target: Traditional/artisanal fishermen replacing wooden canoes
schemes.eligibility: Must possess NOC issued by Directorate of Fisheries for procurement of FRP craft up to 10 m OAL replacing old wooden canoe and purchase of fishing net and insulated boxes; produce original GST bill from authorized dealer; applicant shall not be a fishing trawler owner or defaulter of the Department. Fishermen who availed other State scheme (financial assistance for fisheries requisites - gill net with accessories and insulated boxes) not eligible for subsidy on both equipments, but eligible for subsidy on fishing canoe only.
schemes.benefit: General category: 40% of unit cost limited to Rs. 1,70,000/- (canoe unit cost Rs. 4,00,000/- subsidy Rs. 1,60,000/-; insulated fish/ice boxes unit cost Rs. 25,000/- subsidy Rs. 10,000/-). SC, ST, Women and their co-operatives: 60% of unit cost limited to Rs. 2,55,000/- (canoe Rs. 2,40,000/-; boxes Rs. 15,000/-). Subsidy shared Central 60% / State 40%; paid by ECS/DBT.
schemes.how_to_apply: Obtain NOC from Directorate of Fisheries; claim subsidy with original GST bill; craft and nets to be registered with Directorate of Fisheries; not to sell/mortgage/transfer for five years.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Fisheries (Not. DF/GB/SCHEME/ARTISINAL F.M./2017-18) under Blue Revolution scheme, in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing.

schemes.name: Atal Asra Yojana (Financial Assistance for Construction of New Houses and Repairs)
schemes.target: ST families of Goa needing construction/reconstruction/repair of houses
schemes.eligibility: Any individual from ST community of State of Goa having family income upto Rs. 1.50 lakhs p.a. (family = father/mother/spouse/son and unmarried daughter; major son residing separately excluded). Applicant should be owner of the land; construction per plan by registered Engineer/Architect. Assistance in addition to and irrespective of Rajiv Awas Yojana/Indira Awas Yojana. Priority: BPL families first; households headed by widow/unmarried/divorcee women; physically disabled; households affected by flood, fire, natural calamities; forest dwelling applicants; others. No second sanction for same house except deserving case with Monitoring Committee approval
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs. 2.00 lakhs for construction of new house or reconstruction of existing house; up to Rs. 75,000/- for repairs; Monitoring Committee may increase limit to Rs. 2.50 lakhs and Rs. 1.00 lakh respectively in deserving cases. Fees of registered Engineer/Architect paid directly by Director of Tribal Welfare, max 5% of total cost
schemes.how_to_apply: Documents include family income certificate issued by V.P. Secretary countersigned by BDO (Village Panchayat areas) or by Chief Officer of Municipal Council (municipal areas); estimate by registered Engineer/Architect (or self/mason for reconstruction/repairs, no fee reimbursed); where construction permission is pending, BDO processes file and recommends
schemes.later_amendments: 20-04-2020 – Amendment to Atal Asra Yojana (recovery/closure and evaluation clauses, 2020); 2022-04-05 – Atal Asra Yojana
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/5879 (Official Gazette Series I No. 41 dated 9th January, 2014) replaces scheme notified vide No. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51 dated 14th March, 2013. Signing date not in text. Trimmed: conditions of sanction cut off mid-clause; later clauses may be on later pages. Portal title refers to recruitment rules in same gazette.

amendments.benefit: No change to amounts.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/2104, Official Gazette Series I No. 32 dated 05-11-2015. Date partly OCR-damaged ('28th Oct ... 2015').

amendments.benefit: Rs. 2.00 lakhs for construction of new house/reconstruction; up to Rs. 1.50 lakhs for repairs; disbursed in two instalments 75% and 25%. Fees of registered Engineers/Architects/Contractors (PWD/GSIDC etc.) up to 5% of sanctioned amount paid directly.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2017-18/51, Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 08-02-2018 (signature date not in extracted text). Work to commence within 90 days; 2nd instalment applied within 90 days. Trimmed.

amendments.name: Atal Asra Yojana
amendments.benefit: Financial assistance for construction, re-construction and repairs of house (amounts not stated in this amendment).
amendments.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/2104 in Official Gazette Series I No. 32 dated 5-11-2015. Amends Sr. No. 6 (conditions of sanction (c),(d),(e)) and Sr. No. 21 (documents); all other clauses unchanged.

amendments.name: Atal Asra Yojana
amendments.benefit: Clause 4 (Benefit under the Scheme), addendum clause (iii) amended: Construction/Re-construction licence fees for construction or re-construction of house under the scheme will be exempted to beneficiaries subject to maximum of Rs. 1,050/- for which area of house falls in the jurisdiction of Village [Panchayat - text cut off].
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/3316 in Official Gazette Series I No. 14 dated 02-07-2015; signing date not in text (truncated mid-clause). Same gazette has Goa Land Development and Building Construction (Amendment) Regulations, 2015 inserting Annexure XV for Atal Asra Yojana houses: should conform to Settlement Zone of RPG 2021; no new construction in Eco-I land (repairs in forest/1 km buffer with Forest NOC); max 100 sq. m plinth, ground plus one floor, total built-up not over 150 sq. m; min plot 60 sq. m for new construction, coverage of reconstruction not over 60%; at least 1.50 m access and 1.00 m side setback; no conversion Sanad/licence copy insisted for repairs; applicant must own land or have irrevocable NOC/Mundkar proof; no infrastructure tax or other fees. Rs. 1,050 is a licence-fee exemption cap, not the main housing grant (main benefit amounts not in text). Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

amendments.benefit: Financial assistance for construction of new house, reconstruction or repairs of existing house; amounts not stated in this amendment.

Also present: fragment of a 03-02-2026 notification (61-22-2017-BC-DSW/Part/5046) stating cases applied before 31-12-2025 and pending may get benefit of that amendment, with recovery under Land Revenue Code (preceding text missing); and start of 23-04-2025 notification (Part/1563) modifying clauses 8(e), 9(i), 9(vi) - cut off. Original scheme amounts are on pages not included. Gazette also lists other schemes (Art & Culture schemes, Cooperation incentives, extension of Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme 2017, TOS-DRILL) but their texts are not included. Local body role: Panchayat/Municipality certificate can substitute for Form I & XIV for repairs.

schemes.name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching to Scheduled Tribe Students Studying in Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
schemes.target: ST students in class X, XI (Science), XII (Arts, Science, Commerce) taking coaching
schemes.eligibility: Student belongs to ST category (communities notified in Goa); regular full-time student in Government school/higher secondary or school recognised by Government of Goa or Central/State Board, attending regular classes in institutions in Goa aided by Government of Goa; no income limit; not for open school or similar mode; fees not reimbursed for a repeated class; benefit once per standard (once on change of stream); coaching institute in Goa recognised by Directorate of Education or registered under Goa Coaching Classes Regulation Act, 2001; must apply each academic year (no deemed renewal).
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 75% of coaching fees paid, up to a ceiling of Rs. 10,000/- per annum per subject in rural areas and Rs. 12,000/- per annum per subject in urban areas. Subjects: X - Mathematics, Science, English; XI Science and XII Science - Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology; XII Commerce - Accountancy, Mathematics; XII Arts - English, Economics. Paid by DBT: 50% in first term on fee receipt, 25% after first-term attendance certificate. Refund required if coaching discontinued.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form available at Director, Tribal Welfare, Panaji and Office of Dy. Director, Tribal Welfare, Margao; affix signed photo; documents: caste certificate, birth certificate, Aadhar card, bank mandate form, institution ID card, fee receipt and fee structure, coaching institute registration certificate; coaching institute certifies enrolment. Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions.
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/AD(N)/EPY/2022-23/CSS-37/2854, OG Series I No. 27 dated 06-10-2022. Max is per subject per annum (urban). Budget head 2225-02-277-17. Same gazette has S&T 'Scheme to encourage students for innovative projects' (only tail visible; up to Rs. 50,000 per project) - not extracted.

schemes.name: Exit Policy for distressed beneficiaries under the Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)/Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana (VKRY) Scheme
schemes.target: Distressed CMRY/VKRY loanees of EDC Ltd. (since 2001) and their heirs
schemes.eligibility: All CMRY/VKRY loan accounts with EDC Ltd. since 2001 (also Share Capital Assistance to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme of DITC). Category A: death of beneficiary during currency of loan (past or future); Category B: permanent disability during currency of loan; Category C: incapable to repay due to natural calamities, critical health of borrower/dependant, adverse market conditions or sector impact announced by Government, or other justified reason.
schemes.benefit: Relief from repayment of outstanding loan on case to case basis; Category A: TFC may recommend waiver of entire outstanding EDC term loan with interest, cost and expenses and outstanding Share Capital (DITC) with interest, and handing over financed assets to legal heirs; disability cases decided after valuation of assets if beneficiary continues to use them.
schemes.how_to_apply: Legal heir/next of kin/guarantor furnishes death certificate and letter requesting waiver to EDC Ltd.; placed before Task Force Committee (TFC); waiver ratified by Competent Authority.
schemes.valid_period: 5 years from publication or as further extended
schemes.notes: Department of Finance (DMU) Not. 6/21/2015-FIN; no rupee cap. Category B/C procedures partly cut off. Official Gazette Series I No. 27 dated 01-10-2015; two-column text interleaved; trimmed.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to facilitate community level action for growth of agriculture and for preparing conservation management plan of community forest resources
schemes.target: Tribal (ST) farmers' co-operatives and Forest Rights Act committees
schemes.eligibility: Target population: cultivators/agriculturists of Scheduled Tribe community or forest dwelling STs dependent on Community Forest Resources in areas/villages where Forest Rights Act is implemented. Eligible: (1) Tribal farmers co-operatives registered under the Co-operative Societies Act formed for improved productivity or marketing of farm/forest produce; (2) committees constituted by Gram Sabhas to manage Community Forest Resources under FRA; (3) Forest Right Committees under FRA; (4) Village Panchayat in whose jurisdiction such co-operative/committees are constituted. At least 50% of co-operative members must be ST; minimum 10 ST beneficiaries; land ownership documents/NOC from owner.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for running activities: (1) wages of one clerical assistant and one peon at rates fixed under Minimum Wages Act; (2) fixed amount of Rs. 25,000/- per annum for stationery, printing etc.; (3) one time financial assistance of Rs. 1,00,000/- for procurement of desktop computer, UPS, computer table, cupboard, table and chairs etc.; (4) rent per annum for office premises as per rent certificate issued by PWD (Bldg Division). 50% of sanctioned amount released as 1st installment; balance after utilization certificate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to the Zonal Agriculture Officer with: FRC/committee constitution notification, registration certificate of co-operative, Gram Sabha resolution, brief project report, constitution and composition, PWD rent certificate, land ownership documents/NOC, ST certificates, undertaking, ZAO recommendation certificate, Aadhaar copy, mandate form. ZAO forwards to Director of Tribal Welfare, who sanctions.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of notification; to be evaluated after two years
schemes.notes: Published in Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 24-12-2015 (Not. No. DTW/STAT/FA/2014-15/1/14841). Funding source not explicitly stated beyond Government of Goa/Tribal Welfare. Village Panchayat listed as an eligible entity. Same gazette contains 'Financial Assistance to Participate and Organize Exhibition cum Sale, Fairs and Workshop Camp as Udyog Adhar Yojana' but its text is cut off, so not extracted.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to facilitate community level action for growth of agriculture and for preparing conservation management plan of community forest resources, i.e. Sheti Samrudhi Yojana
schemes.target: ST cultivators/forest-dwelling STs organised in farmers co-operatives or FRA committees
schemes.eligibility: Tribal farmers co-operatives registered under Co-operative Societies Act (formed for improved productivity or marketing of farm/forest produce; 50% of members ST); committees constituted by Gram Sabhas to manage community forest resources under Forest Right Act; Forest Right Committees under FRA; Village Panchayat in whose jurisdiction such co-operatives/committees are constituted. Areas/villages where FRA is implemented; minimum 10 ST beneficiaries.
schemes.benefit: For running activities: (1) wages of one clerical assistant and one peon at Minimum Wages Act rates; (2) fixed Rs. 25,000/- per annum for stationery, printing etc.; (3) one time Rs. 1,00,000/- for Desktop Computer, UPS, computer table, cupboard, table and chairs etc.; (4) rent as per PWD (Bldg. Division) Rent Certificate with minimum limit of Rs. 8,000/- per month urban and Rs. 5,000/- per month rural, enhanced @10% every 3 years. Released 50% first installment, balance after utilization certificate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form to the Zonal Agriculture Officer with: ST certificates of members, registration certificate, Gram Sabha/Village Panchayat resolution, ST certificates (min 10 beneficiaries), land ownership/NOC, brief project report, undertaking on sharing resources, constitution of co-operative/committee, notification of committee, PWD rent certificate, ZAO recommendation, Aadhar copy, mandate form. ZAO forwards to Director of Tribal Welfare who sanctions.
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/FA/2014-15/1/7004 in OG Series I No. 29 dated 20-10-2016, superseding Not. dated 24-12-2015 (modified scheme; signature date not in extracted text). Village Panchayat is an eligible applicant and Gram Sabha/VP resolution required. Max = one-time Rs. 1,00,000 grant (recurring items separate).

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Participate and Organize Exhibition cum Sale, Fairs and Workshop Camp as Udyog Adhar Yojana
schemes.target: ST artisans/producers and NGOs organising exhibitions for ST people
schemes.eligibility: Individual or group of individuals of Scheduled Tribe category with own capacity to produce/make/market the product for exhibition cum sale; NGOs working for benefit of ST people (for organizing exhibition/fair)
schemes.benefit: (1) Value addition and skill development: max Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum per individual/group/NGO; (2) preparatory work (raw materials, making charges, labour) max Rs. 50,000/- per annum; (3) actual cost of transportation, participation fees, daily allowance max Rs. 50,000/- per annum; (4) actual cost of organizing exhibition/fair/workshop for NGOs max Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum; (5) 50% advance as 1st instalment, balance on production of receipts/bills
schemes.how_to_apply: Proof of Aadhaar or Aadhaar authentication required (or enrolment slip plus bank/post office passbook with photo, PAN, passport, ration card, voter ID)

NGO/Society: actual cost up to Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum to organise exhibition/fairs/sale for ST persons within or outside Goa; 50% as 1st instalment, balance 50% on original bills, photographs and report within one month of the event.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/Exhibitions/2022-23/54/3601, Official Gazette Series I No. 31 dated 03-11-2022. Individual max is Rs. 10,000 per annum; Rs. 1,00,000 is the NGO cap. Gazette also contains StartUp Policy 2021 schemes (only tail annexures in text).

schemes.name: Goa State Cultural Award Scheme
schemes.target: Eminent Goan artists (lifetime achievement in art & culture)
schemes.eligibility: Individual artist who has completed 60 years of age with extraordinary contribution to art & culture; contributed in his/her field of art in Goa for minimum 10 years; recipients of Kala Gaurav Puraskar not eligible; not eligible a second time; no posthumous award (except death after recommendation); maximum 12 persons per year across fields (Music, Dance, Drama/Theatre incl. Tiatr, Performing Folk Art, Fine Art & Craft, Bhajan/Kirtan/Choir, Film & AV, Overall contribution, Literature, Creative Photography).
schemes.benefit: Memento, shawl, sriphal, certificate of appreciation and financial purse of Rs. 1,00,000/- per individual, plus monthly financial assistance (pension) of Rs. 3,200/- under the Kala Sanman scheme (not if already availing pension under any State or Central scheme; not paid to dependent after death).
schemes.how_to_apply: Department of Art & Culture releases press advertisement each year inviting recommendations from eminent institutions/individuals; Task Force Committee may also consider names suo-moto and recommends to Director of Art & Culture.
schemes.valid_period: From publication in Official Gazette upto 31st March, 2021
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Art & Culture (Not. DAC/COMPCELL/10-SCHEMES/2015-16/7594), repealing earlier notification; same gazette issue (24-12-2015) as the Tribal Welfare scheme; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing. 'State' funding inferred (Govt of Goa scheme).

schemes.name: Goa Welfare/Pension Scheme for Seafarers, 2021
schemes.target: Retired Indian seamen from Goa in lowly paid sea jobs, seamen invalidated on medical grounds, and widows of deceased seamen
schemes.eligibility: Citizen of India; Seaman of category in Annexure on completion of 60 years of age, employed on board and retired, or invalidated from sea service on medical grounds before retirement, or widow of deceased Seaman; annual income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 1,20,000/-; total 120 months actual service on board (breaks up to 6 months condoned; not applicable to medically invalidated or widows); bonafide resident of Goa by birth, or birth registered in Goa, or either parent born in Goa; widow must be resident of Goa of fifteen years domicile.
schemes.benefit: Gross pension of Rs. 2,500/- per month, remitted on last working day of every month; if in receipt of Dayanand Social Security Scheme/Griha Aadhaar/Kala Samman pension less than this, only the difference is paid.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in Form I to the Office of the Commissioner for NRI Affairs with CDC/Seafarers Identity Document, birth certificate/school leaving certificate, medical certificate (invalidation), death and marriage certificates (widows), income certificate Form II, residence certificate Form III, life certificate Form IV (annually before 31st March), affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper Form V, Voter ID, Aadhaar. Beneficiaries under 2018 scheme continue on production of life certificate.
schemes.valid_period: Deemed in force from 01-12-2021 up to 30-11-2022
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Home (Foreigners & Citizenship Division), Not. 4/9/2020-HD(F&CD)/NRI/05; date not visible. max_benefit_inr is monthly (Rs. 2,500 per month). Annexure of seamen categories not in extract.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Support for education in Agriculture
schemes.target: Goan students pursuing B.Sc/M.Sc (Agri/Hort) and allied degrees (children of farming community)
schemes.eligibility: Apply in prescribed proforma Annexure I; resident of Goa for minimum period of 15 years; selection on merit (aggregate marks of qualifying exam as points) with weightage: student from agricultural family having land in own/parent's/paternal parent's name (Form I & XIV) for B.Sc (Agri)/(Hort) - 10 points; fishing family for B.Sc (Fish...) [OCR gap]; inter-collegiate games/sports - 2 points; B.Sc degree holders seeking admission to UG agriculture/allied - 6 points; maximum added points 20. Post graduation support only for those admitted on own merit. Selected candidates make own stay/travel arrangements and execute bond on Rs. 50 non-judicial stamp paper.
schemes.benefit: Graduation B.Sc (Agri/Hort): Rs. 10,000/- per year/per seat paid to the University as per agreement; educational support Rs. 2,000/- per month for undergraduate students during entire period of study for maximum 4 years. Post Graduation M.Sc (Agri/Hort): educational support Rs. 3000/- per month during entire period of study.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed proforma (Annexure I) to Directorate of Agriculture; submit copy of admission fee receipt after admission.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.later_amendments: 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Study Tour outside State; 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Workshops/Exhibitions/Seminars/Krishi Melas/Trainings; 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Support for education in Agriculture and allied sciences
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is a monthly figure (Rs. 3000 per month for PG; Rs. 2000 per month for UG); Rs. 10,000 per year per seat is paid to the University. Part of criteria list lost in trimming. Component 3.9 'Assistance for Agriculture Training Centre' cut off. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Trainings and study tours
schemes.target: Farmers, farm workers, agricultural labourers, rural youth, students
schemes.eligibility: Skill development in farming operation (2 months, 20 participants/batch): individual/farmers or school dropouts, unemployed rural youth having marginal land or family land or belonging to family of agriculture labourer. Skill development in operation of agricultural machinery: individual/farmer/agriculture labourer having LMV licence. On-campus training: any individual farmer cultivating own or other's land, agricultural labourer, member of NGO, farmers clubs, students from high schools/colleges, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer. Off-campus training: any farmer, land owner, agricultural labourer, members of farmers clubs, students, women self help groups etc. Study tour within State: farmers cultivating own crops or interested, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer. Study tour outside State: farmers cultivating own/leased/rented land, agriculture officers, students of agriculture, members of farmers clubs, agri co-operatives, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer.
schemes.benefit: Skill development trainings: Rs. 300 per day per trainee towards food, refreshment, travel etc. (reduced where Department provides these), certificate at end; external experts @ Rs. 800 per demonstration. On-campus training (2 days, Farmers Training Centre, Ela, Old-Goa, 25 per batch): Rs. 300 per trainee. Off-campus training (1 day, 20-40 participants): expenditure up to Rs. 5000 per training plus Rs. 4000 per training for P.O.L.; expert honorarium Rs. 800 per day. Officers' training: Rs. 150 per day per officer/staff. Study tour within State: Rs. 200 per trainee for lunch, refreshment, stationery plus actual bus fare. Study tour outside State (90 farmers/year, 3 batches, 5-6 days): stipend Rs. 600 per day towards lunch, refreshment and lodging plus actual bus fare or 3-tier A.C. train fare.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through recommendation of the Zonal Agricultural Officer (for on-campus training and study tours); trainings conducted by Departmental Officers.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Per-day/per-trainee rates only; no single per-beneficiary total stated, so max_benefit_inr left null. Other components: mobile training vehicle (Rs. 15.00 lakhs) for ST farmers in distant areas. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Workshops/Exhibitions/Seminars sponsorship
schemes.target: Farmers Clubs, NGOs, voluntary organisations, professional institutes organising agricultural events
schemes.eligibility: Farmers Club, NGOs, voluntary organisations or professional institutes organising workshops/exhibitions/seminars must be a registered body and submit duly audited Statement of Accounts for last 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Department will provide maximum assistance of 50% of the cost with specific approval of Government upon receipt of detail proposal. Rs. 5.00 lakhs allocated for the component.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit detailed proposal with audited accounts for last 3 years to Department of Agriculture.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Rs. 5.00 lakhs is the component allocation, not a per-beneficiary cap. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: MATRUTVA YOJANA - Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method
schemes.target: ST married couples with primary infertility
schemes.eligibility: Couples belonging to Scheduled Tribes; married couple who fail to conceive even after three years of marriage due to primary infertility; only cases of primary infertility; no income limit; benefit for birth of first born child only
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for actual cost of IVF/IUI treatment at Government Hospitals or empanelled Private Hospitals/Nursing Homes in Goa, including diagnostic investigation, medicine, hospital admission, professional fees of Obstetrics and Gynaecology specialist in a specified course/package, and procedures like Laparoscopy; maximum Rs. 5.00 Lakhs (expenditure above borne by beneficiary). Funds of Rs. 5.00 lakhs transferred to Goa Scheduled Tribe Finance and Development Corporation account 'Matrutva Yojana'; payments in stages per treatment cycle (up to 4 cycles)
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form in Annexure-I to Directorate of Tribal Welfare with copy of provisional ST certificate issued by Dy. Collector with verification certificate of Director of Tribal Welfare, Marriage Certificate, Aadhar Card copy. Scrutiny Committee -> medical examination at Government Hospital -> Monitoring Committee -> Sanctioning Committee (chaired by Minister for Tribal Welfare); treatment to commence within 6 months of order
schemes.later_amendments: 2022-04-05 – MATRUTVA YOJANA - Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method; 26-08-2021 – Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method under Matrutva Yojana
schemes.notes: Revised scheme notified vide Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2017-18/53 in Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 8th February, 2018, replacing original Notification No. DTW/STAT/PC/2016-17/53/9274 (OG Series I No. 37 dated 15-12-2016). Signing date not in extracted text. Trimmed: bill procedure and later clauses may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Merit based Award and recognition of high performance in the Board Exams of SSC and HSSC in the State of Goa
schemes.target: ST students who passed SSC/HSSC board exams
schemes.eligibility: Students belonging to Scheduled Tribes who qualified SSCE/HSSCE Board Examination of Goa Board or any recognized Board conducting SSC/HSSC exams for students in Goa. A. Rank holders: first five rank holders among ST students in SSC and in HSSC (separately for Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational streams) - no income ceiling. B. Merit award: ST students whose annual family income is less than Rs. Two Lakhs securing benchmark percentage (50% and above).
schemes.benefit: A. Felicitation in public function, Certificate of Appreciation and financial award of Rs. 20,000/- to rank holders. B. Merit award: 50% to 59.99% - Rs. 5000/-; 60% to 69.99% - Rs. 8000/-; 70% to 74.99% - Rs. 10,000/-; 75% and above - Rs. 15,000/-. Students eligible for award of highest amount based on Board exam performance.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed format of Post Matric Scholarship along with attested copy of mark sheet; Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions; amount released electronically to beneficiary bank account.
schemes.valid_period: From date of notification; evaluation after two years
schemes.later_amendments: 06-10-2015 – Amendment to Merit Based Award (clause 4(b)); 15-01-2018 – Amendment to Merit Based Award (clause 4(B)); 15-01-2018 – Merit Based Award and recognition of high performance in the Board Exams of SSC and HSSC in the State of Goa

schemes.target: ST rank holders in SSC/HSSC board exams
schemes.eligibility: ST students who qualified SSCE/HSSCE of Goa Board or any recognised Board conducting exams in Goa; first five rank holders among ST students in SSC, and first five in HSSC separately for Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational streams. No income ceiling.
schemes.benefit: Felicitation in public function, Certificate of Appreciation and financial award of Rs. 20,000/- transferred electronically to bank account.

schemes.name: Prashikshan Yatra - Scheme to provide financial assistance for conducting Study Tours (Excursion) for ST Students during Vacations
schemes.target: Educational institutes (Goa Board/CBSE) with ST students in class VIII to XII
schemes.eligibility: Educational Institutes in Goa recognized by Goa Board/CBSE having Scheduled Tribe students; restricted to ST students studying in class VIII to XII who are willing; tour during Diwali, Christmas and Summer vacations with prior written permission of Education and Tribal Welfare Departments; two experienced teachers accompany; use railway concessions; tour from nearest station; accounts settled within one month and report within 15 days.
schemes.benefit: Financial Assistance to the Educational Institutes upto Rs. 1.00 lakh covering: actual travelling cost of up to 40 students and two teachers by rail (second class sleeper non-AC) and/or bus, tour of six days or more; entry fees/passes to monuments/cultural sites; lodging and boarding for minimum 6 days. Other expenditure borne by student/institution.
schemes.how_to_apply: Head of the Educational Institute submits prescribed application form to Director, Directorate of Tribal Welfare, Panaji at least one month in advance, with brief report on purpose and outcome and list of students; enclosures: parent/guardian permission and undertaking, tour programme, list of ST students with caste certificates, school registration certificate, railway/bus tickets. Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions.
schemes.later_amendments: 17-10-2016 – Amendment to Prashikshan Yatra (2016); 17-10-2016 – Prashikshan Yatra - Scheme to provide financial assistance for conducting study tours (Excursion) for ST students during vacations; 2021-08-24 – Addendum to Prashikshan Yatra
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/69, OG Series I No. 30 dated 25-10-2012. Later amended 2016 (limit raised to Rs. 1.50 lakh, see c11868bb1d). Max is per institute. Same gazette has 'Mundkarache Ghar' scheme (Not. /70) but its eligibility is truncated - not extracted (max Rs. 30,000/- visible).
