amendments.benefit: Standard hire charges at clause 3(iv) revised: Tractor (30 hp & above) with implements excluding Rotovator Rs 800/- per hour; Tractor (30 hp & above) with Rotovator Rs 1000/- per hour; Mini Tractor Rs 600/- per hour; Power tiller Rs 500/- per hour; Paddy Transplanter Rs 35000/- per hectare. Effective from date of publication.
amendments.notes: Gazette Series I No. 35 dated 01-12-2022. Text layout jumbled with adjacent Co-operation notification.

amendments.name: Modified Scheme for Custom Hiring Service in Agriculture (Amendment)
amendments.benefit: Clause 3(i) amended: 50% subsidy on standard hire charges provided to farmers at source when booking machinery from Department of Agriculture. Where Government approved agencies give subsidy at source, subsidy reimbursed to agencies after work is completed on receipt of letter of authority, undertaking and documents. Where farmer pays full hire charges to service providers, subsidy reimbursed to farmer after work completed on submission of payment receipt and documents.
amendments.notes: Gazette Series I No. 42 dated 13-01-2022 (Not. No. 3/1/Agri.Mech/AD(AE)/2021-22/D.Agri/247). Index also lists unrelated items (laptop/camera for journalists, Journalist Welfare Scheme, Sahayata Scheme amendment, ST orphan scheme) not in text.

schemes.name: Promoting Improved Technologies in Food Grain Crops
schemes.target: Progressive paddy/pulse/groundnut farmers; owners of paddy transplanters; SRI farmers
schemes.eligibility: Progressive farmer willing to take up new varieties of paddy as a challenge to test in their field and adopt departmental instructions (for minikits and SRI); must have appropriate fields and be willing to share details of operations and allow other farmers to visit. For mechanized transplanting incentive: only groups/individuals owning mechanized paddy transplanters and ready to take up transplanting as a package in farmers' fields; undertaking to cover at least 10 ha in a year at standard cost. SRI facilitators: trained farmers who practised SRI in own field and passed at least IXth standard.
schemes.benefit: (A) Seed minikits of new/improved varieties free of cost (2 kg paddy, 1 kg pulses, 5 kg groundnut per kit; max two kits of paddy and pulses at a time). (B) Mechanized paddy transplanting: 50% subsidy limited to Rs. 1.00 lakh on purchase of trays/silpaulin sheets/sieves/spacers for mat nursery. (C) SRI: trainings (Rs. 10,000/- per batch) and 22 field days (Rs. 20,000/- each); manually operated weeder of cost limited to Rs. 2,000/- per farmer cultivating SRI in minimum 0.1 ha (one time); manually operated sprayer limited to Rs. 2,000/- to a group of minimum 10 farmers; Muriate of Potash limited to Rs. 1,000/- per ha pro rata (min 1000 m2 under SRI, capped at 1000 ha/year); urea-DAP briquettes limited to Rs. 4,500/- per ha to farmers with more than 0.1 ha SRI (50 ha area); SRI facilitators paid honorarium of Rs. 5,000/- per month for up to five months (25 facilitators/year).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply with requisite documents to concerned Zonal Agriculture Officer; ZAO verifies and gives administrative approval; after purchase submit original receipts/invoice (or bank-attested copy if loan); ZAO inspects and forwards claim to Head Office; Dy. Director of Agriculture (Agronomy) scrutinizes. Minikit/SRI farmers identified by ZAOs.
schemes.valid_period: Till withdrawn or amended
schemes.later_amendments: 04-09-2017 – Promoting Improved Technology in Food Grain Crops (addendum to eligibility); 2023-12-15 – Promoting Improved Technology in Food Grain Crops (amendment)
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 20 dated 16-08-2013. Max Rs 1.00 lakh is for transplanter-owner incentive. SRI facilitator honorarium is Rs 5,000 per month. Index also lists a Co-operation scheme (pattern of assistance to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana) not included in text.

schemes.name: Promotion of Modified Sustainable Sugarcane Initiative (MSSI)
schemes.target: Registered sugarcane growers bringing new area under sugarcane
schemes.eligibility: Registered sugarcane grower with Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Kharkhana Ltd. desirous of bringing new area under crop; land in own name or on lease/contract/power of attorney/inheritance/co-owner as shown on valid Krishi Card; must use single bud seedlings raised in polytray and follow MSSI guidelines; certificate from SSSK; minimum 2000 m2 per farmer; no assistance if below Rs. 1000/-.
schemes.benefit: Assistance @ Rs. 10,000/- per ha towards land preparation and planting of single bud seedlings: 50% of expenditure on labour charges or Rs. 10,000/- per ha whichever is less, pro-rata.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online to Zonal Agricultural Officer in prescribed form with scanned SSSK certificate; ZAO verifies on site; claim uploaded for sanction by District Agriculture Officer.
schemes.valid_period: Till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 13 dated 29-06-2017. Rs 10,000 is per ha. Index also lists Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi (Art & Culture), not in text.

schemes.name: Promotion of Organic Farming 2018
schemes.target: Farmers and groups adopting organic farming in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Largely unreadable (OCR). Fragments indicate NGOs/Farmers/individuals/institutions/Self Help Groups eligible, with Krishi card.
schemes.benefit: Components largely unreadable (OCR). Objectives: promote organic farming, substitute agro-chemicals with bio-fertilizers/bio-controls, convert organic waste to manure, healthy foods and premium markets, awareness, conserve traditional local varieties.
schemes.how_to_apply: Largely unreadable; fragments mention proposals through Zonal Agricultural Officer, Dy. Director (CIN), payment via ECS.
schemes.valid_period: From 2018-19, in force till amended or terminated
schemes.notes: Circular No. 3/CIN/INM/Org-Gen/...2018-19/D.Agri dated October 2018 (day illegible) implementing scheme notified vide 3/CIN/INM/Org-Govt/4/2018-19/D.Agri/452 dt 4/10/2018 (Finance concurrence U.O. 1400055502 dt 07/09/2018), superseding notification dated 27/05/2016. Severe OCR damage: most of the components table, eligibility, pattern of assistance, and procedure are scrambled word salad; amounts seen in fragments (e.g. Rs 5,000/- per hectare, Rs 10,000, 50%, 75%, Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000/unit, Rs 1,00,000, 80:10:10, 90%) cannot be reliably tied to components. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Promotion of Organic Farming 2018 - Assistance for conservation of traditional seed varieties
schemes.target: Conservators/growers of traditional local crop varieties
schemes.eligibility: Government farms/recognised bodies involved in biodiversity/registered farmer-grower conservators of traditional local varieties (paddy, ragi, pulses, brinjal, bhendi, chillie, sweet potato, watermelon and others approved by Department committee); traditional variety's cultivation area in the State not more than 100 hectares (field crops) or 20 hectares (vegetables/other crops).
schemes.benefit: Field crops (paddy/pulse etc.): minimum 30 sq.m, maximum 500 sq.m at Rs. 20/- per sq.m pro rata; farmer gives 3 kgs of seeds to the Department at claim. Vegetables: minimum 50 sq.m, maximum 500 sq.m at Rs. 30/- per sq.m pro rata; farmer gives seeds (minimum quantity for small/large seeded varieties illegible in OCR). Other crops: area and pattern decided by Department committee.
schemes.notes: Component 4 of the circular; read through OCR errors. Per-sq.m rates only (not multiplied). Circular No. 3/CIN/INM/Org-Gen/...2018-19/D.Agri dated October 2018 (day illegible) implementing scheme notified vide 3/CIN/INM/Org-Govt/4/2018-19/D.Agri/452 dt 4/10/2018 (Finance concurrence U.O. 1400055502 dt 07/09/2018), superseding notification dated 27/05/2016. Severe OCR damage: most of the components table, eligibility, pattern of assistance, and procedure are scrambled word salad; amounts seen in fragments (e.g. Rs 5,000/- per hectare, Rs 10,000, 50%, 75%, Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000/unit, Rs 1,00,000, 80:10:10, 90%) cannot be reliably tied to components. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Promotion of Organic Farming 2018 - Organic farming demonstrations
schemes.target: Implementing agencies conducting organic farming demonstrations
schemes.eligibility: Demonstrations undertaken by Zonal Agriculture Offices, Farm Superintendent, Mechanical Cultivation Offices, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, ATMA, Institutions, Self Help Groups, Societies involved in agriculture, Sugar factory etc., on Government farms/Institution farms/progressive farmers' fields, community cultivation etc.; proposal based.
schemes.benefit: Demonstration on 04 hectare area (as OCR reads) covering 100% cost towards purchase of inputs for nutrient, pest, disease, weed management and cost of demonstrating farm machinery/equipment; total cost of one demonstration limited to maximum Rs 20,000/-.
schemes.notes: Component 3 of the circular; read through OCR errors (area figure '04 hectare' uncertain). Circular No. 3/CIN/INM/Org-Gen/...2018-19/D.Agri dated October 2018 (day illegible) implementing scheme notified vide 3/CIN/INM/Org-Govt/4/2018-19/D.Agri/452 dt 4/10/2018 (Finance concurrence U.O. 1400055502 dt 07/09/2018), superseding notification dated 27/05/2016. Severe OCR damage: most of the components table, eligibility, pattern of assistance, and procedure are scrambled word salad; amounts seen in fragments (e.g. Rs 5,000/- per hectare, Rs 10,000, 50%, 75%, Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000/unit, Rs 1,00,000, 80:10:10, 90%) cannot be reliably tied to components. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Promotion of Sri Anna-Millets cultivation in the State of Goa
schemes.target: Millet cultivators
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in Goa cultivating millets on own, tenanted/leased/contract or inherited land; also on verbal lease (with undertaking); Farmers Groups/Community Farmers Groups/Societies/SHG/Farmers Clubs cultivating collectively.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 20,000/- per hectare incentive for cultivation of all types of millets, pro-rata, minimum area 500 sq. mts., maximum 2.0 Ha (maximum limit not applicable to groups).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed format with documents to Zonal Agriculture Officer within 30 days of planting; ZAO inspects and forwards to District Agriculture Office for sanction; ZAO disburses.
schemes.valid_period: 2023-24 to 2027-28 (five years)
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/Crops & PP/18/Millets/2023-24/D.Agri/509; Official Gazette Series I No. 20 dated 17-8-2023. Max figure is per hectare. Same PDF also carries an illegible Environment dept scheme page (not extracted).

schemes.name: Revitalization of Khazan lands by seed distribution of salt resistant paddy varieties and subsidized rates
schemes.target: Farmers and lease holders cultivating Khazan rice fields
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating Khazan rice fields in Goa having Krishi Card; lease holders of Khazan rice fields.
schemes.benefit: Seed of Korgut and other salt tolerant paddy varieties distributed at pre-fixed price of Rs. 30 per kilo with 100% subsidy at source; maximum 100 kgs per farmer.
schemes.how_to_apply: ZAO identifies farmers and issues recommendation slip to collect seed from approved societies (Goa Bagayatdar, Goa Krishi Bazar, Pernem Taluka Farmers Society) or departmental sub offices.
schemes.valid_period: Till withdrawn or amended
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 13 dated 25-06-2015. Max benefit not stated as a rupee amount (100 kg at Rs 30/kg, not computed). Text also shows tail of another scheme (5-year tenure) and start of 'Assured price for Agriculture' amendment (cut off).

schemes.name: Scheme for Crop Protection in Agriculture
schemes.target: Farmers growing cereals, pulses, vegetables, horticulture & plantation crops
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing cereal, pulses, vegetables, horticulture & plantation crops in Goa.
schemes.benefit: (a) Seed treatment fungicide/pesticide supplied free, max Rs. 400/- per ha or actual. (b) Pesticides, fungicides, biocontrol agents, pest-monitoring equipment, light/mechanical traps, pheromone lures: 75% subsidy or max Rs. 4,500 per ha; max benefit Rs. 18,000 for 4 ha. (c) Biocontrol agents/egg cards/parasitoids from departmental lab released free. (d) SC/ST farmers: 90% subsidy max Rs. 5,400/- per ha; max Rs. 21,600/- for 4 ha. (e) In emergencies/epidemics Directorate procures pesticides at subsidized rate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Zonal Agricultural Officer with Form I & XIV or Krishi Card, original purchase receipt from registered dealer, caste certificate (SC/ST); ZAO verifies and recommends to Dy. Director of Agriculture (PP); subsidy by ECS. No application for seed treatment.
schemes.valid_period: Till amended or terminated
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 25-07-2013. Max Rs 21,600 is for SC/ST farmers (general Rs 18,000). Text also contains tail of a poly house/NHM scheme (incomplete) and start of 'Desilting and Revitalization of Ponds and Tanks' (cut off) - no rows made for those.

schemes.name: Shetkari Adhar Nidhi (revised State Sector Scheme)
schemes.target: Farmers suffering agricultural losses from natural calamities
schemes.eligibility: Farmer cultivating the land with valid Krishi Card. NGOs/Self Help Groups/Farmers Clubs/Institutes and Organizations engaged in agricultural activities with valid Krishi Card also covered. Causes: floods, drought, cyclonic rains, landslide & siltation, pest/disease epidemic, unseasonal rains, accidental fire, lightning, cloud burst, earthquake, wild animals.
schemes.benefit: Compensation per standard cost, e.g. paddy/vegetables/pulses etc. Rs 40,000/- per ha per season; sugarcane ready to harvest Rs 60,000/- per ha (4-9 months Rs 30,000/-); coconut palms Rs 600/1500/5000 per palm; arecanut, cashew, mango, banana etc. per-tree rates; agricultural inputs as actual up to Rs 40,000/- per ha; infrastructure/machinery/wells/walls at 25% of losses. Maximum compensation per farmer Rs. 1.60 lakhs (max 4 ha). Compensation from NCRF/insurance deducted.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to taluka Zonal Agricultural Officer within 15 working days of calamity in Annexure-I proforma with photographs; Krishi Card mandatory; ZAO inspects within 15 working days; settled at zonal level on sanction by District Agricultural Officer (North/South).
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect; in force till withdrawn
schemes.notified_on: April 2022 (day illegible); published 02-06-2022
schemes.later_amendments: 18-07-2016 – Amended scheme "Shetkari Adhar Nidhi" (2016); 2023-10-30 – State Sector Scheme Shetkari Adhar Nidhi
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXT/25/2022-23/D.Agri/22; supersedes 2015 and 2016 notifications. Official Gazette Series I No. 9 dated 2-6-2022. Compensation limited to once per year per season per farmer.

amendments.name: State Sector Scheme Shetkari Adhar Nidhi
amendments.benefit: Sr. No. 6(e) replaced: claims will be verified by the concerned Zonal Agriculture Officer and ... (rest cut off/OCR-garbled).
amendments.notes: Directorate of Agriculture Not. 3/5/EXT/25/2023-24/D.Agri/596 in same gazette (12-10-2023). Text OCR-damaged and incomplete.

amendments.name: Amended scheme "Shetkari Adhar Nidhi" (2016)
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXT/25/2016-17/D.Agri/257 listed in index; only struck-through/garbled fragments in text; content unreadable. Superseded by 2022 revised scheme.

schemes.name: Special Assistance for Sugarcane Growers
schemes.target: Sugarcane farmers in Goa
schemes.eligibility: All farmers cultivating sugarcane in Goa; valid Krishi Card; registered with SSSKL; beneficiaries not eligible for assured price for sugarcane under 'Assured Price for Agriculture Produce' scheme.
schemes.benefit: Special financial assistance on basis of highest productivity in last 5 years (2015-16 to 2019-20) limited to 80 MT per Ha for 2020-21; thereafter on actual area and actual production. Rates: 2020-21 Rs 3000/- per MT; 2021-22 Rs 2800/-; 2022-23 Rs 2600/-; 2023-24 Rs 2400/-; 2024-25 Rs 2200/- per MT. Farmers free to sell to any factory; no harvesting/transport charges paid.
schemes.how_to_apply: SSSKL registers farmers; area assessed by SSSKL and certified by Zonal Agriculture Officer; paid by SSSKL from Grant-in-Aid.
schemes.valid_period: 2020-21 for five years or till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/Crops & PP/80/8/SSSSKL/2021-22/D.Agri/162; Official Gazette Series I No. 12 dated 17-6-2021. Per-MT rates only, no cap per beneficiary.

amendments.name: Special Assistance to Sugarcane Growers (amendment)
amendments.benefit: Para IV(i): special assistance for all five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) on basis of highest productivity during last 5 years (2015-16 to 2019-20) limited to 80 MT per ha. First-time growers in 2020-21 paid on State average productivity of last 5 years. From 2021-22 SSSKL confirms cultivation of sugarcane/alternate crop, ZAO certifies area, SSSKL pays.
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/Crops & PP/80/8/SSSKL/2022-23/D.Agri/775; Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 29-12-2022.

schemes.name: Desilting and Re-vitalization of Ponds and Tanks
schemes.target: Owners/users of irrigation ponds/tanks up to 500 m2
schemes.eligibility: Ponds/water bodies less than 500 m2 used for irrigation; serving individual farmer or group; farmer's name in Krishi card abstract as owner, tenant or lessee with right to pond, validity minimum 10 yrs from year of application.
schemes.benefit: 100% of actual cost of desilting/revitalisation work, limited to cost evaluated by Department engineers; groups paid in instalments 25%/25%/50%; NGOs/SHGs/Farmers Societies get additional 10% of evaluated cost as incentive; total assistance restricted in proportion to maximum of Rs.70,000/per hectare of area benefitted under command.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agriculture Officer in specified form with Krishi card, site plan with command area, photos, GAR-32, vouchers, bank mandate, undertaking for irrigation use (6 years), group resolution; JE prepares estimate; Director approves; ZAO disburses.
schemes.notes: Circular No. 3/3/Hort/SSS/Desilt-Pond/6/2023-24/D.Agri (date OCR 'l31 1112023', read as 13-11-2023); scheme notified 06-07-2016. Max is per hectare benefitted. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Mechanizing Agriculture in the State of Goa - Assistance for Purchase of Agriculture Machinery & Equipments (Promotion of Mechanization in Agriculture) 2020-21
schemes.target: Farmers, farmer groups, societies, NGOs, panchayats purchasing farm machinery
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, registered farmer groups, registered agricultural co-op societies, NGOs, Village Panchayats, registered agriculture development institutions, farming companies; farmers must hold Goa Krishi Card. Tractor: own at least 10 ha (individual use) plus driver licence; Mini tractor: 2 ha and more; Power tiller: land of [illegible] ha, or 3000 m2 and more with undertaking to hire out as registered service provider; other machines: 2000 m2 and more; manually operated equipment: 500 m2 or more; walk-behind paddy transplanter: at least 4000 m2 paddy; riding transplanter, combine harvester and mini excavator only to farmers clubs/societies/NGOs. Groups: 2/3rd of minimum ten members with Krishi card and min 1000 m2 each. Not eligible again for 10 years (tractor, mini tractor, transplanter, combine) / 5 years (others) or specified hours.
schemes.benefit: Tractor, mini tractor, power tiller & paddy combine: 50% (ST and General/SC/groups). Mini tiller: 90% ST, 50% others. All other machinery/equipment/attachments excluding weed cutter: 75%. Weed cutter: 90% ST, 75% others. Attachments to other machines: 50%. Mini excavator: 75% of actual or standard cost whichever is less. Subsidy on standard or actual cost (excluding taxes) whichever is less; GoI (RKVY, SMAM) subsidy adjusted. At-source subsidy for farmers with annual income less than Rs.3,60,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agriculture Officer in prescribed form (Annexure I) with Krishi card abstract, dealer quotation and other documents; ZAO/MCO verify; Director of Agriculture approves major machines; ZAO approves others up to Rs 1.5 lakhs subsidy; DAO sanctions up to Rs 3 lakhs. Payment by ECS. Buy from registered dealers.
schemes.notified_on: 07-2020 (day illegible)
schemes.notes: Circular No. 3/1/Agri Mech/AD(AE)/2020-21/D.Agri/130 dated 2?.07.2020. Trimmed: text cut at guideline (xv); Annexure V machine list not included. No rupee cap per beneficiary stated.

schemes.name: Micro Irrigation - PDMC under Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) 2018-19
schemes.target: Farmers installing drip/sprinkler irrigation
schemes.eligibility: Combined drip and sprinkler area not exceeding 5.0 ha per beneficiary; new systems by approved manufacturer not previously subsidised; sprinkler only where drip uneconomical; co-operative societies/SHGs/incorporated companies may avail on behalf of members; installation by dealer registered with Directorate.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance limited to 55% of total cost of installation for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers, calculated on indicative unit costs for drip, portable/micro/mini/semi-permanent/rain-gun sprinklers and optional components (fertilizer tank, sand/hydrocyclone filters).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed format (Annexure I & II) with Krishi Card copy, survey plan with layout, letter of authority (if loan), GAR-32, receipts, dealer quotations, photograph; prior administrative approval from ZAO/DAO/D.Agri; ZAO inspects; DAO sanctions (above Rs 3.00 lakhs by Director).
schemes.notes: Circular issued under Order No. 3/3/Hort/GS/MI/9/2018-19/D.Agri/275 dated 05-02-2019 (circular's own date not printed). Funding share not stated. Indicative cost tables partly garbled by OCR.

schemes.name: Modified scheme for Custom Hiring Service in Agriculture (under State Sector Scheme 'Mechanizing Agriculture in the State of Goa') 2020-21
schemes.target: Farmers hiring machinery for ploughing/transplanting/weeding/harvesting; approved custom hiring agencies
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in Goa venturing for ploughing/transplanting/weeding/harvesting; machinery hired from Government departments or Government approved agencies (Sanjivani SSK, CADA, Goa Tillari Irrigation Corp., approved farmers clubs/NGOs/Village Agro Service Centres, co-operative societies, approved individuals, manufacturers' custom hiring centres). No subsidy to farmer already provided with appropriate machine. Collective farming: more than 4 farmers each with less than 1 ha.
schemes.benefit: 50% subsidy on standard hire charges (at source for departmental machines; reimbursed to agencies providing subsidy at source), within eligible hours per acre by crop. 60% subsidy for transplanting under collective farming. Nursery & transplanting subsidy maximum Rs 15,000/- per hectare for individual farmers and Rs 18,000/- per hectare for collective farming; cap of 1 hectare. Standard hire charges: Tractor with implements Rs 700/hr, with Rotovator Rs 800/hr, Mini tractor 500, Power tiller 400, Paddy combine harvester 2400, Combine Harvester 21HP 800, Kubota Mini Excavator 700.
schemes.how_to_apply: Requisition through taluka-level Mechanical Cultivation Officer or Zonal Agricultural Officer; farmer applies for subsidy within three months of work with self declaration, acknowledgement, letter of authority, GAR-32, mandate form; ZAO/MCO forward statements to District Agriculture Office for sanction.
schemes.valid_period: 2020-21 (scheme till withdrawn or amended)
schemes.notified_on: 07-2020 (day illegible)
schemes.notes: Circular No. 3/1/Agri Mech/AD(AE)/2020-21/D.Agri/131. Rs 18,000 is per hectare (1 ha cap). Eligible-hours table partly garbled by OCR.

schemes.name: One time assistance to farmers for removal of weeds/shrubs/bushes, aquatic weeds by hiring power driven machinery/equipments/manually
schemes.target: Farmers bringing fallow land under cultivation
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers cultivating agricultural/horticultural crops; registered under Krishi card programme. Cleared area must be used exclusively for cultivation for six years or more.
schemes.benefit: One time assistance of 50% of expenditure on hire charges of machinery/equipment including labour wages, limited to Rs.15,000 per hectare or 50% of actual expenditure whichever is less.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agricultural Officer with application form, Krishi Card copy and affidavit on Rs.50/- stamp paper; ZAO inspects and gives administrative approval; after work submit vouchers; subsidy released after ZAO certifies plantation.
schemes.notes: Circular continuing scheme notified vide Gazette Notification No. 3/1/WS/2015-16/D.Agri/323 dated 16-07-2015. Rs 15,000 is per hectare.

schemes.name: Western Ghat Development Programme (WGDP)
schemes.target: Farmers and groups in Sattari, Dharbandora, Sanguem, Quepem and Canacona talukas
schemes.eligibility: Farmer, Self Help Group, User Group, Farmers Club, Society, NGO from Sattari, Dharbandora, Sanguem, Quepem and Canacona talukas.
schemes.benefit: Planting material of fruit/medicinal/forest plants free up to Rs.5000/ha; agro-processing/traditional craft units 50% of standard cost limited to Rs. 30,000/- per unit; land development 50% of standard unit cost (Rs 10/15/20 per m2 by slope, max 1 ha); crescent trenches Rs 65/trench (up to 1000); gully plugging, drain diversion, dug-out pond 50% of actual cost; bank stabilisation 50% of standard cost (Rs 1003/1948/2814 per RMtr, max 500 RMtr); 10% of evaluated cost for maintenance of old structures; trainings/meetings/Krishi Mahotsav.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agriculture Officer in specified form with Krishi card/farmer abstract, survey plan demarcation, GAR-32, receipts, photographs, bank mandate; ZAO/Director of Agriculture approve; subsidy disbursed by ZAO.
schemes.notes: Circular No. 3/3/Hort/SSS/WGDP/7/2023-24/D.Agri (date OCR '/3/11/2023', read as 13-11-2023). Scheme notified 01-07-2016, amended 15-07-2021. 30,000 is per-unit cap for processing units; most components are %-based. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Assistance for Creation of Irrigation Infrastructure (implementation during 2023-24)
schemes.target: Farmers creating irrigation infrastructure (wells, borewells, pumpsets, solar pumps, micro-irrigation)
schemes.eligibility: Eligibility clauses not in extracted text. Preference to SC/ST farmers; 10.40% of target for ST farmers and 2% for SC farmers. Diesel/petrol pumpsets only where no electric supply or uneconomical. Any GoI CSS/CS assistance adjusted within state assistance.
schemes.benefit: Pattern of assistance not in extracted text. Annexures give standard costs for 2023-24: laterite masonry/RCC open wells, square wells, borewells, electric pumpsets (up to Rs 34,200 for 10 HP), diesel/petrol pumps (Rs 10,000 for 1 HP), off-grid solar pumps (Rs 96,877 for 1 HP to Rs 4,69,054 for 10 HP with USPC), micro-irrigation add-ons and drip systems.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Zonal Agriculture Officer: ZAO inspects site, certifies completion and submits claim to District Agriculture Officer; DAO sanctions up to Rs 3.00 lakhs, above that Director of Agriculture. Asset geotagged where GoI subsidy adjusted.
schemes.notified_on: 11-2023 (day illegible)
schemes.notes: Circular implementing scheme notified vide No. 3/3/Hort/SSS/4/2018-19/D.Agri/218 dated 31-12-2018 and its amendments/addenda (26-11-2019, 15-07-2021, ...). Trimmed: pattern of assistance and eligibility are on pages not extracted. 100% inspection by ZAO, 25% random inspection by DAO.

amendments.name: Addendum to State Sector Scheme I ‘Assistance for Creation of Irrigation Infrastructure’ — Assistance for purchase of Soil Moisture Indicator
amendments.benefit: Assistance for purchase of Soil Moisture Indicator up to 90% of the total cost inclusive of GST; may be availed as 'At Source Subsidy' paid to dealer when farmer pays his share and furnishes Letter of Authority.
amendments.notes: Department of Agriculture Not. 3/3/Hort/SSS/4/2021-22/D.Agri/603; date of addendum not visible (Finance U.O. dated 29-12-2021).

amendments.name: Assistance for Creation of Irrigation Infrastructure (Addendum - Soil Moisture Indicator)
amendments.benefit: Addendum adds para 3(viii) 'Assistance for purchase of Soil Moisture Indicator' after 3(vii); details cut off in extracted text.
amendments.notes: Only the start of this addendum is in the text (page cut); pattern of assistance and date not available.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Finfish and Shellfish Seeds
schemes.target: Aquaculture farmers buying freshwater/brackish water fish seed
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/Individual/Traditional fishermen/Registered SHG/Fisheries Co-operative Societies/Entrepreneurs doing aquaculture in Goa. Resident of Goa for last fifteen years. Caste certificate if SC/ST. Farm licensed under Coastal Aquaculture Authority (brackish/marine units). Ownership documents; seed purchase bill from authorised dealer/hatchery. Not eligible for any other State or Central scheme for same component. Limited to 2 ha ponds or 10 cages or 5 biofloc tanks (18 m3) or RAS tank (100 m3).
schemes.benefit: Brackish water seed: Ponds unit cost Rs. 12,000/- per 0.1 ha - Gen Rs. 6,000/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 7,200/-; Cage Rs. 50,000/- per cage - Gen Rs. 25,000/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 30,000/-; Biofloc/RAS Rs. 10,000/- per tank - Gen Rs. 5,000/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 6,000/-. Fresh water seed: Ponds Rs. 3,000/- per 0.1 ha - Gen Rs. 1,500/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 1,800/-; Cages Rs. 20,000/- per cage - Gen Rs. 10,000/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 12,000/-; Biofloc/RAS Rs. 6,000/- per tank - Gen Rs. 3,000/-, SC/ST/W Rs. 3,600/-. Gen 50%, SC/ST/Women 60%; paid via ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Obtain prescribed application form from Sub-Offices of Directorate of Fisheries and submit to the Fisheries Official at the sub-office; scrutiny committee of Fisheries officials.
schemes.valid_period: Three years from date of notification
schemes.notes: Notification DF/AQUA/FA-Fish seed/Govt. File/2026-27, Official Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 23-7-2026. max_benefit_inr is per cage (up to 10 cages); not multiplied.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for setting up of Crab Farming unit in Goa
schemes.target: Fish farmers, traditional fishermen, individuals, SHGs and societies taking up mud crab pen/box culture
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/Traditional Fishermen/individual/Registered SHG/Societies setting up crab farming unit in Goa. Fish farmer/Individual resident of Goa for last fifteen years (Residential Certificate). Training on crab farming by Fisheries Department/MPEDA/ICAR/recognized institute. Annual income not more than Rs. 20 lakhs. Land documents (Form I & XVI or Lease Deed). One-time assistance (once in life time).
schemes.benefit: Pen culture: setting up - unit cost Rs. 2.00 lakh per 0.1 ha, up to 0.5 ha: General 50% limited to Rs. 1.00 lakh, SC/ST/Woman 60% limited to Rs. 1.20 lakh; input cost - unit cost Rs. 1.50 lakh per 0.1 ha: General Rs. 75,000/-, SC/ST/Woman Rs. 90,000/-. Box culture (up to 2 units of 1000 boxes): horizontal unit cost Rs. 4.00 lakh - General Rs. 2.00 lakh, SC/ST/Woman Rs. 2.40 lakh; vertical (incl. RAS) unit cost Rs. 8.00 lakh - General Rs. 4.00 lakh, SC/ST/Woman Rs. 4.80 lakh; input cost unit cost Rs. 1.50 lakh - General Rs. 75,000/-, SC/ST/Woman Rs. 90,000/-. 100% of assistance released after installation, via ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Directorate of Fisheries with: residential certificate/registration document, training certificate, land document, Aadhar, caste certificate if SC/ST, NOC from local Panchayat/Municipality, site plan on Google map, clearances, project/feasibility report.
schemes.valid_period: Three years from date of notification
schemes.notes: Notification FSH/PLG/SCH-CRAB FARMING/2026-27, Official Gazette Series I No. 14 dated 2-7-2026. Cancels earlier crab scheme notified 9-6-2016. max_benefit_inr is per vertical box unit (up to 2 units); assistance per 0.1 ha for pen culture is not multiplied. NOC from local Panchayat/Municipality required.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa
schemes.target: Fish farmers, individuals, SHGs and societies setting up ornamental fish breeding/rearing units
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/individual/Registered Self help group/Societies interested in setting up ornamental fish farming unit in Goa. Fish farmer/Individual resident of Goa for last fifteen years. Site should have adequate water facilities. Own/leased land adequate for the unit. Applicant should undergo training on Ornamental Fish Farming by Fisheries Department/MPEDA/ICAR. Breeding unit min 4-5 species; rearing unit and rearing & breeding unit min 5-6 species.
schemes.benefit: (i) Breeding unit: 50% of the actual cost limited to Rs. 1,50,000/-. (ii) Rearing unit: 50% of the actual cost limited to Rs. 1,50,000/-. (iii) Rearing & Breeding unit: 50% of the actual cost limited to Rs. 2,50,000/-. 60% released on approval of project proposal, balance 40% on registration of unit. Eligible items listed in Annexure A (tanks, pools, FRP, cement tanks, lined ponds, blower, pump, filtration, etc.).
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application and project report (activities, layout plan, design, expenditure estimates) to Directorate of Fisheries with: identity proof plus fifteen years Residential Certificate (or SHG/Society registration), proof of land and finance, water testing report (pH, hardness, salinity), feasibility report, training certificate. Steps: advance approval (NOC), 60% release, set up unit, final application, registration, balance 40%.
schemes.notes: Notification FSH/PLG/SCH-ORN FISH/2016-17, Official Gazette Series I No. 12 dated 23-6-2016.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms
schemes.target: Registered fish and shrimp farmers (coastal aquaculture)
schemes.eligibility: All registered fish and shrimp farmers. Small farmers having water spread area of 2 ha or less. Farms owned by farmers should be licensed by Coastal Aquaculture Authority.
schemes.benefit: (a) Construction/renovation of farms/bandhs: 25% subsidy limited to Rs. 2.00 lakh per ha, of which Rs. 45,000/- per ha Central share; renovation eligible after 5 years of construction. (b) Farm equipment (aerators, pumps, crates, ice boxes etc.): 50% of the cost limited to Rs. 1.00 lakh per ha; eligible after 5 years. (c) Feed: 25% subsidy on cost of feed limited to Rs. 30,000/- per crop per ha for 2 crops in a year; every year. Paid by ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application forms available at all B.D.O. offices; filled forms forwarded to Directorate of Fisheries through the concerned B.D.O. office. Scrutiny Committee (Director, Dy. Director, Superintendent, Asst. Superintendent of Fisheries) recommends to Director of Fisheries.
schemes.funding: Centrally Sponsored Scheme (Central share Rs. 45,000/- per ha of construction subsidy)
schemes.later_amendments: 01-12-2022 – Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms (Amendment 2022); 05-02-2025 – Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms (Amendment 2025); 21-05-2013 – Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farm - Corrigendum
schemes.notes: Notification DF/PLG/Bud/2012-13, Official Gazette Series I No. 31 dated 1-11-2012. max_benefit_inr is per-ha construction cap. Text trimmed: gazette also has unrelated items (pensioner DR, Sanskrit addendum, recruitment rules).

amendments.name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farm - Corrigendum
amendments.notes: Corrigendum DF/PLG/BUD/2012-13/I, Official Gazette Series I No. 9 dated 30-5-2013. Date 21-5-2013 taken from the adjacent Fisheries signature block (two-column layout; slightly uncertain). Gazette also contains fragments of Agriculture hire-rate and Shetkari Adhar Nidhi addenda and other unrelated notifications.

amendments.name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms (Amendment 2022)
amendments.benefit: Introduction revised (reference to Centrally Sponsored Scheme dropped). Construction/renovation of farms/bandhs: 25% subsidy limited to Rs. 2.00 lakh per ha (Central share clause removed); renovation after 5 years of construction.
amendments.notes: Notification DF/PLG/BUD/2022-23, Official Gazette Series I No. 35 dated 1-12-2022; signature date not printed so gazette date used. max_benefit_inr is per ha.

amendments.name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms (Amendment 2025)
amendments.benefit: (a) Construction of new farms/bundhs: 25% subsidy of cost limited to Rs. 2.00 lakh per hectare; once in life time. (b) Farm equipment (aerators, pumps, crates, ice boxes etc.): 50% of the cost limited to Rs. 1.00 lakh per hectare; once in life time.
amendments.notes: Notification DF/PLG/BUD/2024-2025, Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 6-2-2025. Renovation no longer mentioned in revised clause (vi)(a). max_benefit_inr is per hectare.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Freshwater Aquaculture Farm
schemes.target: Freshwater fish/prawn farmers
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/individual/Registered Self help group/Societies/Association interested in Freshwater fish/prawn farming in Goa. Fish farmer/Individual resident of Goa for last fifteen years. Water spread area limited to 2 ha.
schemes.benefit: (a) Construction/renovation of farm: 25% subsidy of the cost limited to Rs. 2.00 lakh per ha, limited to 2 ha; once every 5 years. (b) Feed and seed: 25% subsidy on the cost limited to Rs. 50000/- per ha, limited to 2 ha; once every year. (c) Farm equipment: 50% of the cost limited to Rs. 60000/- per ha; once every 5 years.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form with: identity proof (Voter Id/Passport/Aadhar) plus fifteen years valid Residential Certificate, or SHG/Society registration document; NOC from local village Panchayat/Municipality; proof of availability of finance; project/feasibility report.
schemes.notes: Notification FSH/PLG/SCH-FRESHWATER/2016-17, Official Gazette Series I No. 12 dated 23-6-2016. max_benefit_inr is the per-ha construction cap (up to 2 ha). NOC from village Panchayat/Municipality required but local body has no stated delivery role.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
schemes.target: Fish farmers, individuals, SHGs and societies setting up mussel/oyster units
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/individual/Registered Self Help Group/Societies interested in setting up Mussel Culture/Oyster Farming Unit in Goa. Fish farmer/individual should be resident of Goa for last fifteen years. Applicant should undergo training programme on Mussel Culture/Oyster Farming organized by the Fisheries Department/MPEDA/ICAR/any other institute.
schemes.benefit: (a) Unit in estuarine waters (4 m x 4 m): 50% subsidy of the actual cost limited to Rs. 25,000 per unit, maximum 2 units. (b) Unit in open sea (6 m x 6 m): 50% subsidy of the actual cost limited to Rs. 40,000 per unit, maximum 2 units.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form with: proof of identity (Voter Id/Passport/Aadhar) plus fifteen years valid Residential Certificate, or registration document for SHG/Societies; NOC from COP in case of farming in the river; project/feasibility report.
schemes.notes: Notification FSH/PLG/SCH-MUS & OYS FARM/2016-17, Official Gazette Series I No. 12 dated 23-6-2016. max_benefit_inr is per unit (up to 2 units). Page also carries the tail of an unrelated Education Department librarian grant scheme (16-6-2016), incomplete.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Registered Fishermen Societies/Associations
schemes.target: Fishermen co-operative societies/associations
schemes.eligibility: All Fishermen Societies/Associations registered under the Co-operative Societies Act; members actively engaged in fishing at sea/inland fishing/fish/shrimp farming; must produce audited statement of accounts, employ at least one personnel for records, and produce books of accounts for inspection.
schemes.benefit: Grant-in-aid up to Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) towards administrative cost; paid by ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application available at and received by the concerned Block Development Officer's office; forwarded to Head Office; Scrutiny Committee recommends to Secretary of Fisheries.
schemes.notes: Notification DF/PLG/Bud/2012-13 dated 22-10-2012 in same gazette; beginning of this scheme text was cut off by the trim.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farm
schemes.target: Freshwater fish/prawn farmers
schemes.eligibility: Fish farmer/individual/Registered SHG/Societies/Association in freshwater fish/prawn farming in Goa; resident of Goa for last fifteen years.
schemes.benefit: (a) Construction & renovation: 25% subsidy limited to Rs. 2.00 lakh per ha, limited to 2 ha. (b) Feed and seed: 25% subsidy limited to Rs. 50,000/- (per year) per ha, limited to 2 ha. (c) Farm equipment: 50% of cost limited to Rs. 60,000/- (per year) per ha.
schemes.how_to_apply: Forward application in the prescribed form to the Department (Directorate of Fisheries).
schemes.notes: Portal summary sheet. Per-ha figure.

schemes.name: Mukhel Mantri Nustekar Mazat Yevjan (Aadhaar requirement under Section 7)
schemes.target: Next of kin of deceased fishers
schemes.eligibility: Beneficiary must undergo Aadhaar authentication or furnish proof of Aadhaar possession, or apply for enrolment if none.
schemes.benefit: Compensation not exceeding Rs. 50,000/- lump sum assistance to the next of kin of the deceased fisher.
schemes.notes: Notification FSH/PLG/DBT-Section-7/2026-27; text cut off after clause 1(2). Not the scheme rules themselves.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.target: Poor and vulnerable families per SECC 2011 and RSBY beneficiary families
schemes.eligibility: Households included based on deprivation and occupational criteria of SECC 2011 (rural/urban), plus families covered in RSBY not in SECC 2011. No restriction on family size, age or gender. Eligibility check at mera.pmjay.gov.in / www.pmjay.gov.in.
schemes.benefit: Cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization at empanelled public and private hospitals across India; cashless; 1,650 medical packages in Goa; portable nationwide.
schemes.how_to_apply: At PMJAY Kendras set up by Goa Electronics Ltd and at all public & private PMJAY empanelled hospitals. Documents: Ration Card/PMO letter (mandatory) plus one ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, passport, etc.). Contact: AB-PMJAY cell, DHS, Campal, Panaji, 0832-2225540, pmjaygoa@gmail.com.
schemes.notes: Described as 'fully financed by the government' without Centre/State split. Launched in Goa 23-09-2018. Cover is per family per year. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY)
schemes.target: Entire resident population of Goa residing 5+ years
schemes.eligibility: Residents of Goa for five or more years. Family defined via ration card (or marriage/birth certificates/declaration). OBC non-creamy layer (income below Rs.6.00 lakhs p.a.), SC/ST and differently abled to submit respective certificates.
schemes.benefit: Cashless insurance cover up to Rs.2.50 lakhs per annum for family of three or less members and up to Rs. 4.00 lakhs for family of four or more; claim never exceeds Rs. 4.00 lakhs annually; 447 procedures covered; can be availed individually or collectively.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at Goa Electronics Ltd., Ground Floor, Shrama Shakti Bhavan, Patto Plaza, EDC Complex, Panaji with Aadhar/enrolment slip of every member above 5 years, residence proof issued minimum 5 years ago in Goa, ration card, caste/disability certificates as applicable. For treatment, approach Empanelled Health Care Provider; DDSSY Sahayak raises pre-authorisation request. Website ddssygoa.mdindia.com.
schemes.later_amendments: 05-05-2021 – Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana - amendment adding COVID-19 treatment package; 19-11-2019 – Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana - amendment excluding Government employees
schemes.notes: Funding 'State' inferred (State scheme, insurer-administered) - not explicitly stated. Cover is per family per year. Scanned registration form at end is OCR garbage; it appears to mention registration fees and a concession (possibly 50%) for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer, but this is unreadable and not captured. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Family Planning Indemnity Scheme (FPIS)
schemes.target: Persons who underwent sterilization operation (and their claimants/dependents)
schemes.eligibility: Persons suffering death, failure or complication following sterilization operation (sections IA-ID); claim must be certified by convener of DISC (CMO or equivalent) at district level.
schemes.benefit: IA: death following sterilization in hospital or within 7 days of discharge - Rs. 4 lakhs; IB: death within 8-30 days of discharge - Rs. 1 lakh; IC: failure of sterilization - Rs. 60,000/-; ID: cost of treatment in hospital and up to 60 days for complication - actual not exceeding Rs. 50,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Beneficiary reports to respective health facility; in-charge reports case to District Indemnity Scheme Committee (headed by Collector) for verification, then to state office for payment. Submit to Medical Superintendent of District/Sub District Hospitals or Health Officer of CHC/PHC/UHC. Documents: claim form, consent/application form, sterilization certificates, case papers, admit paper, discharge card, Aadhar & Election card of husband and wife, birth certificates of both children, bank details.
schemes.notes: Claim Form cum Medical Certificate annexed. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Goa Mediclaim Scheme
schemes.target: Low-income permanent residents of Goa needing super-speciality treatment not available in Goa Government hospitals; retired State Government employees
schemes.eligibility: Permanent resident of Goa for last 15 years, in voters list, holding permanent ration card; family income less than Rs. 1.5 lakh per annum (retired State Government employees entitled and exempt from income ceiling); treatment not available in Government hospitals incl. GMC and District Hospitals (except NICU, ventilatory support and kidney dialysis); hospital must be recognized under the scheme.
schemes.benefit: Ceiling per treatment (or actual expenses, whichever is least): CAPD 15000 P.M; Dialysis 15600 P.M @ Rs.1300 per dialysis for 12 dialysis; Plastic surgery 1.5 lakhs; ICU/NICU/PICU/Trauma Care 1.5 lakhs; CABG/PTCA 1.5 lakhs; Open Heart Surgery 3.00 lakhs; Kidney Transplantation 3.00 lakhs; Neuro Surgery 3.00 lakhs; Radiotherapy/Chemotherapy (Cancer) 5.00 lakhs; Cochlear implant 1.5 lakhs; Spastic child/cerebral palsy/skeletal deformities 1.5 lakhs; Bone Marrow Transplant 8.00 lakhs. Credit facility at listed empanelled hospitals.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Director of Health Services, Panaji in prescribed Form C (self) / Form D (minor) with: medical certificate from treating doctor at GMC Bambolim, Hospicio Margao or Asilo Mapusa; income certificate (Form B) from Mamlatdar or certified copy of PPO for retired employees (15 years residence certificate); Mediclaim certificate from Medical Superintendent GMC; photograph and declaration; Election/Ration card, DDSSY and Aadhaar card. Submit at Mediclaim Cell, S-37, Second Floor, DHS, Campal, Panaji.
schemes.notes: Funding not explicitly stated; 'State' inferred from DHS administration - verify. List of 39 recognized hospitals included. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Honorarium for the TB Treatment supporter
schemes.target: TB treatment supporters (non-government servants)
schemes.eligibility: Any TB Treatment supporter other than Government servant.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1000/- for New TB patient; Rs. 1500/- for previous TB patient on treatment; Rs. 5000/- for Drug Resistant TB (DRTB) patient.
schemes.how_to_apply: On certification by Head of respective health unit; bank account details required. Office: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme, DHS, Campal, Panaji (CMO, 0832-2426416).
schemes.notes: Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Incentive to Private Practitioner
schemes.target: Private practitioners/hospitals notifying TB cases
schemes.eligibility: Private Practitioner/Hospital notifying TB cases.
schemes.benefit: Incentive of Rs. 500/- on notification of cases & Rs. 500/- on assigning outcome.
schemes.how_to_apply: On notification of TB patient, submit bank account details for Direct Benefit Transfer to National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme, DHS, Campal, Panaji (CMO, 0832-2426416).
schemes.notes: Amounts are per notification/outcome; 500 is per event, not a total cap. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
schemes.target: Pregnant women from BPL families or SC/ST community (institutional delivery)
schemes.eligibility: Women belonging to BPL family, or any woman of SC/ST community irrespective of income.
schemes.benefit: Rs.700/- for rural and Rs.600/- for urban area.
schemes.how_to_apply: Registration during antenatal period by ANM at PHC/CHC/UHC; application forwarded to Health Officer; funds transferred by DBT within 7 days of delivery. Documents: Aadhar card, Caste certificate, Ration card (BPL). Submit at office of Health Officer/Medical Officer I/C of CHC/PHC/UHC.
schemes.notes: Prescribed form mentioned as enclosed but not in text. Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Nutritional support to TB patients / Nikshay Poshan Yojana
schemes.target: TB patients on treatment
schemes.eligibility: All TB patients.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 500/- per month to patient on treatment for tuberculosis.
schemes.how_to_apply: On diagnosis, submit bank account details for Direct Benefit Transfer; National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme, DHS, Campal, Panaji (CMO, 0832-2426416).
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the monthly figure (Rs. 500 per month). Same content as the 2020-09-11 posting.

schemes.name: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme for Higher Education for Orphans
schemes.target: Children orphaned of both parents pursuing UG/PG general or technical education
schemes.eligibility: Orphaned of both parents (father and mother) and deprived of higher education for want of financial resources; born in Goa or resident of Goa for at least last fifteen (15) years; passed qualifying examination from institutions located in Goa; students enrolled for First Year of Degree/PG courses from academic year 2012-13.
schemes.benefit: Full waiver of the fees in the institution of admission: Tuition fees, Library fees, Laboratory fees and Development fees, if any, plus other charges payable to institution like Lodging/Boarding, Food (Hostel charges) or Transport, etc.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in format at Annexure 'A' at time of admission (with fee receipt, death certificates of father and mother, residential certificate); institution processes and sanctions fee waiver at admission. Managed by DHE (general education UG/PG) and Directorate of Technical Education (technical courses).
schemes.valid_period: From academic year 2012-13
schemes.notes: Same gazette (Series I No. 11, 14-06-2012) as the other DHE fee-waiver/orphans document in this batch. No rupee cap stated.

schemes.name: Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students pursuing Higher Education
schemes.target: SC/ST students of Goa pursuing higher education
schemes.eligibility: Born in Goa or resident of Goa for at least last fifteen years; passed qualifying examination from an institution located in Goa; belongs to SC/ST community of Goa; applies to students enrolled in First Year of degree/(PG) courses from academic year 2011-12.
schemes.benefit: Fee waiver sanctioned by the institution at the time of admission (details of amount/fees covered are on a part of the text that was cut).
schemes.how_to_apply: Fill application form at Annexure-A (with fee receipt, residential certificate, SC/ST certificate) at the institution at time of admission; institution sanctions fee waiver.
schemes.valid_period: From academic year 2011-12
schemes.later_amendments: 02-07-2025 – Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students pursuing Higher Education
schemes.notes: Same gazette (Series I No. 11, 14-06-2012) as the other DHE fee-waiver/orphans document in this batch. Trimmed: beginning of this scheme (objectives/details of fee waiver) not in extracted text; notification date 7-6-2012 inferred from shared notification number 32/2011-12/Bud/DHE/Plan/Part file/1321.

amendments.name: Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students pursuing Higher Education
amendments.benefit: Fee waiver subject to a maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per annum at the time of admission, consisting of Tuition, Library, Laboratory and Development Fees; other charges borne by student. Institutions are reimbursed by the Directorate.
amendments.notes: Issued by Directorate of Higher Education (Education Dept), Notification Dev/Scheme-Amend/SC/ST/173/2024/2866; the amended scheme is restated in full. Amount is per annum. Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 18-09-2025.

schemes.name: Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme, 2025
schemes.target: Meritorious young Goans pursuing PG or PhD in India or abroad
schemes.eligibility: Age not exceeding 35 years as on 1st January of the year; resident of Goa for minimum 15 years, or of Goan origin with minimum 7 years residence (birth certificate of parent/grandparent born in Goa); passed qualifying degree preferably from institution in Goa with min 60% marks and min 70% aggregate under shortlisting criteria (SSC 50%, HSSC 30%, graduation 20% weightage); bonafide student of PG/PhD programme in any discipline for the academic year; canvassing disqualifies. 40 awards per year (max 50).
schemes.benefit: Award of INR 6,00,000/- for studies in India or INR 15,00,000/- for studies abroad, via Direct Benefit Transfer from Higher Education Promotion Fund.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online in prescribed proforma to Directorate of Higher Education by notified last date with documentary evidence and bonafide certificate (and ranking/NAAC certificate if applicable); shortlisted top 100 submit CV and 500-word write-up and attend interview before Selection Committee.
schemes.valid_period: From publication in Official Gazette; scheme to be reviewed after 3 years
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 50 dated 12-03-2026. Eligibility clause cites 'Clause IX' for shortlisting criteria though they are in Clause VIII. Page also begins with the tail end (clauses 10-16) of a Directorate of Education pre-primary helpers scheme (retirement assistance Rs. 1.50 lakhs for 15+ years service, Rs. 75,000 for 10-15 years; supersedes Not. dated 07-03-2002); scheme name and start not in text, so no separate row.

schemes.name: Revised Infrastructure Loan-cum-Grant to Educational Institution
schemes.target: Government Aided schools (Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, composite)
schemes.eligibility: Government Aided Educational Institutions run by registered society/trust; minimum enrolment: Primary 160 (developed talukas)/100 (less developed), Secondary 300/200, Higher Secondary 120/80; SSCE pass percentage 70%+ (developed) or 60%+ (less developed); institution at least 5 years old from recognition; defaulted schools eligible after clearing dues with 10% interest. Developed talukas: Mormugao, Salcete, Ponda, Tiswadi, Bardez; less developed: Satari, Pernem, Bicholim, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona.
schemes.benefit: Loan-cum-grant (50% of amount is a grant; no interest if repaid on schedule) for construction/renovation of buildings, toilets, hostels, playground, security equipment incl. CCTV, land cost up to 50% of loan. Max: Primary Rs. 50 lakhs; Secondary Rs. 100 lakhs; Higher Secondary Rs. 200 lakhs; composite Primary+Secondary Rs. 150 lakhs, Secondary+Higher Secondary Rs. 300 lakhs, all three Rs. 350 lakhs. Repayment over 15 years at Rs. 278/- per lakh per month; defaults convert to loan @10% interest.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed format to Directorate of Education with managing committee resolution, land title, approved plan (TCP), NOC from Panchayat/Municipality and Health Department, undertaking on Rs. 100 stamp paper, certified estimates. Scrutiny committee recommends; disbursed through GEDC in 30%/50%/20% instalments after GSIDC inspection.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 18 dated 01-08-2013; trimmed to matching section (application format cut off at end). Max is Rs. 350 lakhs for composite Primary+Secondary+Higher Secondary schools. Panchayat/Municipality only issues NOC. Gazette index also lists Agriculture 'State Agriculture Awards' scheme and a Mines amendment to schemes for mining affected people, not included in text.

schemes.name: Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti (Bursary Scheme)
schemes.target: Students in college (general and professional) education incl. post-graduation in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Students pursuing college education in Goa incl. PG; total family income from all sources (both parents/guardian) less than Rs. five lakhs; passed Std X (diploma) / Std X, XII or Diploma (graduation) / graduation (PG) from an institution in Goa (PG relaxation for degrees from Central University, NIT, IIT, IIM etc.); institution in Goa, affiliated to Goa University or recognized by DHE/DTE or approved authority; courses max 5 years, full-time attendance; not availing similar benefits under other Goa/India schemes incl. fee concession, nor Interest Free Education Loan Scheme.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of actual 'Entitled fees' (university registration, tuition, library, lab, gymkhana, IT, practical fees and others approved) subject to maximum Rs. 40000/- per annum, including textbooks/reference books up to Rs. 5000/-; paid by DBT to student's bank account.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply (fresh/renewal) on online Bursary Portal before last date notified by GEDC; Head of institution verifies. Documents: marksheets (Std X, XII/Diploma, graduation, last qualifying exam as applicable), income certificate, admission proof and bonafide certificate, fee receipts and fee structure certified by Head of Institution. Scrutiny Committee sanctions based on merit vs parental income.
schemes.notes: Operated through Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC); funded from interest on Bursary Scheme Corpus Fund created by budgetary provisions plus donations. Gazette Series I No. 30 dated 24-10-2024. Withdraws earlier Bursary Scheme notifications of 02-12-2014 and 27-02-2014. Max is per annum.

schemes.name: Scheme for Engaging Services of Retired Resourceful Teachers
schemes.target: Retired college/university teachers engaged by Government departments/bodies
schemes.eligibility: Scheme limited to Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Societies, Corporations, other Government Institutions and PSUs. Retired teacher must have served on regular basis minimum 10 years in an educational institution (UG/PG level); resident of Goa for minimum 15 years (or Goan origin with minimum 5 years service in Goa with residence in Goa); possess Ph.D degree; tenure up to three years from date of retirement/superannuation or completion of approved project, whichever is earlier.
schemes.benefit: Maximum monthly remuneration by designation at retirement: Senior Professor Rs. 1,40,000/-; Professor Rs. 1,30,000/-; Associate Professor Rs. 1,20,000/-; Assistant Professor Rs. 80,000/-. 10% deduction if Government accommodation retained. Paid by DHE.
schemes.how_to_apply: Intending Department/Institution applies to Directorate of Higher Education in prescribed format with detailed project report and ~500-word justification; Selection Committee chaired by Director of Higher Education recommends; DHE appoints on contract after Government approval.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Gazette; engagement up to three years
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is a monthly figure (Rs. 1,40,000 per month for Senior Professor). Gazette Series I No. 28 dated 08-10-2020.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Science Education - Component (A) Catch Them Young
schemes.target: B.Sc. students who scored 75%+ in Std. XII
schemes.eligibility: Score 75% and above at Std. XII and seeking admission to B.Sc. courses (grant-in-aid or self-financing); residence: studied in Goa continuously for 10 years (school certificates, or Mamlatdar residence certificate for any break); renewal requires minimum 60% at First/Second Year B.Sc. passed in one and same sitting.
schemes.benefit: Scholarship of Rs. 2,000 per month for maximum of thirty months till completion of course; plus book/equipment grant to a maximum of Rs. 5,000/- per year subject to fee receipt and expenditure certificates.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application/renewal form submitted to the College Principal with proof of residence (fresh applications), marksheet of qualifying exam, Mandate Form, proof of purchase of books/equipment; sanctioned by Directorate of Higher Education on Principal's recommendation.
schemes.notes: Monthly scholarship is Rs. 2,000 per month; max_benefit_inr gives the largest single stated amount (Rs. 5,000 per year book grant). Amended scheme notified 9/328/2016/SPSE/DHE, Gazette Series I No. 50 dated 10-03-2016. Components B, C, D approved by Evaluation Committee chaired by Chairman of State Innovation Council.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Science Education - Component (B) Support for patents
schemes.target: Students and teachers filing patents
schemes.eligibility: Any student or teacher who files a patent; must produce valid supporting documents.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 10,000/- on filing a patent; Rs. 40,000/- if the patent is granted; Rs. 1.00 lakh incentive if converted into commercial venture.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply with valid supporting documents; approved by Evaluation Committee (Member Secretary: Director of Higher Education).
schemes.notes: Amended scheme notified 9/328/2016/SPSE/DHE, Gazette Series I No. 50 dated 10-03-2016. Components B, C, D approved by Evaluation Committee chaired by Chairman of State Innovation Council.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Science Education - Component (C) Support for exhibition of research based projects
schemes.target: Recognized institutions holding all-Goa research exhibitions
schemes.eligibility: Any recognized institution planning an all Goa Exhibition of research based projects; two such exhibitions sanctioned in any given year.
schemes.benefit: Maximum grant of Rs. 1.00 lakh towards prizes and organization of exhibition.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to the Directorate of Higher Education latest by 15th of July every year; approved by Evaluation Committee.
schemes.notes: Amended scheme notified 9/328/2016/SPSE/DHE, Gazette Series I No. 50 dated 10-03-2016. Components B, C, D approved by Evaluation Committee chaired by Chairman of State Innovation Council.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Science Education - Component (D) Support for project proposals
schemes.target: College teachers doing S&T research relevant to Goa
schemes.eligibility: College teacher; full time, regular, permanent; minimum Ph.D. in relevant area; research project in Science and Technology applicable to Goa, useful to economic development and welfare of people of Goa; fresh project not having availed assistance from State Government, GoI or bodies like UGC, AICTE, DST; completed within maximum two years.
schemes.benefit: Research grant released in phased manner; maximum Rs. 5.00 lakhs.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit project proposal to Directorate of Higher Education latest by 30th July every year; Evaluation Committee approves; audited statement of accounts certified by Head of Institution at end.
schemes.notes: Amended scheme notified 9/328/2016/SPSE/DHE, Gazette Series I No. 50 dated 10-03-2016. Components B, C, D approved by Evaluation Committee chaired by Chairman of State Innovation Council.

schemes.name: Scheme for Soft Loan to the Grant-in-Aid/Non-Grant-in-Aid Institutions for Maintenance and Upgradation of Infrastructure Facilities
schemes.target: Aided/non-aided institutions of higher learning in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Aided/non-aided institutions of higher learning incl. professional courses; run by society registered under Societies Registration Act; affiliated to Goa University or recognized by AICTE/MCI/ACI/DCI or other statutory body; in operation at least 10 years (older given priority); minimum 300 students on campus; average passing percentage not below 60% in last three of five years. Preference to less developed talukas (Canacona, Pernem, Satari, Sanquelim, Quepem, Bicholim, Sanguem).
schemes.benefit: Soft loan up to Rupees one hundred lakhs at 6% per annum interest, repayable over 10 years in monthly instalments (12% on default), for new buildings/extension/renovation (not land or consumables); released 50%/40%/10%.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Directorate of Higher Education in Appendix 'A' with approved plan and cost estimate certified by Registered Engineer and CA, latest audited accounts, and land ownership documents (sale deed/long lease).
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 40 dated 30-12-2010. Benefit is an interest-bearing loan.

schemes.name: Scheme to provide Financial Support for Conducting Workshops, Seminars, Conference, Training Programmes and Short Term Courses for Quality Improvement
schemes.target: Government Colleges/Institutions in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Available to the Government Colleges of the State to conduct seminars, workshops, conference, training programs and short term courses for the benefit of its teachers and students in academic and co-curricular areas.
schemes.benefit: Maximum financial support per programme: Seminars/Conferences Rs. 200000/- (State level), Rs. 500000/- (National level), Rs. 10,00000/- (International level); Workshop & Training Programme maximum Rs. 300000/-; Short Term Courses maximum Rs. 300000/-. Expert committee decides actual quantum; assistance from other sources leads to proportionate restriction.
schemes.how_to_apply: College submits proposal at least three months before the programme to the Directorate of Higher Education with theme/objectives, participants/resource persons, detailed plan, estimated expenditure signed by Convener and Principal; expert committee chaired by Director of Higher Education considers; Secretary (Higher Education) gives approval. Utilization certificate and accounts within two months of event.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette up to March, 2023
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 30 dated 25-10-2018. Benefit is per programme to the institution, not an individual.

schemes.name: State Teacher Awards for Excellence in Higher Education Scheme-2018
schemes.target: College/University teachers in Goa (higher education)
schemes.eligibility: Full time regular/permanent teachers & principals of Government/aided degree colleges under DHE and all academic faculty of Goa University; 15 years or more of continuous service as on 30th June of the academic year; outstanding track record in teaching, evaluation, mentoring, community engagement, administration, research etc.; indisputable integrity and reputation; vital role in progress of institution and catchment society; no vigilance case pending; no canvassing (disqualifies).
schemes.benefit: Every year four outstanding College/University Teachers get State Teacher Award for Excellence: cash prize of Rs. 3,00,000/- each and citation; no extension in service. Bestowed at State Level function by DHE.
schemes.how_to_apply: Teacher applies (or any institution/individual nominates) in prescribed proforma with documentary evidence, updated CV and ~1000-word write-up; delivered in sealed envelope to Directorate of Higher Education by last date notified every year; numbered self-attested supporting documents. Selection by committee chaired by an academician.
schemes.valid_period: From 2018-19 (from date of notification in Official Gazette)
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 26 dated 27-09-2018; includes separate 'Pattern of Assistance' notification (same number) with same terms. Text inconsistently says committee selects 'three Teachers' in clause 6(7) vs four awards elsewhere. Budget head 2202 under Demand No. 35.

schemes.name: The Goa Financial Assistance towards fees for various courses under Higher and Technical Education Scheme, 2014 (Bursary Scheme)
schemes.target: Graduate and post-graduate students in Goa from low-income families
schemes.eligibility: Students pursuing college (higher and professional) education in Goa incl. PG; annual income of parent(s)/guardian together less than Rs. three lakhs; completed Std. X and XII (and graduation for PG) from an institution in Goa (graduation requirement relaxed for Central University, NIIT, IIT, IIM etc.); institution affiliated to Goa University and recognized by DHE/DTE (or GoI institution in Goa); total course fees not exceeding Rs. 60,000/- per annum; not availing similar benefits under any other Government of Goa scheme (incl. Interest Free Loan scheme). Selection on merit vis-a-vis parental income.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of fees paid, limited to fees and other charges paid to the College/Institution; maximum grant restricted to Rs. 40,000/- per annum; paid by Direct Benefit Transfer to student's bank account. Voluntary repayment encouraged once employed.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed format to Head of institution within fifteen days of commencement of academic year with X/XII (and graduation) certificates and marksheets, income proof (Form 16 / ITR / income certificate), proof of admission and bonafide certificate, fee receipts; institution forwards consolidated list to Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC) within 45 days; Fund Management Committee sanctions.
schemes.valid_period: From Academic Year 2014-15
schemes.notes: Per-annum figure. Operated through GEDC; funded from interest on Bursary Scheme Corpus Fund (initial Rs. two crores). Students with fees above Rs. 60,000 may approach GEDC Interest Free Loan scheme.

schemes.name: The Goa Value Added Tax based subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme, 2015
schemes.target: Owners of registered fishing vessels in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Registered fishing vessel under Goa, Daman and Diu Marine Fishing Regulation Act, 1980 (or M.S. Act); valid net licence and fishing licence for the year; not a defaulter of Department of Fisheries; not a violator of the Act/Rules; H.S.D. Oil procured from outlet of registered Fisheries Co-operative Society or Government-approved outlet; maximum two fishing vessels per owner.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of an amount equivalent to actual VAT paid on H.S.D. Oil consumed for fishing, on limited quota: 6 cylinder & above max 30000 lts per financial year; 4 cylinder max 20000 lts; 3 cylinder & below max 15000 lts (or actual consumption if less). Total quota 20,000 K.L. per financial year for entire industry. Paid quarterly or half-yearly via Fishermen's Co-operative Society or directly.
schemes.how_to_apply: Owner applies to Director of Fisheries in prescribed Application Form through Fisheries Co-operative Society or individually; pass book maintained with Society.
schemes.valid_period: With effect from 1st April, 2015
schemes.notes: Department is actually Directorate of Fisheries (Not. 1/10/2005-FSH), published in same gazette (Series I No. 50, 10-03-2016) as the Science Education scheme; header department kept. Text cut after clause 7(13); signing date not in extracted text.

schemes.name: The Mukhyamantri Samupadeshan Yojana
schemes.target: Students of Government and Government Aided Secondary and Higher Secondary institutions (via contract counsellors and supervisors)
schemes.eligibility: Coverage: students in Govt and Govt-aided Secondary/Higher Secondary institutions in Goa. Counsellors (150 posts, 11-month contract): Master's in Clinical/Counselling/Wellness/Child Psychology or MSW (medical & psychiatric), or graduation in psychology/social work/home science (HR) plus Diploma in Guidance and Counselling; min 6 months' experience with adolescents; knowledge of Konkani; 15 years' residence certificate from Goa; age limit 45 years. Supervisors (25 posts): relevant Master's, min 2 yrs experience with adolescents, training experience, Konkani, 15 years' residence; age limit 45. Also 2 Clerk cum DEOs and unpaid volunteers.
schemes.benefit: Free school counselling services for students (stress, family issues, depression, anxiety, abuse, suicidal thoughts, trauma etc.). Remuneration: Supervisors Rs 35,000/- per month; Counsellors Rs 30,000/- per month; Clerk cum DEO per Government guidelines; GEDC reimbursed 5% overhead. Budget provision Rs 500.00 lakh.
schemes.how_to_apply: Counsellors/Supervisors selected by GEDC Counselling Cell via skill test and 100-mark written test; implemented through GEDC with Directorate of Education as administrative department.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 24-07-2025; trimmed: only the matching section is included. Replaces the 'Scheme for providing counselling to the students in the Government and Government Aided Institutions (Secondary and Higher Secondary)' (2013, gazetted 23-03-2017). Rupee amounts are staff salaries, not beneficiary benefits, so max_benefit_inr left null. Same issue contains the tail of 'Gopal Ratna Award Scheme (Amended 2025)' (AHVS, Not. dated 15-Jul-2025) but its benefit/eligibility section was cut off, so no row made.

schemes.name: Capital Subsidy Scheme, 2017
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Micro and small manufacturing units in Goa (new or substantially expanded after 1-10-2017)
schemes.eligibility: Micro and small scale manufacturing units in white, green and orange category; units commencing commercial production after 1-10-2017, or carrying out substantial expansion after 1-10-2017 (as defined in Umbrella Scheme). Units that availed CMRY or any GoI/Goa scheme granting capital subsidy ineligible; units taking/having taken benefit under IT Investment Policy of Dept of IT Goa ineligible; not applicable if similar benefit claimed under other Goa scheme. Governed by Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella Scheme).
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy of 30% of cost of capital: micro units ceiling Rs. 10 lakh (subsidy on building/office restricted to Rs. 5 lakh); small units ceiling Rs. 20 lakh (building/office restricted to Rs. 10 lakh). Cost of capital includes plant and machinery, ICT equipment to operate machinery, office and factory premises; excludes land, pre-operative expenses, office equipment, office ICT, furniture, ERP software. Disbursed in two equal installments (50% after Task Force Committee recommendation; 50% after two years of commercial production). Subject to budgetary allocation.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply within one year of commencement of commercial production in specified proforma to DITC with: self-attested Umbrella Scheme registration; self-declaration; invoices and receipts; CA certificate of investment; CA certificate of no Dept of IT incentive; CA certificate of no similar claim. Second installment: separate application after two years with audited balance sheets, income tax returns and GST/ROC returns of the two years.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 18 dated 02-08-2018, Notification 1/18/2017-IND/268. Two-column layout interleaved with Mopa Airport Bill and recruitment rules. The gazette index also lists 'Amendment of Kamdhenu Scheme (Sudharit)' (Animal Husbandry) but its text is not included in the trimmed document.
