schemes.name: Craft & Gear (Unit: boats of appropriate sizes incl. net, fish & ice holding boxes) Scheme
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Traditional fishermen buying canoe, gill net and insulated fish/ice boxes
schemes.eligibility: (Partly cut) Applicant shall produce GST bill from authorized dealer towards purchase/construction of new canoe, gill net and accessories and insulated fish and ice holding box; shall not be fishing trawler owner or defaulter of Department. Canoe registered with Captain of Ports and nets with Directorate of Fisheries; not to sell, mortgage or transfer purchased items for five years.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance of 40% of unit cost limited to Rs. 40,000/- for General Category; 60% of unit cost limited to Rs. 60,000/- for SC, ST, Women and their Co-operative (unit cost Rs. 1,00,000; subsidy shared Central 60% / State 40%, i.e. Rs. 24,000/16,000 General and Rs. 36,000/24,000 SC/ST/Women). Disbursed to applicant's bank account.
schemes.how_to_apply: (Application clause cut) Claim subsidy with GST bill from authorized dealer to Directorate of Fisheries.
schemes.notes: Directorate of Fisheries scheme (Not. DF/GB/SCHEME CRAFT AND GEAR/CSS/2017-18) in same gazette (Series I No. 1, 05-04-2018) as Umbrella Scheme; header department kept. Trimmed: start of scheme (title, intro, part of eligibility) cut. Budget head 2405 Blue Revolution Scheme. SC/ST table labels beneficiary contribution as Rs. 40,000 and repeats 'General Category' (likely typo). Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana scheme in same gazette not included in extracted text.

schemes.name: Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Manufacturing enterprises and hinterland eco-tourism projects employing Goan manpower
schemes.eligibility: Micro, Small, Medium and Large manufacturing industries listed under White, Green and Orange category; projects of Hinterland Eco tourism in lesser developed talukas registered with/recognised by Dept of Tourism/Goa-IPB/TCP/PDA/Eco Sensitive Zone Authority. Must engage minimum 60% Goan manpower on regular employment (on payroll continuously during claim year). 'Goan' = born in Goa, or holding 10 years Residence Certificate from Mamlatdar, or other document showing residence in Goa issued prior to 10 years. Goan employees up to 60 years of age with gross salary above Rs. 8,000/- per month counted for subsidy. Relatives under s.56 Income Tax Act not counted. Units that availed CMRY or any other employment generation scheme of GoI/Goa ineligible; units taking benefits under any Dept of IT Goa policy ineligible; not applicable if similar benefit claimed under other Goa schemes. Registration under Umbrella Scheme required.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of wages of Goan employees pro-rata to Goan employment share (60% Goan = 60% benefit, rising linearly to 100% benefit at 80% Goan and above; below 60% no benefit). MSME and eco-tourism: wages restricted to 50%, reimbursement capped at Rs. 7,000/- per Goan employee per month, total not exceeding Rs. 25.00 lakh per annum. Large enterprises: wages restricted to 25%, Rs. 7,000/- per Goan employee per month, total not exceeding Rs. 50.00 lakh per annum. Subsidy period not exceeding seven years. Subject to budgetary allocation.
schemes.how_to_apply: Yearly claim to DITC in specified proforma as per Umbrella Scheme timeline with: Umbrella registration copy; self-declaration/affidavit; CA-certified payroll; statement of Goan employees and salaries; proof employees are Goans; CA certificate of salaries paid to Goans; audited balance sheet; GST returns; eco-tourism registration certificate (if applicable); CA certificates of no Dept of IT claim and no similar Goa claim; ESI/PF returns; unit-wise salary CA certificate. Delayed claim allowed in following year (not for last claim).
schemes.valid_period: 01-10-2017 to 30-09-2022 (claims can be disbursed beyond if at least one claim filed during validity)
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 26-07-2018, Notification 3/15/2017-IND/256. Max benefit is per annum (Rs. 50 lakh/yr for large enterprises; Rs. 25 lakh/yr for MSME). Two-column text layout interleaved; trimmed.

schemes.name: Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme, 2017
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Goa-based industrial units, hospitals and educational institutions obtaining quality certification or IPR
schemes.eligibility: Industrial units in all categories, hospitals and educational institutions recognised by Govt of Goa and operating in Goa, which have obtained certification from ISI, ISO or other recognised national/international certification for quality standards and/or IPRs accepted by the Task Force Committee. Statutory certifications obtained under law are not eligible. Units that availed similar Central reimbursement eligible only for balance amount. Not applicable if benefit claimed under any other Govt of Goa scheme; units taking/having taken any benefit under any Dept of Information Technology (Goa) policy are ineligible. Governed by Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella Scheme); registration under Umbrella Scheme required.
schemes.benefit: Certification: reimbursement of 100% of actual expenditure per certification (excluding lodging/boarding, refreshment, travel), subject to combined ceiling of Rs. 8.00 lakh for entire Scheme period. IPR: reimbursement of 50% of professional fees for registration and registry fees, subject to maximum ceiling of Rs. 15.00 lakh for entire Scheme period. Subject to budgetary allocation.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in specified proforma to Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce (Udyog Bhavan, Panaji) with: self-attested copy of Umbrella Scheme registration; self-declaration/affidavit; proof of registration and functioning status; documents of IPR/certification; bills and receipts; CA certificate of actual expenditure (original); CA certificate of no claim from Dept of IT; CA certificate of no similar claim under other Goa schemes; CA certificate that certification is not statutory; CA certificate of Central benefits availed; partnership deed/MoA/AoA.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 21 dated 23-08-2018 (Notification 3/16/2017-IND/283; index lists 3/19/2017-IND/283). Rs. 8 lakh (certification) and Rs. 15 lakh (IPR) are separate ceilings. Document is a multi-scheme gazette trimmed to this section; other target schemes listed in index (Incentives to Encourage Purchases from Local Suppliers, Training Prospective Employees, Green Investment, Interest Subsidy, IT schemes) are not included or only partially included (Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017 text cut off after definitions).

schemes.name: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme, 2008
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Traditional Goan clay idol makers/artisans registered with GHRSSIDC
schemes.eligibility: Traditional clay idol makers/artisans (Goan artisans) registered with GHRSSIDC, having own workshop for making clay idols (Ganesh, Durga, Saraswati, Mother Mary etc.). Only clay idols manufactured in Goa, minimum 1 ft height, used for religious festivals (Ganesh Chaturthi, Christmas etc.) and actually sold to the public. Unsold, decorative/aesthetic, imported or traded idols excluded. Maximum 150 idols per artisan per year. First come first served, subject to funds.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of Rs. 100/- per idol (minimum 1 ft height), up to 150 idols per artisan per year; maximum subsidy per beneficiary shall not exceed Rs. 15000/-. Paid by cheque to registered artisan.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed proforma (Proforma A, Re. 1/- per form) to the Managing Director, GHRSSIDC Ltd., Panaji, with undertaking that idols were produced by applicant; register as clay idol making unit (Proforma C); maintain sales register (Proforma B) and serially numbered triplicate bill books, submitting original bills with claim. GHRSSIDC officials physically count idols at the unit.
schemes.valid_period: Comes into force at once (no expiry stated)
schemes.later_amendments: 21-12-2010 – e-Goa (Subsidy to clay Idol makes) Scheme, 2008
schemes.notes: OCR text, Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 24-07-2008, Notification 8/11/2007-IND. Implemented through Goa Handicrafts, Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation (GHRSSIDC); Govt places Rs. 50.00 lakhs grant-in-aid with GHRSSIDC; GHRSSIDC gets 10% service charge. Proforma pages partly garbled (Devanagari OCR noise).

schemes.name: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme, 2015
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Self-employed beneficiaries of CMRY/VKRY and Share Capital schemes with EDC loans
schemes.eligibility: (Partly cut) Activities covered under the Red Category and those dealing in alcohol and tobacco not eligible; subsidy not paid on defaulted EMIs; pre-closure of loan within one year of 1st disbursement reverses subsidy; CMRY/VKRY beneficiaries need not apply separately.
schemes.benefit: Under Revised CMRY Scheme: an amount equal to 20% of the EMIs (approx. 25% of principal component of EMIs) paid within due date on non-overdue outstanding EMIs, credited to principal account on date of payment; also applicable to capital investment via additional loan. (Other parts of benefit clause cut.) Penal interest 2% p.a. on defaulted EDC term loan EMIs and 8% p.a. on defaulted Share Capital Assistance EMIs.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed proforma available with Economic Development Corporation, Panaji, addressed to the Managing Director, submitted at EDC House, Panaji; CMRY/VKRY beneficiaries need not apply separately. Task Force Committee under CMRY/VKRY scrutinizes and sanctions; DITC places funds with EDC.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: extracted text starts mid-scheme (clauses 1-7(a) incl. title clause, eligibility and period missing); details may be on earlier pages. Not. 3/40/2003-IND (Pt. II), Gazette Series I No. 30 dated 23-10-2015. Budget head 2851, Demand No. 19.

schemes.name: Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme (GTEGP) Scheme, 2017
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Unemployed members of notified Scheduled Tribe communities (Gauda, Kunbi, Velip) starting enterprises
schemes.eligibility: Individual who has studied up to 4th Std. and above (relaxable in deserving cases); age 18 to 45 years; member of Tribal Community notified by Government of Goa; must be unemployed (declaration 'I am presently unemployed'). If availed/applied for similar benefit under any other Goa/GoI scheme, eligible only for balance subsidy. Must undergo Entrepreneurship Development Programme within 6 months of sanction if not already done. Farming activities, tobacco products and red category (text cut off) appear excluded.
schemes.benefit: Loan plus subsidy via EDC Ltd: Micro and Small Manufacturing Enterprises - maximum loan Rs. 25 lakhs with 40% subsidy on 95% of total sanctioned loan amount; Service Enterprises (taxi, rickshaw, saloon, workshops etc.) - loan up to Rs. 15 lakhs with 40% subsidy on 95% of sanctioned loan; Trading Enterprises - loan up to Rs. 15 lakhs with 40% subsidy on 95% of sanctioned loan. EDC sanctions 95% of project cost; 5% owner's contribution. Interest 2% p.a. fixed; repayable in 60 to 120 monthly installments after 3-6 month moratorium.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to EDC Ltd. with caste certificate, birth certificate, domicile certificate and other documents required by EDC; application form and checklist available on EDC website. Guarantor requirements: loans above Rs. 2 lakh up to Rs. 6 lakh need third-party guarantor(s); above Rs. 6 lakh need notarized ownership documents of unencumbered immovable property of guarantor. Pre-entrepreneurship counselling available.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 33 dated 15-11-2018, Notification 3/12/2017-IND/439; signing date not captured (text trimmed, ends mid clause 21). Implementing agency EDC Ltd. Rs. 25 lakh is the loan cap (subsidy is 40% of 95% of loan; not computed). Units may be in community industrial shed built by Panchayat or Co-operative Society. Two-column layout interleaved with unrelated Fisheries/GAD orders.

schemes.name: Preferential Purchase Incentives for Micro and Small Enterprises Scheme, 2008
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Micro and Small Enterprises registered with DITC Goa
schemes.eligibility: Micro and Small Scale Enterprises with turnover not exceeding Rs. 6 crores per annum for the last preceding 3 financial years, permanently registered or acknowledged with Entrepreneurs Memorandum II by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce. Must match quality standard required by the State Government Department.
schemes.benefit: Preference in tenders/purchases by Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Corporations and Semi-Government Departments: MSEs allowed to match the lowest tender price if their quoted price is within 15% of lowest price quoted by non-MSEs (lowest MSE preferred if several); pro-rata preference for contractual tenders for installation/commissioning; applies to computer hardware/electronics except Education Department purchases; tender documents at max Rs. 200/-; earnest money max Rs. 500/-; no other security deposit; payment priority within 60 days of delivery/completion, else interest at 0.75% per month payable by the Department.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette up to 31-03-2011

schemes.name: Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme, 2008
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Local youths (preferably of Goan origin) starting income-generating/self-employment activities
schemes.eligibility: Individuals or groups of individuals; preference to those born and resident 15 years in Goa, others must be resident of Goa at least 15 years prior to application and have passed graduation/XII/X/schooling from Goa (all group members must satisfy). Below 40 years of age (relaxable by 5 years for women, disabled, SC/ST, OBC; age not applicable for women SHGs/disabled persons and taxi/motorcycle/rickshaw replacement; CMRY relaxations apply automatically). Minimum VIIth passed (relaxable by Director). Income of applicant with spouse not exceeding Rs. 80,000/- per annum. Not available if subsidy of more than 15% of project cost availed under any other Scheme or debarred by another scheme; those covered under Kamdhenu Scheme excluded except dairy/chilling unit. Excludes Red category activities, tobacco and liquor. Priority to women entrepreneurs (30% of outlay); CMRY beneficiaries automatically covered; covers balance 75% for black and yellow taxi/motorcycle/rickshaw subsidy scheme beneficiaries.
schemes.benefit: Interest-free capital contribution of Rs. 2 lakhs per individual, limited to 50% of total project cost; up to Rs. 3 lakhs per individual for those with professional qualification/degree/diploma in Engineering/I.T.I./Vocational XII/recognized certificate course (activity linked to qualification), within 50% of project cost; group maximum Rs. 10 lakhs. Repayable in equal monthly installments within 10 years (moratorium up to one year). Insurance cover writes off dues on death or permanent disability.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed proforma (form cost Rs. 25/-, processing fee Rs. 200/- non-refundable) with documents to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Udyog Bhavan, Panaji; CMRY-eligible applicants apply in combined form at Economic Development Corporation. Security: self guarantee plus one guarantor owning property in Goa. Insurance premium Rs. 200/- per lakh. Task Force Committee chaired by General Manager (DIC) scrutinizes and recommends.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette up to 31st March, 2011

schemes.eligibility: Valid registration with Department of Women & Child Development (2-year registration requirement deleted); operating successfully for members in Goa; submit project report with activities and prospective beneficiaries; minimum 20 members for training/orientation.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 20000/- annual grant-in-aid for successful functioning; Rs. 5000/- per course for raw materials/self-employment activity training (groups with at least 20 members); resource persons via CDPOs with Rs. 5000/- fixed honorarium per course to master trainer; actual TA for trainers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through CDPO of concerned block / Mukhya Sevika in Annexure-I with registration certificate, statement of accounts, project report, beneficiary list (Annexure-II), bank passbook copy, utilization certificate of previous year (GFR-19(A)).
schemes.notes: Text ends mid-terms and conditions (trimmed).

schemes.name: Grants to local bodies for Village/Municipal Child Committees (scheme name not in extracted text)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Village Panchayats and Municipalities that have set up Child Committees
schemes.eligibility: Local body must have established a Village or Municipal Child Committee under Rule 7 of The Goa Children's Homes Rules, 2004; Committee met at least once in last three months before application; local body provides space for sittings; Committee functioning satisfactorily.
schemes.benefit: Annual financial grant of Rs 10,000/- towards administrative expenses of the Committee, released in single installment within three months by electronic transfer to the local body; additionally an award of Rs.10,000/- each to the best performing Child Committee in each taluka (from 2015-16).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to Director, Women and Child Development: Village Panchayat - signed by Secretary with Panchayat resolution and proposal recommended by BDO; Municipality - signed by Chief Executive with resolution, submitted directly. Within six months from commencement of financial year.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: scheme title and opening clauses are on omitted part (text starts mid-eligibility). Selection Committee chaired by Secretary (WCD).

schemes.name: Hub for Empowerment of Women (HEW)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Women
schemes.benefit: Inter-sectoral convergence (NHEW/SHEW/DHEW): guiding, linking and hand-holding women to schemes for healthcare, education, career/vocational training, financial inclusion, entrepreneurship, social security, digital literacy.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut.

schemes.name: Laadli Laxmi Scheme
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Girls of Goa (married applicants in specified age group)
schemes.eligibility: (A) Girl born in Goa; resident of Goa for last fifteen years; at least one parent born in Goa and resident for last fifteen years, or one parent residing in Goa for last twenty-five years; parental income not exceeding Rs. 3.00 lakhs per annum. (B) Girl born outside Goa eligible if resident of Goa for last fifteen years, educated in Goa for minimum 7 years (continuous), and same parental conditions and income limit. Beneficiaries shall be married applicants in an age group (cut off in text).
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1.00 lakh financial assistance. At 18 years: bank fixed deposit jointly in name of Director of Women and Child Development and the girl; may be withdrawn after age 21 for business/profession or further studies. On marriage: cash through the Bank.
schemes.how_to_apply: Directorate of Women & Child Development; form available at Rs. 100/-.
schemes.valid_period: Launched 06/07/2012
schemes.later_amendments: 17-04-2018 – Amendment to Vidya Laxmi (clause 2); 2022-04-05 – Vidya Laxmi
schemes.notes: Trimmed: benefit amount and age group are on omitted part of document. Flagship State scheme; not to be construed as encouragement of dowry.

schemes.name: Mission Vatsalya
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Children in need of care and protection, children in conflict with law and vulnerable children
schemes.eligibility: Child in need of care and protection under JJ Act 2015, child in conflict with law, vulnerable children (at-risk/migrant/extremely poor families, HIV/AIDS affected, orphans, drug abusers, beggars, sexually exploited, children of prisoners, street and working children).
schemes.benefit: Institutional care: Rs.3000 per child per month to registered eligible Child Care Institutions. Sponsorship: Rs.4,000 per child per month. Foster care: Rs.4,000 per child per month to foster parents. Also funds service delivery structures (DCPU, State Child Protection Society, SARA) in 60:40 Central:State ratio and allowances for CWC and JJB.
schemes.how_to_apply: Directorate of Women & Child Development, Panaji-Goa.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut. max_benefit is per child per month. 60:40 ratio stated for service delivery structures.

schemes.name: Palna (Anganwadi cum Creche)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Children 6 months to 6 years; all mothers irrespective of employment
schemes.benefit: Day-care incl. feeding and sleeping, early stimulation, pre-school education, growth monitoring, health check-ups and immunization; 11 Anganwadi cum creches operational; max 25 children per creche.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Pregnant women and lactating mothers from socially and economically disadvantaged sections
schemes.eligibility: First two living children provided second child is a girl; women who are SC/ST, 40%+ disabled, BPL ration card holders, PMJAY beneficiaries, E-shram card holders, women farmers under Kisan Samman Nidhi, MGNREGA job card holders, net family income less than Rs. 8 lakh per annum, pregnant/lactating AWWs/AWHs, NFSA ration card holders, or other categories prescribed by Centre. Excluded: those in regular employment with Central/State Govt/PSU or receiving similar benefit under law. Registration during pregnancy mandatory for second child benefit; apply not later than 570 days from pregnancy.
schemes.benefit: First child: Rs. 5000/- in two installments (Rs 3000/- on registration of pregnancy and at least one ANC within 6 months of LMP; Rs 2000/- on birth registration and first cycle of BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis-B). Second child (girl): Rs. 6000/- in one installment after birth. DBT to bank/post office account.
schemes.how_to_apply: At Anganwadi Centre/approved health facilities.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut. In force in Goa w.e.f. 1st January 2017 under Section 4 of NFSA 2013.

schemes.name: Sakhi Niwas (Working Women Hostel)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Working women (single, widowed, divorced, separated, or married with family not in same city)
schemes.eligibility: Working women whose immediate family does not reside in same city/area; preference to disadvantaged sections and women with physical disabilities; women under job training (max one year, max 30% of capacity); gross income not exceeding Rs. 50,000/- per month in metropolitan cities and Rs 35,000/- per month elsewhere (relaxable by DM); must vacate within six months of exceeding ceiling.
schemes.benefit: Safe and affordable hostel accommodation with day care for children where possible; assistance to State Govt agencies (Women Development Corporations etc.) for construction/expansion/rented hostel buildings.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut.

schemes.name: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Children 0-6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers
schemes.benefit: Services through 1262 Anganwadi Centres: immunization, health check-up, referral, supplementary nutrition, nutrition & health education, non-formal pre-school education; fortified rice to pregnant women, lactating mothers and children 6 months-3 years (wheat based nutrition program); menu items incl. kesari rawa (shira), groundnut, til chikki.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Women and Child Development Block offices in 12 talukas / Anganwadi Centres.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut. Description partly omitted.

schemes.name: Shakti Sadan
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Women in distress including trafficked, destitute and domestic violence victims, and accompanying children
schemes.eligibility: Women needing long-term stay (after OSC), trafficking victims, distressed/destitute women; stay up to 3 years (extendable by DM); women above 55 up to 5 years; accompanying unmarried girls of any age and boys up to 12 years.
schemes.benefit: Shelter with basic necessities (food, clothing, personal items), legal services via DLSA, and other services (text cut).
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut. Text cut mid-description of services.

schemes.name: Universalization of Child Helpline 1098 (CHL)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Children in distress
schemes.benefit: 24-hour toll-free helpline 1098, emergency/non-emergency intervention, rescue and referral; integrated with ERSS emergency number 112.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut. Service scheme; no cash benefit.

schemes.name: Universalization of Women Helpline 181 (WHL)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Women and Child Development
schemes.target: Women affected by violence
schemes.benefit: Toll-free 24-hour helpline, crisis/non-crisis referral to police, hospitals, DLSA, Protection Officer, OSC; information on schemes; integrated with ERSS 112 from August 2023.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: part of document omitted (text jumps from Poshan 2.0 description to its menu); later content after Shakti Sadan cut.

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY - 2023) Scheme
schemes.target: Goan youth for self-employment (new and expansion units)
schemes.eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years (relaxable by 5 years for widow, disabled, SC, ST, OBC); repayment not beyond age 60; VIIIth passed (relaxable), preference to technical/professional qualifications; no income ceiling; permanent resident of the area for at least 15 years (or married to person of Goan origin resident 15 years and settled in Goa minimum one year); not a defaulter to any bank/FI/cooperative bank; not already assisted under other subsidy linked schemes (PMRY, REGP, PMEGP, CMEGP etc.); existing units that availed subsidy not eligible; one CMRY loan per family; projects must have fixed assets. Activities: all economically viable/legal except alcohol & tobacco, incl. CSC-VLE, start-ups, homestay/B&B, civil/electrical contractors (fixed assets only).
schemes.benefit: Loan: project cost maximum Rs. 25.00 Lakhs (professional degree/diploma/ITI or special training) or Rs. 20.00 Lakhs (others). Funding: DITC share capital 50% (General men, Women/OBC/Disabled) or 80% (SC/ST); EDC term loan 40% (General men), 45% (Women/OBC/Disabled), 15% (SC/ST); promoter contribution 10%/5%/5%. Interest 8% p.a.; interest rebate 75% (@ 6% p.a.) of EDC term loan and DITC share capital credited as subsidy for regular EMI payers with operational unit. Moratorium max one year; repayment 5 years (vehicle), 5-7 years (others).
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form (Rs.100/-) with project details and documents to EDC Ltd.; processing fee Rs.500/- (loans up to Rs.5 lakh) or Rs.5,000/- (above Rs.5 lakh) plus GST, Rs.200/- for SC/ST; project report for Rs.10 lakh or more; compulsory entrepreneurship training up to 3 days before disbursement; sanction by Task Force Committee.
schemes.later_amendments: 04-01-2021 – Chief Minister's Rozgar Yojana (CMRY) - amendment of clause (1)(e) Defaulter/Non Eligibility; 04-01-2021 – Chief Minister's Rozgar Yojana (CMRY)
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the maximum project cost (loan + share capital), not a grant; subsidy is interest rebate. Collateral rules by loan size (up to Rs 2 lakh, 2-6 lakh, above 6 lakh). Working capital restricted to 40% of project cost; land not covered.

schemes.name: Composite Loan Scheme for EDC Clients with Good Track Record
schemes.target: Past/existing EDC clients (industrial, tourism, service, commercial units) with good repayment record
schemes.eligibility: Units in industrial, tourism related, service and commercial activities in Goa; promoter(s) with 15% or more equity stake having more than 5 years business association with EDC and good repayment record for minimum last three years; satisfactory repayment history with Corporation/banks/FIs and standard loan account for past two years (for takeover); in operation minimum five years and in cash profit for previous two financial years; mortgaged property not leased/rented; agree to mortgage immovable property and hypothecate movable assets.
schemes.benefit: Composite term loan against fixed assets and working capital term loan for acquisition of fixed/current assets (expansion, modernization, diversification, renovation) and takeover of standard loans of other banks/FIs. Maximum loan: proprietary concerns Rs 800.00 lakh; partnership firms Rs 1000.00 lakh; corporate bodies/LLP Rs 2500.00 lakh; working capital max 40% of these; up to 75% of value of existing immovable properties. Interest (w.e.f. 01.07.2021): up to 50 L 9.50% p.a. fixed; 50-100 L 9.50%-11.50%; above 100 L 9.50%-12.50% based on credit rating. Repayment within 8 years incl. moratorium up to 2 years.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to EDC Ltd.; processing fee 1% of loan amount subject to max Rs 2.00 lakh plus GST (preliminary application Rs 10,000 plus GST; balance at final application); non-refundable.
schemes.notes: Loan scheme, not a grant; max_benefit_inr is the Rs 2500 lakh loan cap for corporate bodies/LLP. Debt-equity 3:1 (up to 50 lakh), 2:1 (above); minimum 25% margin and promoter's contribution.

schemes.name: General Term Loan Scheme
schemes.target: MSMEs, service sector, tourism, health care and other industrial/commercial units in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Micro, small, medium and large enterprises and services sector units; existing concerns for expansion/modernization/diversification/renovation; tourism (restaurants, hotels, tour agencies), health care units, renewable energy, energy saving systems, barges, warehouse/cold storage and other eligible commercial/industrial activities. Loan for creation of fixed assets or takeover of outstanding standard loans against fixed assets acquired during past 18 months. Assets charged must not be leased/rented without permission. Satisfactory repayment history; for takeover, account standard for past two consecutive years. Must furnish approvals and agree to mortgage/hypothecate with first charge. Area of operation: State of Goa. Minimum promoter contribution 25% of project cost. Existing CMRY & GTEGP borrowers: total EDC term loan exposure not to exceed 50.00 lakhs for hypothecation cases.
schemes.benefit: Term loan up to: Proprietary concerns 400.00 lakh; Partnership firms 700.00 lakh; Corporate bodies/LLP 1500.00 lakh (enhanced amount or consortium possible). Interest (w.e.f. 01.07.2021): up to 50.00 L 9.50% p.a. fixed; above 50 L up to 100 L 9.50%-11.50% p.a.; above 100 L 9.50%-12.50% p.a. (by credit rating). Repayable within 8 years incl. moratorium up to 2 years. Debt-equity 3:1 (up to 50 lakhs), 2:1 (above). Minimum margin on primary security 25%.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to EDC Limited: preliminary application (fee Rs 10,000 + GST; Rs 5,000 for loans 5-10 lakh) then final application; processing fee 1% of loan max 2.00 lakh + GST, non-refundable.
schemes.notes: Loan scheme (not grant). max_benefit_inr = 1500.00 lakh limit for corporate bodies/LLP; Corporation may consider enhanced amounts beyond limits.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Modified Interest Rebate Scheme (MMIRS)
schemes.target: Units with industrial/MSME loans from EDC (backward talukas, Goan entrepreneurs, women entrepreneurs, units employing Goans)
schemes.eligibility: New and existing industrial/MSME loans disbursed by EDC, excluding negative-list sectors (alcohol & liquor, barge, construction of commercial/residential complexes, transport, sponge iron/steel ingots/rolling mills, tobacco, mining equipment & machinery, rescheduled/restructured loans, loans to Government corporations, CMRY & GTEGP loans, personal, housing and vehicle loans). Categories: A) units in Pernem, Sattari, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona, Bicholim, Dharbandora talukas; B) units promoted by resident/non-resident Goan entrepreneurs (native Goans, residents of Goa for not less than last 15 years, PGOs, NRGs) with effective shareholding not less than 74%; C) units promoted by women entrepreneurs with shareholding not less than 74%; D) units employing 20 or more regular Goan employees (on payroll whole claim year, 15 years residence proof). Loan account must be standard at end of financial year. Not applicable if already availing interest subsidy/rebate under any Central or State scheme. Units under earlier MIRS-2012 considered w.e.f. 01/04/2023.
schemes.benefit: Interest rebate: Category A 5% p.a.; B 2% p.a.; C 2% p.a.; D 2% p.a. Can combine categories; A+B+C capped at 7% p.a., plus 2% p.a. exclusively for D; maximum 9% p.a. Total rebate not to exceed Rs.25.00 lakhs per annum per unit. Rebate adjusted towards principal/interest payable to EDC in subsequent financial year.
schemes.how_to_apply: Claims to EDC Limited per procedure framed by EDC; processed and placed before Committee constituted by EDC for approval and submission to Government.
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the per-annum cap per unit (Rs.25.00 lakhs per annum). Replaces Modified Interest Rebate Scheme-2012. Two-column layout; text order interleaved but readable.

schemes.name: Personal Loan Scheme
schemes.target: Permanent government/PSU employees and aided-institution teachers in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Permanent employees of Government of Goa/Central Government/Corporations/PSUs, regular teachers/employees of schools, colleges and educational institutions aided by Government of Goa/other Government bodies; can combine with Government employee spouse; ideally not more than 55 years (up to 58 with reduced repayment); satisfactory CIBIL of applicant/guarantor; minimum net salary Rs.15,000 pm after EDC and other EMIs and minimum 35% of gross salary; total deductions not to exceed 65% of gross salary. Area: State of Goa.
schemes.benefit: Personal loan for any legitimate personal expense, new vehicle for personal use, or takeover of personal loan; minimum Rs.1.00 lakh (multiples of Rs.10,000), maximum Rs.15.00 lakh. Interest 9.50% p.a. (floating) w.e.f. 01/07/2021. Repayment: up to 5.00 lakh 5 years (59 months); up to 10.00 lakh 7 years (83 months); above 10.00 lakh 8 years (95 months); one month moratorium. Nil margin (10% of invoice for vehicles between 5-15 lakh).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to EDC with photographs, PAN, Aadhaar (applicant & guarantor, spouse PAN/Aadhaar), salary certificate & Form 16, guarantor salary slip, 3-month bank statement, employer consent letter for EMI deduction, dealer quotation for vehicle. Processing fee 0.5% + GST. Guarantors (Govt employees): one up to 5.00 lakh, two above.
schemes.notes: Loan product; EMI chart included in document.

schemes.name: Scheme of Financial Assistance Against Mortgage of Immovable Properties
schemes.target: Existing industrial/service units with nil or nominal debt
schemes.eligibility: Existing industrial concerns/enterprises and service sector units for expansion/modernization/diversification/renovation; in existence for at least five years with cash profits for at least two years and positive net worth in last financial year; satisfactory repayment history (standard for two years for takeover); residual life of plant & machinery not less than 10 years, building minimum 20 years; property not leased/rented without permission; agree to mortgage/hypothecate. Area: State of Goa. Minimum promoter contribution 25%.
schemes.benefit: Loan up to 75% of value of existing immovable properties (land & building) plus collateral non-agricultural property, subject to limits: Proprietary 400.00 lakh; Partnership 700.00 lakh; Corporate bodies/LLP 1500.00 lakh. Interest (w.e.f. 01.07.2021): up to 50 L 9.50% fixed; 50-100 L 9.50%-11.50%; above 100 L 9.50%-12.50%. Repayable within 8 years incl. moratorium up to 2 years. Margin 10% (nil for takeover).
schemes.how_to_apply: Preliminary application to EDC (fee Rs 10,000 + GST; Rs 5,000 for loans 5-10 lakh) and final application; processing fee 1% max 2.00 lakh + GST, non-refundable.
schemes.notes: Loan product.

schemes.name: Scheme of Loan Assistance for Construction Projects
schemes.target: Builders/developers of residential/commercial construction projects in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Applicant/promoter with construction experience in last 5 years and at least two completed projects of minimum built-up area 1000 m2 each; land acquired per Corporation norms with all approvals for project of minimum 1000 m2; satisfactory repayment history (standard for past two years for takeover); clear marketable title and agreeable to mortgage/hypothecate. Area: State of Goa. Minimum promoter contribution 25%; max debt-equity 1.5:1; minimum margin on security 35%.
schemes.benefit: Loan for land, land development, construction, interiors, swimming pool, club house, lifts, AC, firefighting, electrification etc. Limits: Proprietary concerns 400.00 lakh; Partnership firms 700.00 lakh; Corporate bodies/LLP 1500.00 lakh. Interest (w.e.f. 01.07.2021): up to 50 L 9.50% p.a. fixed; 50-100 L 9.50%-11.50%; above 100 L 9.50%-12.50%. Repayable from sales within 5 years incl. moratorium up to 2 years.
schemes.how_to_apply: Preliminary application to EDC (fee Rs 10,000 + GST) and final application; processing fee 1% max 2.00 lakh + GST, non-refundable.
schemes.notes: Loan product.

schemes.name: Scheme of Loan Assistance to State Government Agencies
schemes.target: State Government departments, corporations, boards, autonomous bodies in Goa
schemes.eligibility: State Government Corporations/Departments/Board/Autonomous Bodies/Agencies and other establishments operating in Goa; purpose: infrastructure development, repayment/takeover of outstanding liabilities (except doubtful/loss loans), operation of State Government schemes, other funding approved by Board.
schemes.benefit: Short/medium/long-term loan, need based as approved by Finance Department; margin up to 10% of project cost; floating interest, presently minimum 10.00% p.a. (w.e.f. 01/10/2017); repayable normally within 7 years with moratorium up to 12 months.
schemes.how_to_apply: Secured by term loan agreement, demand promissory note, assurance letter from Finance Department for budgetary provision; processing fee 1.00% max Rs 2.00 lakh excl. GST.
schemes.notes: Quantum need based; no fixed maximum.

schemes.name: Scheme of term loan Assistance to qualified professionals
schemes.target: Qualified professionals (doctors, CAs, advocates, architects, engineers, IT professionals etc.)
schemes.eligibility: Registered medical practitioners, homeopathy/ayurvedic/veterinary doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, pharmacists, IT professionals, CAs, CSs, advocates, consulting/chartered engineers, registered valuers, architects, cost accountants etc., individually/jointly or as partnership/LLP/company; minimum two years experience; age up to 55 years; loan for fixed assets or takeover of standard loans for assets acquired in past 18 months; property not leased/rented without permission; satisfactory repayment history; agree to mortgage/hypothecate. Area: only State of Goa. Minimum promoter contribution 25%.
schemes.benefit: Term loan up to 75.00 lakhs for premises, machinery, furniture & fixtures for professional practice; interest 9.50% p.a.; repayable within 8 years incl. moratorium up to 2 years; debt-equity 3:1 up to 50 lakhs, 2:1 above; margin 25%.
schemes.how_to_apply: Preliminary application to EDC (fee Rs 10,000 + service tax; Rs 5,000 for loans 5-10 lakh) and final application; processing fee 1% max 2.00 lakh, non-refundable.
schemes.notes: Loan product.

schemes.name: Policy Guidelines for reconsidering/re-validating the One Time Settlement (OTS) offer
schemes.target: EDC defaulting borrowers who accepted OTS offers before 23.11.2015 but failed to pay
schemes.eligibility: Only borrowers who accepted OTS offer prior to EDC Loan Compromise Settlement Guidelines (prior to 23.11.2015) and (i) failed to pay per OTS offer which was subsequently withdrawn, or (ii) made partial/total payment but delayed beyond stipulated period, and are in weak financial position or where main borrower/partners/directors have expired and legal heirs unable to pay.
schemes.benefit: (A) Loans disbursed above Rs.10.00 lakhs: (i) withdrawn OTS may be re-validated on written request with entire settlement amount plus accrued interest at highest OTS rate for delayed period; (ii) where substantial payment made and OTS not withdrawn, waiver of 25% of interest accrued for delayed period if entire balance paid. (B) Loans up to Rs.10.00 lakhs: (i) if 50% or more of settlement paid, 50% of accrued interest on balance for delayed period waived; (ii) if borrower expired, entire accrued interest for delayed period waived provided 100% settlement amount paid. Expenses payable separately.
schemes.how_to_apply: Written request from borrower/legal heirs with reasons; ITRs, P&L and balance sheets of last three years and net-worth details; sworn affidavit on net-worth. Settlement payable within 60 days of offer (max 90 days, 15.5% interest for days beyond 60). Approval by Committee of Directors (above Rs.10 lakhs, case referred to Government) or Chairman & MD on Executive Committee recommendation (below Rs.10 lakhs).
schemes.notes: Debt-settlement policy rather than a benefit scheme; no notification date printed.

schemes.name: One Time Settlement Scheme 2020
schemes.target: Electricity consumers with arrears (disconnected, RRC and active consumers)
schemes.eligibility: All categories of consumers whose installations are temporarily/permanently disconnected as on 10/10/2020 for non-payment, Revenue Recovery cases filed up to 10/10/2020, and active consumers with arrears up to 13/10/2020. Consumers with cases pending in courts/C.G.R.F. not covered but may apply directly for case-to-case settlement.
schemes.benefit: Waiver of Delayed Payment Charges (D.P.C.) by instalment option: 2 monthly instalments - 100% DPC waived; 3 - 80%; 4 - 60%; 5 - 40%; 6 - 20%. For RRC cases without energy/DPC break-up, 50% of accumulated bill as on 10/10/2020 waived. RRC cases withdrawn on full settlement.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online only at www.goaelectricity.gov.in (OTS Portal); first instalment within 7 days of registration, subsequent monthly as per schedule; non-adherence voids benefits.
schemes.valid_period: Applications within one month (30 days) from date of notification in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Gazette notification date not printed in text.

amendments.name: One Time Settlement (OTS) Scheme for Primary Agricultural Credit / Multipurpose / Urban Co-operative Credit Societies - modification of clauses (Corrigendum)
amendments.notes: Department of Co-operation corrigendum 41/4/2008/TS/RCS/Vol. II/3413 in gazette Series I No. 41 dated 09-01-2025 (approved by Council of Ministers 30-10-2024); also modifies Clause 7 (Dam Duppat Scheme), text of which is trimmed. Date of corrigendum not clearly legible in interleaved text. Not the portal-titled scheme.

schemes.name: Interest Free Education Loan Scheme for Higher Education
schemes.target: Young Goan students pursuing higher/technical education in India or abroad
schemes.eligibility: Below 30 years of age; resident of Goa for 15 years; passed qualifying exam (Std X/XII for diploma/degree from recognized institutions in Goa; graduation in Goa for PG; graduation outside Goa only if both parents residing in Goa for 15 years; PG for PhD); marks 55% or more for studies in India, 60% or more abroad (relaxable by 10% for SC/ST/OBC); family income not exceeding Rs.12,00,000 p.a. for India (Rs.13,00,000 if sibling also in higher studies), Rs.20,00,000 p.a. abroad (Rs.23,00,000 with sibling), relaxation up to Rs.1.00 lakh possible in high-fee cases; full-time course, entitled fees more than Rs.10,000 p.a., recognized by UGC/AICTE/MCI/DCI/ACI/Board of Technical Education Goa etc.; abroad only top 500 world/top 100 continent universities for courses not ordinarily available in India. Scholarships/benefits under other schemes deducted. Reservation: not less than 2% SC, 12% ST, 19.5% OBC; 30% women in each category; 20% of funds for studies abroad.
schemes.benefit: Interest-free loan: within India actual entitled fees up to Rs. 2.00 lakhs per annum (max Rs. 10 lakhs over 5 years); abroad actual entitled fees up to Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum (max Rs. 16 lakhs over 2 years). Entitled fees include tuition, laboratory, development, hostel fees. Repayment starts one year after course; 18-60 months by slab; 10% interest on default. Write-off possible on death or terminal illness.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit completed application with documents to office of GEDC before last date; registration number issued; Sanctioning Committee decides within two months (interview possible). Bond in favour of Government of Goa with parent surety (above Rs. 5.00 lakhs also a Government servant or Goa property owner surety).
schemes.valid_period: From publication in Official Gazette till further notice
schemes.notes: Amended version of 2003 scheme (notification DEV/SCHEME-AMEND/IFEL/96/2022) published in full; operated by GEDC from Higher Education Promotion Fund. Grievances heard by Directorate of Higher Education.

schemes.name: Scheme for Creation and Enhancement of Infrastructure and Overall Development of Educational Sector in Goa-2018
schemes.target: Educational institutions under Directorates of Education, Higher Education and Technical Education
schemes.eligibility: Educational institutions under Directorate of Education, Directorate of Higher Education and Directorate of Technical Education and other institutions specifically identified by Government.
schemes.benefit: Infrastructure, equipment, machinery, furniture etc. via High Powered Committee sanctions; releases listed: Rs 5,00,00,000 to DHE for renovation; Rs 2,49,86,783 to DTE (polytechnics Curchorem and Bicholim); Rs 109,59,00,000 to Directorate of Education for school infrastructure.
schemes.notes: Write-up with achievements table (FY 2019-20/2020-21) only; OCR-like errors in text layer; amounts are institutional releases, not per-beneficiary.

schemes.name: Scheme of Yog Education in Government Primary Schools in the State
schemes.target: Students and teachers of Government primary schools
schemes.benefit: Yoga training in Government primary schools: Master Resource Persons trained, Government primary teachers trained; implemented in approx. 240 Govt. Primary schools (2017-18, 2018-19); NCERT-based 'khel khel me yog' books.
schemes.notes: Programme description/implementation note (budget speech para 54); no application, eligibility or monetary benefit.

schemes.name: Component-B of PM KUSUM in the State of Goa (Off-grid Standalone Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems to Farmers, 2021-2022)
schemes.target: Farmers (inherited/self-owned/caretaker cultivator) without grid connection for irrigation
schemes.eligibility: Farmer having krishi card/kisan card issued by competent authority who owns farm land with reliable irrigation source (bore well/open well/surface storage tank) that has no electricity connection; grid connectivity not feasible or not cost effective.
schemes.benefit: Standalone solar pumps 1 HP to 7.5 HP AC/DC (and 10 HP AC); subsidy 90% (MNRE CFA 30% + State 60%) on benchmark cost or derived rate whichever lower; 5-year warranty and AMC with insurance. 200 pumps sanctioned on first come first serve basis.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in format with land ownership and irrigation source documents and photo ID addressed to Member Secretary, GEDA, Goa IDC Building, Patto, Panaji; techno-feasibility survey by empanelled company; farmer pays contribution by demand draft to company; GEDA issues work order.
schemes.valid_period: Year 2021-2022; MNRE sanction valid one year from issue
schemes.notes: OCR text; gazette Series I No. 27 dated 30-09-2021 (trimmed). No rupee amount per farmer stated.

schemes.name: Grant of subsidy for purchase of "Electric Vehicles" to consumers in State of Goa (Scheme for Promotion of Electric Vehicles in the State of Goa)
schemes.target: Goa residents buying or converting to electric 2W/3W/4W
schemes.eligibility: Permanent residents of Goa having Aadhar Card and Driving License issued in Goa. Scrapping incentive for de-registering old ICE vehicles registered in Goa (confirmed by RTO). Conversion by retrofit kit subject to RTO approval.
schemes.benefit: State subsidy per kWh battery capacity (2W/3W/4W): 2021-22 Rs10,000/kWh; 2022-23 Rs8,000/kWh; 2023-24 Rs6,000/kWh; 2024-25 Rs4,000/kWh; 2025-26 Rs2,000/kWh. Cap: 2W not exceeding Rs30,000; 3W Rs60,000; 4W Rs3,00,000 (for 3000, 50, 300 vehicles respectively). Scrapping: OEM/CESL Rs5,000 (2W); Goa Government Rs5,000 (2W), Rs10,000 (3W/4W). Manufactured in Goa: Rs5,000 (2W), Rs10,000 (3W), Rs15,000 (4W). FAME-II as applicable. CESL low-cost loans if purchased via CESL.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through GEDA/Department of New & Renewable Energy; single-instalment disbursal on purchase/conversion with copy of RC book and insurance; first come first serve. Purchase via CESL for clubbed incentives/loan, or directly from dealer (no CESL assistance).
schemes.funding: State (clubbed with Central FAME-II incentives as applicable)
schemes.valid_period: Subsidy rates FY 2021-22 to 2025-26
schemes.notes: Notification date not printed; approvals U.O. No. 176 dated 06/07/2021 and Finance U.O. 3750/F dated 22/11/2021. max_benefit_inr is the 4W State subsidy cap (excl. scrapping/local-manufacture incentives).

schemes.name: Grant of subsidy to "Biogas Plant based on Kitchen/Organic Waste" - Category I (Domestic)
schemes.target: Domestic households installing kitchen-waste biogas plants
schemes.eligibility: Permanent resident of Goa having Aadhar Card/House Tax receipt (individual/domestic purpose); installation through registered dealers of GEDA; MNRE/BIS-approved models; beneficiary bears full cost first.
schemes.benefit: 1m3 up to 2m3: 40% subsidy of the arrived cost via EoI or Rs. 20,000/- whichever is less; beyond 2m3 up to 3m3: 40% or Rs. 30,000/- whichever is less. Target 80 domestic plants (total scheme subsidy restricted to Rs. 32.00 lakhs).
schemes.how_to_apply: Install via GEDA-registered dealer, then apply to GEDA in prescribed format with photo of installed system with beneficiary and documents; subsidy by RTGS after 6 months continuous operation and GEDA inspection; first come first serve.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 06-02-2020 (trimmed).

schemes.name: Grant of subsidy to "Biogas Plant based on Kitchen/Organic Waste" - Category II (Institutional)
schemes.target: Residential societies, institutions, hotels, hospital canteens, restaurants
schemes.eligibility: Registered institutions under State or Central Government functioning in Goa, registered residential complexes, hotels and restaurants having requisite licence and valid permission; installation via GEDA-registered dealers; MNRE/BIS-approved models.
schemes.benefit: Beyond 3m3 up to 10m3: 30% subsidy of the arrived cost via EoI or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less. Target 20 plants.
schemes.how_to_apply: Install via GEDA-registered dealer, then apply to GEDA with documents; subsidy by RTGS after 6 months continuous operation and joint inspection.
schemes.notes: 'Cooperative society' inferred from 'registered housing societies'.

schemes.name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
schemes.target: Housewives/homemakers from middle, lower-middle and poor sections
schemes.eligibility: Married woman (incl. widow, divorcee) above 18 years; resident of Goa for last fifteen years; gross income of husband and wife together not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000/- per annum; not applicable if she or husband regularly employed in listed entities (incl. scheduled banks excluding co-operative banks; list partly cut); not receiving Dayanand Social Security Scheme benefit (except widow with minor child).
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500/- per month financial assistance (w.e.f. payment of September, 2016).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Director of Women and Child Development, Panaji-Goa in prescribed form (Annexure-A) with self-certified Aadhar Card, Marriage Certificate, ... (list cut).
schemes.notes: Monthly amount. Amended Griha Aadhar Scheme notified by Directorate of Women & Child Development (Not. 2-1233-GA/2019-20/DWCD/7037) in gazette Series I No. 45 dated 06-02-2020; header department is GEDA. Text cut mid-document: list of excluded employers and documents incomplete; notification date not visible.

schemes.name: Scheme for implementation of RVE (Rural Village Electrification) Programme in the State of Goa
schemes.target: Un-electrified households in remote/inaccessible villages, hamlets and wadas where grid extension is not feasible
schemes.eligibility: Census un-electrified villages/hamlets/wadas having population of less than 50, subject to (a) certificate from the Village Panchayat that the house/households is in existence; (b) certificate from the Electricity Department, Goa that the village/hamlet/wada is un-electrified and is not being taken up for electrification under State/Central programmes.
schemes.benefit: Solar Photo Voltaic (SPV) based standalone systems; 100% financial assistance to household of maximum limit of Rs. 90,000/- per household for 500Wp solar system (including transport, installation and cost of AMC for 5 years). Electricity charges as determined by Government charged monthly from each household to create a village/hamlet-wise corpus fund for maintenance after AMC expiry.
schemes.how_to_apply: Implemented through GEDA.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 19 dated 06-08-2020, Notification 1-2/Admin/NCSE/2020-21/20; issued with Finance (Exp.) concurrence U.O. No. 1400070385 dated 2-05-2020. Trimmed: clauses 1-3 of this scheme not in extract. Local body role = Village Panchayat certifies existence of households.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Biomass Briquetting Machines (Grant of Subsidy for Biomass Briquetting Plants Scheme)
schemes.target: Manufacturers/entrepreneurs setting up biomass briquetting plants
schemes.eligibility: Only beneficiaries who are permanent residents of Goa.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of 25% or Rs. 4,00,000/- whichever is less of machinery cost (biomass briquetting machines and auxiliary cutting/pulverizing units); paid 50% on delivery and 50% after 6 months successful continuous operation. Total Rs. 40,00,000/- for 10 plants.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through GEDA.
schemes.notes: Notified by Department of Science, Technology & Environment (Not. 82-10-2010/STE-DIR) in gazette Series I No. 36 dated 04-12-2014; promotion also through Block Development Offices mentioned in objectives.

schemes.name: Scheme for Promotion of Grid Connected Solar Rooftop System with Net Metering System (Grant of subsidy to Grid Connected Solar Rooftop Installation with Net Metering System)
schemes.target: Prosumers installing grid-connected solar rooftop systems with net metering (residential, non-profit educational institutions, industrial/commercial)
schemes.eligibility: All buildings/houses registered with Panchayat or Municipality having permanent electricity connections; installations of 1kW to 90kW (LT consumers only); prosumers who carried out installation after 21st December, 2017; subsidy on MNRE benchmark cost or GEDA derived cost whichever is lower; first come first serve.
schemes.benefit: 50% financial assistance as subsidy, maximum limit Rs. 54,000/- per kW (MNRE benchmark cost), for residential and for non-profit educational institutions (1kW-90kW); 20% subsidy, maximum limit Rs. 54,000/- per kW, for industrial and commercial purpose (1kW-90kW). Subsidy released upon completion of six months of solar power injected into grid. Total scheme assistance restricted to Rs. 2,00,00,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Implemented through GEDA; first come first serve.
schemes.notes: Notification 1-2/Admin/NCSE/2020-21/21 in Gazette Series I No. 19 dated 06-08-2020; Finance U.O. No. 3785 dated 19-06-2020. Subsidy cap is per kW (Rs. 54,000/kW), no per-beneficiary total stated. Clause (v) text in OCR says 20% 'to residential purpose' but clause 6(iii) clarifies 20% applies to Industrial and Commercial.

schemes.name: Goa Youth Rojgar Yojana Scheme (amended Deendayal Swayam Rozgar Yojana)
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Unemployed youth of Goa for self-employment via kiosks/stalls and cashew processing units; women groups/SHGs
schemes.eligibility: Residents of Goa with minimum 15 years of domicile, up to 40 years of age, minimum Std VIII education; age relaxation over 5 years and qualification up to III may be considered for handicapped/widows/deserving cases; open to Women Groups/SHGs of women (max 30% of kiosks reserved for such groups incl. SC/Handicapped/ST/OBC); SHGs must be registered under Societies Registration Act, active at least one year, selling own products. Selection on 100 marks: proximity 40, family income 20, qualification 10, interview 30. Guarantee required (self or person owning residence/500 sq m land, or Govt/PSU employee drawing over Rs.5,000/- pm).
schemes.benefit: Kiosk subsidy: Rs.10,000/- for kiosk costing Rs.30,000/- to Rs.35,000/- (PVC); Rs.15,000/- for kiosk above Rs.35,000/- to Rs.60,000/-; Rs.20,000/- for kiosk more than Rs.60,000/- (FRP). Capital assistance for kiosk plus 90% of working capital requirement, total not exceeding Rs.1 lakh. Capital repayable after 12 months at 10% simple interest in 60 monthly installments; working capital interest-free for first 6 months then 10%, principal repayable from 13th month in 60 installments.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through GHRSSIDC; Appraisal Committee selection including interview; affidavit; 60 post-dated cheques; lease agreement with landowner; allotment letter valid 6 months.
schemes.notes: Order No. 15/12/2001-IND, Industries Department; Finance concurrence U.O. No. FS/1282/F dated 07/04/2006; supersedes orders dated 7/12/01 and 18/2/04. max_benefit_inr is the kiosk subsidy; working capital loan up to Rs.1 lakh is a loan, not grant. Doc is an amended scheme so classified as Scheme rules with amends filled.

schemes.name: Marketing Support and Documentation of Goan Handicrafts
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Goan handicraft artisans (marketing, publicity, documentation of Goan handicrafts)
schemes.eligibility: Goan artisans (Aparant Maand stalls exclusively for Goan Artisans); no further individual eligibility criteria stated - activities implemented by GHRSSIDC.
schemes.benefit: Documentation, website, advertisement and publicity of Goan handicrafts by GHRSSIDC; Aparant Maand annual mega exhibition-cum-sale (up to 7 days, up to 4 per year) with up to 130 stalls free of cost to Goan Artisans; D.A. @ Rs.150/- per day per head (max 2 artisans per stall), Rs.250/- per head per day for Maands outside the State plus transport, travel and stay costs; expenditure limit Rs.15.00 lakhs per Maand in Goa and Rs.25 lakhs outside; exhibitions and trade fair participation costs covered.
schemes.how_to_apply: Implemented by GHRSSIDC.
schemes.notes: Notification No.8/2/2006-IND, Industries Department; Finance U.O. No. 1409038 dated 30/12/2010; supersedes Notification dated 30/12/2007. Per-artisan benefit is a daily allowance (Rs.150/day in Goa, Rs.250/day outside) so max_benefit_inr left null.

schemes.name: Scheme for Handicrafts artisans for participating in interstate crafts mela, exhibitions and interstate tour for visiting handicrafts establishments in other states within the country
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Goan handicraft artisans (groups of 20-30) on interstate study tours and crafts melas
schemes.eligibility: Group of 20-30 artisans from within the State selected by GHRSSIDC; no other criteria stated.
schemes.benefit: Interstate study tours of 10 to 12 days; reimbursement of 2nd class to-and-fro railway fare / KTC / GTDC bus travel; D.A. @ Rs.275/- per beneficiary per day in A-1 class cities and Rs.200/- per day in other cities; total cost per tour not to exceed Rs.1.00 lakh (special cases up to Rs.1.5 lakh per tour).
schemes.how_to_apply: Artisans selected by GHRSSIDC, which conducts the tours.
schemes.notes: Notification No.8/2/2006/-IND, Industries Department; Finance U.O. No. 1409038 dated 30/12/2010; supersedes Notification dated 30/12/2007. Per-beneficiary benefit is daily allowance; Rs.1-1.5 lakh cap is per tour.

schemes.name: Scheme for providing subsidy for Clay Idol Makers
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Traditional Goan clay idol makers/artisans registered with GHRSSIDC
schemes.eligibility: Traditional clay idol makers/artisans registered with GHRSSIDC; own workshop; idols made of clay by Goan artisans during financial year 2007-08, minimum 1 ft height, used for religious purpose (Ganesh Chaturthi, Christmas etc.) and actually sold; decorative idols, unsold idols, idols imported from outside the State or procured for trading excluded; max 250 idols per artisan per year; first come first served subject to budget.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of Rs. 100/- per idol/figure; maximum subsidy per beneficiary stated as Rs. 15000/- in Eligibility clause and as Rs. 25000/- upper limit in Other Terms & Conditions; paid by cheque. Govt places Rs. 50.00 lakhs as grants-in-aid to GHRSSIDC.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed proforma from GHRSSIDC (Rs. 10/- per form) to the Managing Director, GHRSSIDC, Panaji with proof of idols sold and original bills; register as clay idol making unit (Proforma C); maintain sales register and triplicate bill books; GHRSSIDC visit to count idols; Appraisal Committee scrutiny.
schemes.valid_period: Financial year 2007-08 (forms reference 2009)
schemes.notes: Internal inconsistency: per-beneficiary cap Rs. 15000/- vs Rs. 25000/-; max_benefit_inr uses the larger. Older version of doc 449e170527. No order date printed.

schemes.name: Seed Capital Loan Scheme for Self Help Groups 2011
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Self Help Groups in rural and urban areas taking up non-farm sector income-generating enterprises
schemes.eligibility: SHGs registered with Registrar of Co-operative Societies under Cooperative Societies Act or as a Society under Societies Registration Act 1860, engaged in non-farm sector business/trading activities (industries sector: agro processing of groundnuts/areca/coconut, traditional cashew roasting, coconut oil, sweets/chicky/biscuits, papads/pickles, cashew value-added products (FDA licence needed for food), embroidery, perfumes, handicrafts/handloom, others approved by GHRSSIDCL; service sector: laundry, catering, labour contract, others approved); must register with GHRSSIDCL; SHG contributes 5% of project cost.
schemes.benefit: One time non-recurring grant of 50% of project cost as seed capital to the extent of Rs.50,000/- (for SHG of 10 members; Rs.5000/- per member if fewer members), credited to SHG bank account; 45% loan through Village Co-operative Bank, EDC, nationalized banks or micro finance (bank/EDC to max Rs.45,000/-); SHG contributes 5%. Also marketing support, exhibitions and skill development training via GHRSSIDCL for handicraft SHGs.
schemes.how_to_apply: Joint application by President and Secretary in typed format (Annexure 'A') on SHG letterhead to Managing Director, GHRSSIDCL, with Registration Certificate, EM Part I, list of members, activity details and project cost; deposit 5% contribution in bank; Appraisal Committee sanctions; bank/EDC claims 50% seed capital.
schemes.valid_period: 5 years from date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Department of Industries notification; Finance (Exp.) concurrence U.O. 143214 dated 27-01-2011; budget head 2851-800-40-31. No notification date printed.

schemes.name: Training Programme 'Conducting Training Programmes in Various Handicrafts and Allied Items, Design Development and Technology Upgradation Workshops for Capacity Building and to Create Self-Employment Opportunity for Urban & Rural Youth / Women, and Un-employed Persons'
schemes.department: Goa Handicrafts Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation
schemes.target: Artisans, urban and rural youth, women, SHG members and unemployed persons in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Open to all residents of Goa holding domicile certificate / Electoral Identity Card; minimum 30% of programmes exclusively for mahila mandals/women SHGs/women cooperative societies; at least 30% targeted to S.C/S.T/OBC; product development for export open to artisans/individuals/institutions engaged in handicraft exports (institutions with exports of Rs.2.00 lakhs in preceding year eligible); GHRSSIDC is final authority on beneficiaries.
schemes.benefit: Training programmes for batches of 20-30 candidates with expenditure upper limit Rs.50,000/- per training (raw material/tool kits Rs.20,000/-, trainers + coordinator fees Rs.20,000/-, publicity etc. Rs.10,000/-); course coordinator honorarium Rs 150 per day up to Rs 2000/- per training; improved tool kits assistance up to Rs.5,000/- per kit per person; specialized training, design development workshops, training of trainers, product development for export; marketing support through GHRSSIDC emporia and exhibitions.
schemes.how_to_apply: Implemented by GHRSSIDC; course coordinator selects beneficiaries; GHRSSIDC final authority.
schemes.notes: Notification No.8/2/2006/-IND, Industries Department; Finance U.O. No. 1409038 dated 30/12/2010; supersedes Notification No 8/2/2006-IND dated 30/12/2007. max_benefit_inr = tool kit per person (Rs.50,000 is per training programme, not per beneficiary).

schemes.name: Goa-IDC Exit Support Scheme
schemes.target: Lessees of non-functional industrial undertakings in Goa-IDC industrial estates and transferees acquiring them
schemes.eligibility: Lessees of Goa-IDC plots with non-functional industrial units intending to transfer leasehold rights; lessees who have not made any utilisation of the plot are excluded; built-up area exemption only for lessees who obtained the plot on or before 1st August 2014.
schemes.benefit: Lessee (plot obtained on or before 1st August 2014) exempt from mandatory utilisation of built-up area of at least 30% of plot area (Regulation 11(4)(a)); Transferee acquiring leasehold rights over plots with non-functional units gets waiver of Lease Rent for the first year (must meet minimum built-up area within two years); Corporation publicises plots and organises Transferor-Transferee meetings.
schemes.how_to_apply: Lessee submits letter of intent in Form-I to the Managing Director, Goa Industrial Development Corporation, Plot No 13 A-2, EDC Complex, Patto Plaza, Panaji; appeals within sixty working days to grievance redressal authority under Regulation 25.
schemes.valid_period: From 25th June 2024, valid for one year
schemes.notes: Non-monetary incentives (exemption and lease rent waiver); no notification number/date printed other than commencement date.

schemes.name: Incentives to Encourage Purchases from Local Suppliers Scheme, 2017
schemes.target: Micro, small and medium manufacturing units (white/green/orange category) buying inputs locally in Goa
schemes.eligibility: White, green and orange category MSME manufacturing units purchasing minimum 50% (in value) of raw material/components/tools from local sources (purchased from Goa, excluding services and Schedule A negative list: natural resources, major/minor minerals, alcoholic beverages, tobacco products); registered under Umbrella Scheme; not for cases claiming similar benefit under another Goa Govt scheme.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 2% of the cost of local purchases (excluding GST) consumed by the unit, maximum Rs.5.00 lakh per year, for five consecutive years from first application.
schemes.how_to_apply: After close of each financial year (by end of December of subsequent financial year) apply in specified format to DITC with Umbrella Scheme registration, affidavit, purchase bills, statement of local purchases with GST vouchers, final accounts, CA statements and certificates.
schemes.valid_period: 1st October 2017 to 30th September 2022
schemes.notes: Finance (Exp.) U.O. No.1400045040 dated 28/06/2018. Affidavit template refers to old notification 3/40/2003-IND(Part) dated 31-12-2008 amended 21-05-2010 (likely copy-over). Cap is per year.

portals.section: Schemes > State Government Schemes > Financial Support Scheme
portals.name: Incentives to Encourage Purchases from Local Suppliers Scheme (Umbrella Scheme)

apply_online.service: Incentives to Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme

schemes.name: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017
schemes.target: Micro, Small and Medium manufacturing enterprises (White/Green/Orange category) and Hinterland Eco-tourism projects in lesser developed talukas
schemes.eligibility: MSME manufacturing industries in White, Green or Orange category commencing production after 01/10/2017; Hinterland Eco tourism projects in lesser developed talukas registered with/recognised by Dept of Tourism/Goa IPB/TCP/PDA/ESZ Authority; minimum 60% Goan manpower on regular employment ('Goan' = born in Goa, or 10 years Residence Certificate from Mamlatdar or other 10-year-old residence document); term loan and/or working capital loan from nationalized/scheduled private/co-operative bank, EDC Ltd. or RBI-recognised NBFC. Excluded: EDC loans under Modified Interest Rebate Scheme 2012, interest under CMRY or other employment generation schemes, units under Goa State Financial Relief Scheme for Sick Industrial Units 2016, charges/overdue/penal interest; enterprises availing any Dept of IT policy benefit; cases claiming similar benefit under any other Goa Govt scheme. Governed by the Umbrella Scheme (registration required).
schemes.benefit: Term loan: 30% of interest paid; working capital loan: 1½% of total turnover or 30% of interest paid, whichever is less; benefit pro rata 60% to 100% for 60% to 80% Goan employment (below 60% no benefit, 80% and above 100%); ceiling Rs. 25.00 lakh per annum (27.50 lakh for women and SC/ST applicants); for up to seven years (27 continuous quarters after first claim quarter).
schemes.how_to_apply: Annual claim after close of financial year to Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Udyog Bhavan, Panaji in specified proforma with Umbrella Scheme registration, self-declaration/affidavit, bank interest certificate, CA-certified financial statements, CA certificate of interest and turnover, payroll showing Goan employees, CA certificate of no DoIT/other-scheme claim, tourism registration (eco-tourism), Aadhaar-linked bank details, GSPCB certificate.
schemes.valid_period: 1st October 2017 to 30th September 2022 (disbursal may continue if at least one claim filed during validity)
schemes.notes: Finance (Exp.) concurrence U.O. No.1400044855 dated 19/12/2017. Ceiling is per annum (Rs. 27.50 lakh/year for women and SC/ST). No notification date printed.

portals.section: Schemes > State Government Schemes > Financial Support Scheme
portals.name: Interest Subsidy Scheme (Umbrella Scheme)

schemes.name: Scheme for Imparting Training under Khadi & Village Industries Sector 2018
schemes.department: Goa Khadi And Village Industries Board
schemes.target: Unemployed persons in Goa to be trained in traditional Khadi, Solar Khadi and village industries
schemes.eligibility: Any person above the age of 18 years resident of the State of Goa for 10 years.
schemes.benefit: Training batches of maximum 20 candidates, up to 25 working days, five batches per year; TA for participants @ Rs 100/- per day; refreshments or stipend @ 100 per person per day; study material @ 100 per trainee; trainer fee @ 500 per day; budget Rs.190000/- per batch, Rs.950000/- per year for 5 batches. Trained candidates to be linked to Government sponsored schemes for self-employment.
schemes.how_to_apply: Selection through public notice, sponsorship by line departments or by voluntary organizations; application form at Annexure I; three-member Appraisal Committee (CEO GKVIB chairman, State Director KVIC, DITC representative) scrutinises and prepares training schedule.
schemes.valid_period: Five (05) years from date of issue of notification
schemes.notes: OCR of scanned document with damage (some Devanagari OCR noise); Department of Industries notification dated 7th January, 2019; Finance U.O. No.1400055531 dated 21/09/2018. Per-participant benefit is daily (TA Rs 100/day + stipend Rs 100/day), so max_benefit_inr null. Annexure I form not included.

schemes.name: Scheme for promotion of Beekeeping Industry (in the State of Goa)
schemes.department: Goa Khadi And Village Industries Board
schemes.target: Trained beekeepers / prospective beekeeping entrepreneurs in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Any person above 18 years of age who is a permanent resident of Goa and has undergone training in beekeeping industry from an authorized institution.
schemes.benefit: Maximum 10 beehives each and other implements, applicant paying 10% of the cost of equipment (SC/ST: 5%); beehive cost not to exceed Rs 6000/- per beehive and implements Rs 1000/- per applicant (applicant bears excess). Beehives for Apis Cerana Indica with 6 frames, purchased through agencies approved by appraisal committee. Annual outlay Rs. 75 lakhs (Rs. 60 lakhs for beehives/equipment).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to KVIB Goa (implementing agency) in form at Annexure I with documents; selection through public notice, sponsorship by line departments, voluntary organisations or SHGs; three-member committee (CEO KVIB, State Director KVIC, DITC representative) scrutinises.
schemes.valid_period: Five years from publication in Official Gazette
schemes.later_amendments: 23-09-2021 – Scheme for Promotion of Beekeeping Industry (Amendment)
schemes.notes: Department of Industries No. 10/7/2019-IND/27 dated 07/01/2020; Finance U.O. No. 140007026? dated 27/12/2019 (OCR). OCR of scan with minor damage. Clause 6.1 OCR says beehives provided '@ 10% of the cost' - per doc edaa22d38a this means subsidy up to 90% (general) / 95% (SC/ST). No single rupee subsidy amount stated. Portal type: Guidelines.

amendments.name: Scheme for Promotion of Beekeeping Industry (Amendment)
amendments.benefit: Additional subsidy equal to the difference between Honey Mission Programme subsidy and the subsidy eligible under the Scheme for Promotion of Beekeeping Industry (new clause 6.1(A)).
amendments.notes: Issued by Department of Industries (Notification 10/7/2019-IND/331), found in same gazette issue as PM-KUSUM; header department is GEDA.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.department: Goa Khadi And Village Industries Board
schemes.target: New micro enterprises in rural and urban Goa (credit-linked subsidy)
schemes.eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age; no income ceiling; minimum VIII std education for projects above Rs 10 lakhs (manufacturing) / Rs 5 lakhs (service); only new units; SHGs not having availed assistance under any scheme, institutions registered under Societies Registration Act 1860, cooperative societies and charitable trusts eligible; project cost max Rs 25 lakhs manufacturing / Rs 10 lakhs service, excluding land, must include capital expenditure; negative list excluded (meat, intoxicants/liquor/tobacco/toddy, agriculture/horticulture/floriculture/animal husbandry, polythene <20 microns/recycled plastic carry bags, Khadi programme activities, rural transport except cycle rickshaw); one person employed per Rs 1.00 lakh fixed investment; only one project per family (person and spouse).
schemes.benefit: Margin money subsidy of project cost: General category 15% (urban) / 25% (rural), beneficiary contribution 10%; Special category (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Ex-servicemen/physically handicapped) 25% (urban) / 35% (rural), contribution 5%; balance as bank term loan; no collateral for projects up to Rs 10 lakhs; margin money kept as TDR for three years.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit proposal in prescribed format to KVIB (rural areas; Junta House Panaji, Tel 2221452 / Fatorda Margao, Tel 2740081) or District Industries Centre (municipal limits of Panaji, Margao, Mapusa, Vasco); District Level Taskforce scrutiny and interview; forwarded to chosen public sector bank; two-week EDP training; deposit own contribution; bank claims margin money via nodal branch.
schemes.notes: Annexure-I guideline summary of the central PMEGP scheme (monitored by Ministry of MSME); funding labelled 100% Central as it is a GoI programme though text does not state the funding split. No rupee subsidy cap stated (would be percentage of max project cost; not computed).
