schemes.notes: Corrigendum No. 13-91/Kamd/(S)/2021-22/6214, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 44 dated 27-01-2022. Same gazette pages also include unrelated PWD, Skill Development and Women & Child Development notifications.

schemes.name: Kamdhenu Scheme (Sudharit) Amended 2021
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Dairy farmers / youth setting up dairy units
schemes.eligibility: Bonafide resident of Goa for at least 05 years; pucca cattle shed with cement flooring; undertake to strictly stall feed (no open grazing); new applicants must undergo dairy training at designated centre (old traditional dairy farmers with crossbred/improved/indigenous animals who had not availed Kamdhenu may be exempted on Area Officer recommendation); knowledge or experience in cattle/buffalo farming or trained by Department; land for green fodder cultivation desirable; farmer who had availed the purchase of animals under the earlier Kamdhenu Scheme (listed under eligibility); must have cattle shed; be member of local Dairy Society/Bachat Gat/SHG (those branding own dairy products may be permitted without membership); letter from financing institution having ECS willing to finance.
schemes.benefit: Unit cost of Cross Bred Cow/Improved She Buffalo/Indigenous breed cow (Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi, Tharparkar) limited to Rs. 70,000/- per animal. Subsidy on cost of animal: 1 to 10 animals 90% (Rs. 63000), 11 to 20 animals 75% (Rs. 52500), 21 to 100 animals 50% (Rs. 35000), all categories; credited via ECS to financing institution/beneficiary account. Transport incentive Rs. 2000/- per animal (or actual, whichever less) for purchase outside the state; Rs. 800/- per animal (or actual, whichever less) for purchase at cattle melas organized by the Department. If animal dies within one month of purchase (not due to negligence), cost of animal credited to beneficiary.
schemes.how_to_apply: Documents include: consent for Aadhaar seeding/authentication; affidavit in prescribed format re ownership of cattle shed and Form I & XIV; caste certificate of SC/ST/Dhangar (if applicable); letter from financing institution with ECS; passport size photograph; residence verified/attested by local area Officer. Animals to be purchased within one year of sanction, from Department cattle melas or outside the state (outside-state purchase needs prior written permission and minimum 10 animals at a time).
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the subsidy per animal (1-10 animal slab); total per beneficiary not stated (up to 100 animals). notified_on is the Gazette issue date (Series I No. 29); corrigendum 926aced651 gives notification date as 04-10-2021. Animals must be insured (comprehensive, min 3½ years) and microchipped/ear-tagged. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Pashupalan Scheme (Amended)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Owners of non-descript cattle/buffalo and cross-bred/improved/indigenous female calves; NGOs, Goshalas, community farms
schemes.eligibility: All farmers availing Artificial Insemination facility for cattle and buffalo and registered with local Government Veterinary Services; NGOs, Goshalas, Community Farms and other organizations availing A.I.; all farmers irrespective of financial status; farmers having cross-bred/improved buffalo/indigenous (Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi) female calves born of A.I., born to existing animals, or bought under Kamdhenu/Western Ghat/Modern Dairy or other Government schemes. Animals must be stall-fed/tied; calves must gain at least 30 kg per quarter (min 30 kg at 3 months).
schemes.benefit: Phase 1: incentive Rs. 500/- for 1st A.I. and Rs. 200/- for 2nd A.I. of non-descript cow/buffalo. Phase 2: on confirmation of pregnancy, Rs. 2,000/- per month for feed, fodder & misc. from 4th month onward. Phase 3: Rs. 4,000/- on birth of female cross-bred/improved buffalo calf to local cow/buffalo; calf feed allowance from birth to 27 months at 75% of estimated expenditure (quarterly subsidy Rs. 5,625/-, 2,625/-, 3,375/-, 3,375/-, 4,800/- x4, 5,400/-); 100% subsidy for S.C./S.T. & Dhangar community.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register animals at local Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital (Forms I-V); submit caste certificate if SC/ST/Dhangar and bank passbook copy (account no., MICR, IFSC); Area VO/AD submits records and quarterly weight-gain certificates (Annexure A) to Head Office; subsidy credited to bank account.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 14-55/AHVS/16-17/1041; notified_on is Gazette issue date (Series I No. 10). Monthly feed incentive is Rs. 2,000 per month; amounts are per A.I./per animal/per quarter and no single per-beneficiary total is stated, so max_benefit_inr left null (estimated rearing cost Rs. 52,800 per calf). Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Construction/Re-construction and Repairs of house under Atal Asra Yojana
schemes.target: Scheduled Tribe house owners (construction/re-construction/repairs of house)
schemes.eligibility: Not restated in this amendment; only Clauses 4(b), 7(c) and 10 of the principal scheme are amended. All other clauses remain unchanged.
schemes.benefit: Amended Clause 4(b)(ii): fees of registered Engineers/Architects/Contractors (registered under PWD/GSIDC/Government Departments or Autonomous bodies) for preparing estimate and certification for New construction/Re-construction paid directly to them by the Director of Tribal Welfare, restricted to maximum of 5% of the total sanctioned amount of New construction/Re-construction; balance fees paid directly at time of second installment through Aadhar/ECS mode. 2nd installment of 25% of the sanctioned amount released through Goa ST Finance & Development Corporation by Director, Tribal Welfare.
schemes.how_to_apply: Clause 7(c): estimate for New construction/Re-construction to be prepared by registered Engineers/Architects (PWD/GSIDC/Govt Depts/Autonomous bodies); for repairs, estimate by registered Engineers/Architects/Contractors accepted. Clause 10: applicant must put the prescribed scheme logo on front/prominent place of house after completion. 2nd installment on: reports of registered Engineers/Architects/Contractors on utilization of 1st installment; joint inspection by BDO or representative and official appointed by Director, Tribal Welfare; completion certificate; logo certificate issued by BDO with two photographs (logo with applicant, site of work); occupancy certificate from competent authority for Re-construction/New construction and bills for materials. If estimate prepared by contractors, EO (RE) of BDO office (Village Panchayat jurisdiction) or Municipal Engineer of Municipal Council certifies completion; BDO recommends 2nd installment to Director of Tribal Welfare.
schemes.valid_period: Amendment in force with immediate effect from date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Published in Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018 (Notification No. 1-349-2018-19/ADMN/DTW/Part-I/6896). Issued with concurrence of Finance (Exp.) Dept U.O. No. 1400059025 dated 10-12-2018. Benefit amounts of the principal scheme not in this document. Funding 'State' inferred from Directorate of Tribal Welfare/Finance concurrence. Two-column OCR text interleaved with a Personnel notification; clauses reconstructed.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method under Matrutva Yojana
schemes.target: Scheduled Tribe couples with infertility and no living issue
schemes.eligibility: Couples/Husband or Wife belonging to Scheduled Tribes; no income limit; only in cases of infertility and couple having no living issue (couples without children even after 3 years of marriage due to primary infertility or other medical reasons); benefit for birth of first born child; treatment at Government Hospitals or empanelled Private Hospitals/Nursing Homes in Goa.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance upto Rs. 5.00 Lakh for IVF or IUI treatment covering actual cost incl. diagnostic investigation, medicine, hospital admission, investigations needing admission or medical reasons during pregnancy, specialist fees, procedures like Laparoscopy, and delivery of baby. Unspent sanctioned amount may be used for delivery charges (restricted to Rs. 5.00 lakhs); expenditure above Rs. 5.00 Lakhs borne by beneficiary. Rates: one cycle IVF with medicine Rs. 1.00 lakh; one cycle IUI with medicine Rs. 15,000/-; Embryo Transfer Rs. 30,000/-; Embryo Freezing Rs. 30,000/-; Histroscopic Diagnostics Rs. 20,000/-; Laparoscopy Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 80,000/- (rates maintained two years, reviewed for medical inflation). Paid to empanelled hospital via Goa Scheduled Tribe Finance and Development Corporation.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit filled application form to Directorate of Tribal Welfare with: copy of provisional ST certificate (Dy. Collector or competent authority; mandatory), Marriage Certificate, Aadhar Card copy of couple, Birth Certificate, any medical papers. Empanelled hospitals/applicants submit doctor-certified bills to Directorate of Tribal Welfare.
schemes.notes: Amends clauses 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 and 15; other clauses unchanged. Also covers hospital empanelment criteria (18-24 months IUI/IVF experience, 25% success rate, empanelment for 5 years) and Monitoring Committee. Comes into force from date of publication (OG Series I No. 24 dated 09-09-2021). Gazette issue also contains PWD water tariff revision (free water up to 16m3/month) - not a scheme row.

schemes.name: Fisheries scheme (ref. Notification No. DF/PLG/NSWF/SCR/2014-15 dated 7-8-2015) - amended clauses 4 and 6
schemes.target: Full-time active fishers, BPL, aged 18-60
schemes.eligibility: (1) Full-time active fisher. (2) Member of a functional local fishers co-operative society/Federation/any other registered body. (3) Below Poverty Line (BPL) and between 18 and 60 years of age.
schemes.benefit: Quantum of grant-in-aid: fisherman contributes Rs. 1,500/- collected over 10 months; total contribution of Rs. 4,500/- distributed to the fishermen in 3 equal monthly instalments of Rs. 1,500/- each.
schemes.valid_period: w.e.f. year 2016-17
schemes.notes: Directorate of Fisheries Not. DF/PLG/BUD/2016-17 (Dr. Shamila Monteiro, Panaji 12th October 2016) in the same gazette; department field is the portal header. Scheme name not given; 'NSWF/SCR' in the reference suggests a fishermen welfare saving-cum-relief scheme but this is not stated. Funding split for the Rs. 4,500 not stated.

schemes.name: Kamdhenu Scheme (Sudharit) Amended
schemes.target: Dairy farmers buying crossbred cows/improved she buffaloes/indigenous breed cows
schemes.eligibility: Any person residing in Goa for at least 05 years; pucca cattle shed with cement flooring; undertake strict stall feeding (no open grazing); new entrants must undergo two weeks practical training on Government Farms; knowledge or experience in cattle/buffalo farming; land for green fodder desirable; farmer who availed purchase under earlier Kamdhenu Scheme (listed under eligibility); letter from financing institution with ECS willing to finance; purchase within one year of sanction. For purchases outside State: minimum 10 animals at a time, member of local Dairy Society/Bachat Gat/SHG, prior written permission, accompanied by Veterinary Doctor. Documents: residence certificate from Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Chairman of Dairy Society, Aadhaar, cattle shed affidavit, caste certificate of SC/ST/Dhangar, photograph.
schemes.benefit: Unit cost limited to Rs. 70,000/- per animal. Subsidy per animal - General: 1-5 and 6-10 animals Rs. 56000 (80%), 11-20 Rs. 35000 (50%), 21 & above Rs. 28000 (40%); SC/ST/Dhangar: 1-5 and 6-10 Rs. 63000 (90%), 11-20 Rs. 52500 (75%), 21 & above Rs. 35000 (50%). General category unemployed youth subsidy enhanced to 90% up to purchase of 10 animals. Transport incentive Rs. 1500/- per animal (outside State) or Rs. 600/- per animal (Department cattle melas) or actual, whichever less. Insurance premium reimbursed up to Rs. 9600/- per animal. Cost of animal credited if death within one month not due to negligence. Subsidy credited to loan account via ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply with documents verified by Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director of the area; financing institution submits purchase statement and documents to Head Office within 2 weeks of purchase; animals identified by microchip; insurance mandatory (min 3½ years).
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Not. 13-91/Kamd/(S)/2018-19/121, Official Gazette Series I No. 3 dated 19-04-2018; signing date not visible. Earlier amendments dated 19-06-2015, 02-09-2015, 23-09-2015, 05-08-2016, 16-09-2016. max_benefit_inr is per animal. Promotes 'Dudh Gram Villages'. Trimmed: some clauses cut off.

schemes.name: Kamdhenu Scheme Sudharit
schemes.target: Beneficiaries purchasing milch animals at departmental cattle melas
schemes.eligibility: Applies only to animals purchased at Cattle Melas organised at Cattle Breeding Farm, Copardem/Dhat; not for animals purchased from other States.
schemes.benefit: Clause 19: if animal yields less than 50% of expected milk yield within 20 days of calving, reported in writing to Area Officer and by fax to Director; on verification within 72 hours that it is not due to beneficiary negligence, cost of animal credited directly to beneficiary's loan account; animal returned to Government farm at beneficiary's cost.
schemes.notes: Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services Not. 13-91/Kamd/(S)/2015-16/3539. Official Gazette Series I No. 27 dated 01-10-2015; two-column text interleaved; trimmed.

schemes.name: Kissan Mitra
schemes.target: Persons appointed as Kissan Mitra
schemes.eligibility: No Kissan Mitra shall be appointed for more than 12 months but may be reappointed after cooling period of at least one month.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 15,000/- per month, paid by Zonal Agriculture Officers via ECS to bank account.
schemes.valid_period: In effect from July 2016 onwards
schemes.notes: Directorate of Agriculture Not. 1/2/51/2016-17/D.Agri/1029 in same gazette. Monthly amount (emolument). Two-column text interleaved.

schemes.name: Kissan Mitra (amendment of Rule 4(7) & 5)
schemes.target: Kissan Mitra appointees (Agriculture Dept)
schemes.eligibility: Rule 4(7): No Kissan Mitra shall be appointed for more than 12 months but may be reappointed after cooling period of at least one month.
schemes.benefit: Rule 5: selected Kissan Mitra paid Rs. 15,000/- per month, credited via ECS by respective Zonal Agriculture Officers to the Kissan Mitra's bank account.
schemes.valid_period: Effective from July, 2016 onwards
schemes.notes: Agriculture Dept Not. 1/2/51/2016-17/D.Agri/1029 (Tonca, Caranzalem, 14th October 2016) in the same gazette; department field is the portal header but issuer is Directorate of Agriculture. max_benefit_inr is a monthly figure (Rs. 15,000 per month). Finance concurrence 4984 dated 26-9-2016.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Scheme to provide financial assistance to organized/conduct programs)
schemes.target: Voluntary Organizations/NGOs/SHGs/Mahila Mandals/Youth Clubs/Sports Clubs/Sanskrutik Mandals, Forest Rights Act committees, Village Panchayats, Deputy Collector/SDO/BDO organising programmes for tribal communities
schemes.eligibility: Organisations must contribute 20% (proof required); must utilize amount for sanctioned purpose
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance to organise programmes (amount not stated in amendment). Amended clause 7(2): within 3 months of the activity, submit utilization certificate per GFR-19, proof of 20% contribution by the organisation, detailed accounts and report to Director of Tribal Welfare
schemes.how_to_apply: Revised application forms to Director, Directorate of Tribal Welfare, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji: Form A (VOs/NGOs/SHGs/Mahila Mandal/clubs - registration certificate, bank passbook, resolution, MoA/AoA, activity and financial details, Aadhar); Form B (Forest Rights Act committees - recommended by BDO/Dy. Director of Panchayat/Deputy Collector); Form C (Village Panchayats - Gram Sabha resolution, recommended by BDO); Form D (awareness programmes by Deputy Collector & SDO and BDO)
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/6/Sahayata/Scheme/13/Amendment/2017-18/5080, OG Series I No. 42 dated 13th January, 2022. Village Panchayats can also apply directly (Form C). Same gazette begins a notification on children of widow scheme (income limit Rs. 3,00,000) that is cut off; not extracted.

schemes.name: Scheme for providing employment in Government to the children of Freedom Fighters
schemes.target: Children of Freedom Fighters registered with the Home Department
schemes.eligibility: Eligible children of Freedom Fighters registered with the Home Department. Children who qualified for registration as on the date of publication of the principal notification but could not submit applications may apply within 30 days from publication of this notification.
schemes.benefit: Employment in Government (scheme validity extended; in clause 3(c) 'for two years' substituted by 'for four years' vis-a-vis posts filled through Goa Public Service Commission).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application within 30 days of publication of this notification (for those who could not apply earlier); office not stated.
schemes.valid_period: Extended for a further two years with effect from 1st March, 2015 (principal scheme was valid upto 28-2-2015)
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Home (Home-General Division), Not. 11/13/91/HD(G), in the same gazette issue (Series I No. 8, 21-5-2015); header department is Tribal Welfare because the portal file is filed under Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana.

schemes.name: Subsidy for custom service in agriculture
schemes.target: Farmers in Goa doing cultivation/transplanting
schemes.eligibility: All the farmers in Goa venturing for cultivation/transplanting shall be eligible for subsidy on hire charges of Agricultural Machineries.
schemes.benefit: 50% subsidy on hire charges under custom service for paddy harvesting by paddy combine withdrawn from Rabi 2014-15, compensated by increase of paddy assured price by Rs. 2 per kg (from Rs. 17 to Rs. 19 per kg).
schemes.valid_period: Effective from Rabi harvest 2014-15
schemes.notes: Directorate of Agriculture Not. 3/1/WS/2015-16/D.Agri./569. Official Gazette Series I No. 27 dated 01-10-2015; two-column text interleaved; trimmed.

schemes.name: The Goa, Grant-in-aid to Scheduled Tribe Hostels run by Voluntary Organization Rules, 2015

schemes.notes: Notification DTW/7/Hostel/Scheme/9/Amendment/2015-16/69/7423; effective retrospectively from publication of the 24-09-2015 notification. Administrative amendment only.

schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: NGOs and special schools setting up physiotherapy centres for PwDs
schemes.eligibility: As amended (visible parts): NGOs registered with the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and Special Schools recognized by Directorate of Education; Clause 6(1): NGO (applicant) should be registered with DEPwD (rest trimmed).
schemes.benefit: Clause 5(1) substituted: amount equivalent to 100% cost of setting up of the Physiotherapy Centre subject to maximum of Rs. 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five lakhs only), sanctioned by DEPwD and released in two equal installments.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application addressed to the Director, Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Porvorim-Goa, with copy of Certificate of Registration issued by DEPwD/Directorate of Social Welfare under RPwD Act, 2016.
schemes.notes: Not. 1/51/2024-25-DEPwD/Amen/Physiotherapy/580 in gazette Series I No. 41 dated 09-01-2025; date of the amendment itself not in extract. Two-column text interleaved with an unrelated post-creation order, so the eligibility substitution's clause number is unclear; some amendment clauses (3, 6-9) trimmed. Same gazette text as f8ed74e622.

schemes.name: Diamond Jubilee Government Investment for Technical Education Scheme (DJ-GIFT)
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Students enrolled in specified technical education institutions
schemes.eligibility: Continues to apply to eligible students enrolled in specified institutions in 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 with base fee and criteria notified for those years; for students admitted in 2025-26, must fulfil scheme eligibility criteria and annual family income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 12.00 lakhs p.a. in 2024-25.
schemes.benefit: Base fee for batch admitted in 2025-26: Diploma in Engineering Rs. 30,000/- p.a.; Diploma in Hotel Management & Catering Technology Rs. 75,000/- p.a.; Degree courses Rs. 1,10,000/- p.a. (2025-26), Rs. 1,20,000/- p.a. (2026-27), Rs. 1,30,000/- p.a. (2027-28), Rs. 1,40,000/- p.a. (2028-29).
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Education, Directorate of Technical Education (Not. DTE/DJ-GIFT EDUCATION SCHEME/2021-22/582/286); header department is DEPwD because it is in the same gazette (Series I No. 6, 08-05-2025). The notification sets the 'base fee' but does not state in this text how it translates to the per-student benefit, so max_benefit_inr left null. Not the portal-titled scheme.

schemes.name: Grant-in-aid for setting up of Accessible Library (Braille Library) for persons with visual disabilities
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: NGOs setting up accessible libraries for persons with visual disabilities
schemes.eligibility: NGO registered with DEPwD/Directorate of Social Welfare under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016; library for at least 25 persons with visual disabilities; NGO bears at least 20% of setting-up cost.
schemes.benefit: 80% cost of setting up the Accessible Library subject to maximum of Rs. 15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen lakhs only); to be utilized within six months (relaxable, never beyond 12 months).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application for GIA in prescribed format (Annexure-I) to the Director, Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Porvorim-Goa, with copy of Certificate of Registration under RPwD Act 2016.
schemes.notes: Not. 1/52/2024-25/DEPwD/Amen/Library/595. Exact scheme title not given in text. Inspection by Director DEPwD at least once a year; separate accounts open to check; DEPwD member on staff interview panel.

schemes.name: Scheme to provide Financial Assistance to NGO's for Running Day Care Centres for Persons with Disabilities (Jeevan Jyot)
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: NGOs/VOs running day care centres for persons with physical and intellectual disabilities
schemes.benefit: Administrative amendments: scheme title substituted; implementation by Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD); Sanctioning Committee = Minister DEPwD (Chairperson), Director DEPwD, Deputy Director DEPwD (Member Secretary); utilization certificate to DEPwD; Director DEPwD final authority on interpretation; applications addressed to Director, DEPwD, Porvorim.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to the Director, Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Porvorim-Goa.
schemes.notes: Not. 1/50/2024-25/DEPwD/Amen/JeevanJyot/585, OG Series I No. 41 dated 09-01-2025. Amendment transfers scheme administration from Social Welfare to DEPwD; no change to benefit amounts in this text. Gazette also contains Physiotherapy Centre scheme amendment (Not. /580, beginning cut off; 100% cost up to Rs. 5,00,000) and Accessible Library amendment (separate row).

schemes.name: Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance to the Groups of Traditional Folk Artists for purchase of Costume & Drapery
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Groups of traditional folk artists
schemes.eligibility: Eligible groups (other conditions in original 2006 scheme, not in text); number of beneficiaries subject to committee approval and budget availability.
schemes.benefit: Clause 5(b) substituted: lumpsum grants/financial assistance to the maximum extent of Rs. 25,000/- per group.
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Art & Culture (Not. DAC/2/Costume.sch.amend/2011); header department is DEPwD because it is in the same gazette (27-10-2011). Not the portal-titled scheme.

schemes.name: Assistance for Purchase of Agriculture Machinery & Equipments (amendment)

schemes.eligibility: Eligibility clause 2(ii) amended: Farmers should possess Krishi Card of State of Goa, except for Farmer Producer Companies (FPC)/Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO)/Limited Liability Partnerships (LLP) registered under Companies Act, 2013.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/1/Agri.Mech/AD(AE)/2023-24/D.Agri/205; Official Gazette Series I No. 22 dated 31-8-2023. Same PDF also contains unrelated PWD crash barrier policy (not extracted).

schemes.name: Assistance price for Agricultural Produce (amendment)
schemes.target: Farmers and groups of farmers selling produce
schemes.eligibility: 'or the Group of Farmers' added to eligibility clauses 3(a) and 3(e).
schemes.benefit: For paddy, for Group of farmers quantity considered on pro rata basis relative to individual farmer support; minimum quantity to be sold by farmer/group not less than 100 kgs.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/Crops & PP/67/Community Farming Group/D.Agri/75.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for purchase of "Kisan Drone" (under Promotion of Mechanization in Agriculture)
schemes.target: Individual farmers, Custom Hiring Centres/Hi-tech Hubs of farmer cooperative societies, FPOs and rural entrepreneurs buying Kisan Drones
schemes.eligibility: Purchase of Kisan Drone (unmanned aircraft system for spraying agro-chemicals/pesticides and soil & crop nutrients) by individual farmers, Custom Hiring Centers (CHC)/Hi-tech Hubs established by Co-operative Societies of farmers, FPOs and Rural Entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefit: Top-up subsidy of 10% of the cost limited to Rs. 1.00 lakh from State Government scheme budget, in addition to 40% of the cost limited to Rs. 4.00 lakhs (whichever is less) provided by Central Government under Sub Mission on Agriculture Mechanization guidelines.
schemes.funding: State top-up to Central SMAM assistance
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/1/Agri.Mech/AD(AE)/2023-24/D.Agri/110. State top-up max Rs 1.00 lakh; Central component separately max Rs 4.00 lakh. OCR columns interleaved.

schemes.name: Incentive to SRI farmers (amendment)
schemes.target: Farmers cultivating paddy by SRI method
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating SRI from Rabi 2013-14 in a minimum area of 1000 m2.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 10,000/- per hectare on pro rata basis to compensate additional labour for row planting and conoweeder operation etc.
schemes.notes: Official Gazette Series I No. 43 dated 23-01-2014. Max is per hectare. Parent scheme name taken from related addendum/other docs.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Amendment
schemes.target: Loanee and non-loanee farmers
schemes.benefit: As per revamped PMFBY guidelines scheme continues for remaining 2 years of the tender, Kharif 2020 to Rabi 2021-22 (overall 3 years). Enrolment made voluntary for all farmers (loanee & non-loanee); loanee farmers may opt out by submitting prescribed form to bank branch 7 days before enrolment cut-off date.
schemes.how_to_apply: Loanee farmers wishing to opt out apply at concerned bank branch.
schemes.valid_period: Kharif 2020 till Rabi 2021-22
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 17 dated 23-07-2020. Index also lists Scheme for Promotion of Beekeeping Industry (Amendment) by Industries, not in text.

schemes.name: Promoting Improved Technology in Food Grain Crops (addendum to eligibility)
schemes.target: Groups/individuals and institutions
schemes.eligibility: At 4. Eligibility, Para IV: word 'only' before 'groups/individuals' deleted and 'Institutions/Societies with agriculture development as mandate' added.
schemes.benefit: Assistance to popularize time saving cultivation technique such as mechanized transplanter. 50% subsidy limited to Rs. 1.00 lakhs.
schemes.notes: Addendum No. 3/CIN/Crops/50/Prom.Tech.in Food Grain Crops/2017-18/D.Agri/489; appears on a later page (Official Gazette Series I No. 24, 14 Sept 2017).

schemes.name: Promoting Improved Technology in Food Grain Crops (amendment)
schemes.target: Food grain farmers
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/crops & PP/50/Prom.of Imp.Tech/2021-22/D.Agri/373. Text of the amendment is OCR-garbled (struck-through style) and unreadable; only references visible.

schemes.name: Promotion of Mechanization in Agriculture (amendment to clause 3(x))
schemes.target: Farmers purchasing agricultural machinery/equipment
schemes.eligibility: Machinery/equipment to be purchased from approved Agriculture Machinery dealers registered with the Department of Agriculture or any Agriculture Machinery dealers from outside the State.
schemes.benefit: Clause 3(x) amended: if machinery is purchased from outside the State, the beneficiary shall obtain from the manufacturer/dealer a letter of assurance of after-sales service/warranty and guarantee terms; any disputes over after-sales service/warranty/guarantee are the sole responsibility of the beneficiary to settle with the dealer/manufacturer. Other contents unchanged.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/1/Agri.Mech/AD(AE)/2023-24/D.Agri/108; published Official Gazette Series I No. 16 dated 20-07-2023. Two-column OCR is interleaved; wording reconstructed.

schemes.name: Scheme for Assistance for Purchase of Laptop/Camera for Journalists, 2021 (Amendment)
schemes.target: Working journalists and photo-journalists
schemes.eligibility: Continuous working journalist as defined under the scheme; may avail again after 5 years of deriving benefit; application form says 8 years experience and 15 years domicile certificate from Mamlatdar; declaration to take responsibility for maintenance.
schemes.benefit: Government grant for Computer/Laptop/tablet/iPad/Smartphone restricted to maximum of Rs. 50,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application Form A with documents (domicile certificate, employer evidence, pay slip, age proof, two photos) to Director, Department of Information and Publicity, Udyog Bhavan, 3rd floor, Panaji.
schemes.notes: Department of Information & Publicity notification DI/INF/79/LCS/2021/8492 in same gazette; header department is Fisheries.

schemes.name: Scheme for providing employment in Government to the children of freedom fighters - acceptance of belated applications
schemes.target: Children of freedom fighters registered with the Home Department
schemes.eligibility: Belated applications accepted after due date; considered only after present applications are disposed off; no right to employment or seniority.
schemes.benefit: Employment in Government (scheme extended two years w.e.f. 1st March 2015; no further extension).
schemes.how_to_apply: Home Department (General), Secretariat, Porvorim.
schemes.valid_period: Extended for two years w.e.f. 01-03-2015; no further extension
schemes.notes: Home Department notification No. 11/13/91-HD(G)/2028 appearing on the same gazette page; header department is Fisheries but issuing department is Home.

schemes.name: State Sector Scheme - Assured Price for Agricultural Produce (Amendment)
schemes.target: Coconut and cashew growers (and paddy, arecanut, alsando claims)
schemes.eligibility: Coconut: max 100000 nuts per beneficiary for max 10 ha with 1600 bearing trees; not more than 10,000 nuts per ha. Cashew: max 4000 kg per cultivator for max 10 ha; minimum 50 kg; area registered under Krishi Card considered. Apply within one year of sale with copy of Krishi Card; produce bought by traders registered with the Directorate, paid cashless.
schemes.benefit: Coconut: average minimum price not less than Rs. 6/- per nut; maximum assured price to an individual farmer shall not exceed Rs. 9.00 lakhs. Cashew: assured price Rs. 170/kg, paying difference between Rs. 170/kg and price received, max difference Rs. 50/kg.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed form with copy of Krishi Card and trader's online payment receipt/cheque details; Zonal Agricultural Officer verifies; District Agriculture Officer issues sanction; ZAO disburses through designated bank.
schemes.notes: Directorate of Agriculture notification 3/3/Hort/SSS/2-A/2024-25/D.Agri/533 in same gazette; header department is Fisheries. Rs. 9.00 lakh cap stated for coconut.

schemes.name: e-Goa (Subsidy to clay Idol makes) Scheme, 2008
schemes.target: Clay idol makers (artisans)
schemes.benefit: Corrigendum: figure at para 5 substituted to read 250 per Artisan per year instead of 150 per Artisan per year; Rs. 15,000/- wherever appearing substituted by Rs. 25,000/-.
schemes.notes: Department of Industries corrigendum (8/11/2007-IND) printed in same gazette issue; the department field follows the portal header. Units of '250 per Artisan per year' not stated in visible text. Rs. 25,000 context not visible, so max_benefit_inr left null.

schemes.name: Debt Relief Scheme for mining affected Borrowers of Financial Institutions (extension)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Mining-affected borrowers of financial institutions
schemes.eligibility: Extension limited to proposals pending with banks or those rejected earlier.
schemes.benefit: Scheme validity extended up to 31-12-2017 from date of expiry; final authority to grant benefit fully or partly in exceptional cases lies with Chief Minister. Benefit amounts not stated in this notice.

schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Mines & Geology (Not. DMG/SCHEME/LOAN/PART-III/2298), printed in the same gazette as the Umbrella Scheme; department field is from the portal header.

schemes.name: Increase in number of dialysis per month under Goa Mediclaim Scheme and Medical Reimbursement
schemes.department: Directorate Of Sports And Youth Affairs
schemes.target: Patients undergoing dialysis at private recognized hospitals
schemes.benefit: Increase in number of dialysis from 10 to 12 per month @ Rs 1300/- per dialysis to all patients undergoing dialysis in private recognized hospitals under Goa Mediclaim Scheme and Medical Reimbursement.
schemes.notes: Scanned gazette pages with very poor text layer (heavily garbled); only fragments legible, details may be wrong or missing. schemes.name: Pashupalan Scheme - Phase 1 (Artificial Insemination incentive)
schemes.target: Owners of non-descript cows and buffaloes

schemes.notes: Amount is per month

schemes.name: Pashupalan Scheme - Phase 3 (Female calf rearing)
schemes.target: Owners of cross-bred/improved/indigenous female calves; 100% for SC/ST/Dhangar

schemes.benefit: Rs.4,000/- incentive on birth of female calf to local cow/buffalo; feed allowance birth to 27 months as subsidy @ 75% of estimated expenditure (100% for S.C./S.T. & Dhangar): 1-3 months Rs.5,625/-; 4-6 months Rs.2,625/-; 7-9 months Rs 3,3375/-; 10-12 months Rs 3,3375/-; 13-15, 16-18, 19-21, 22-24 months Rs.4,800/- each; 25-27 months Rs.5,400/-
schemes.how_to_apply: Intimation of birth in Form No. IV through area officer; Area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer submits quarterly weight gain certificate (Annexure A); subsidy credited to bank account
schemes.notes: Table shows 'Rs 3,3375/-' for 7-9 and 10-12 months (likely typo for Rs.3,375/-, 75% of Rs.4500/-); copied as written

schemes.notes: forms also available at BDO office / Fisheries Surveyor in Panchayat

schemes.funding: Centre and State (Central share 50% of eligible subsidy limited to Rs.15,000; State Rs.45,000)
schemes.notes: forms also available at BDO office / Fisheries Surveyor in Panchayat

schemes.target: ST students in higher education (scholarship)
schemes.eligibility: Candidates admitted to courses in notified Universities/Institutes.
schemes.benefit: Scholarship (amount not stated).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at www.scholarships.gov.in after taking admission. Guidelines: https://tribal.nic.in/schemes.aspx
schemes.notes: Central Ministry scheme; benefit amounts not stated.

schemes.name: Scheme of National Overseas Scholarships for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
schemes.target: ST candidates studying abroad
schemes.eligibility: Total family income from all sources of the employed candidate or parents/guardians or spouse not above Rs. 6.00 lakh per annum (excluding allowances not treated as income for income-tax), as certified by employer. Airfare only for applicants with a post-graduation degree in science, technical and engineering subjects.
schemes.benefit: Grant for tuition fees, educational expenses, travelling and living expenses; airfare for those with a PG degree in science, technical and engineering subjects.
schemes.how_to_apply: Send application to: Director, SCD-V Section, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Room No. 211, 'D Wing', Shastri Bhavan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Marg, New Delhi-110001. Guidelines: www.tribal.nic.in, https://www.india.gov.in/national-overseas-scholarships-scheduled
schemes.notes: Central scheme; address given is Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (as written).

schemes.name: Grant in Aid to Voluntary Organizations for Running Hostels for ST Students
schemes.target: Voluntary organisations running hostels for ST students
schemes.eligibility: Hostel premises in good sanitary condition and passed by the taluka Health Officer; adequate sleeping and dining accommodation; free food and lodging for inmates; provision for indoor/outdoor games and simple medicines/first aid; inmates regularly attend courses; annual income of inmates' parents not above Rs. 3,00,000/-.
schemes.benefit: Maintenance grant Rs. 1500/- per month per student for 12 months; wages for 12 months: Resident Superintendent Rs. 15,000/- p.m., Clerk cum attendant Rs. 10,000/- p.m., Cook Rs. 10,000/- p.m., Asst. cook Rs. 8,000/- p.m., 2 Security Guards Rs. 10,000/-; Medical reimbursement Rs. 50,000/- p.a.; maintenance of kitchen/sports equipment & musical instruments Rs. 5,000/- p.m.; water purifier up to Rs. 15,000/- (one time); hostel rent as fixed by PWD valuation.
schemes.notes: Multiple grant components to the institution kept in one row. max_benefit_inr is the largest single stated amount (medical reimbursement p.a.). Documents: students' ST & Income certificates, mark sheets, attendance certificate, staff muster roll, bills/vouchers, bank details, Aadhar.

schemes.name: Merit Based Award and Recognition of High Performance in SSC and HSSC Board Exams - Felicitation of Rank Holders
schemes.target: Top-ranked ST students in SSC/HSSC
schemes.eligibility: ST students who are among the First Five Rank Holders of SSC, and First Five Rank Holders of HSSC (separately for Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational streams). No income ceiling.
schemes.benefit: Felicitation in a public function and Rs. 20,000/-.
schemes.notes: Documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Mark Sheet, Fee receipt, Bank Pass Book, Aadhaar Card with consent form.

schemes.name: Merit Based Award and Recognition of High Performance in SSC and HSSC Board Exams - Merit Based Award
schemes.target: ST students scoring 50%+ in SSC/HSSC
schemes.eligibility: ST students with annual family income less than Rs. 5,00,000/- who secure the benchmark percentage (50% and above) in SSC/HSSC Board exams.
schemes.notes: Documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Mark Sheet, Fee receipt, Bank Pass Book, Aadhaar Card with consent form.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Financial Assistance to Organized Programmes) - BDOs, Dy. Collector & SDO, PRIs and FRA Committees
schemes.target: Government offices, PRIs and FRA committees organising programmes for STs
schemes.eligibility: Panchayat Raj Institutions/Committees constituted under the Forest Right Act; Dy. Collector & SDO; Block Development Officer.
schemes.benefit: Financial Assistance of Rs. 50,000/-.
schemes.notes: Documents (BDOs, Dy. Collector & SDO): details of proposed activity, financial implication, bank account details for ECS.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Financial Assistance to Organized Programmes) - NGOs, SHGs and community groups
schemes.target: NGOs/SHGs/Mahila Mandals/clubs working for ST welfare
schemes.eligibility: NGOs registered under an appropriate law at least 2 years before applying; must submit audited accounts of last two years and MoA & AoA; must be working for welfare of Scheduled Tribes, with activities for that cause. Also NGOs/Self Help Group/Mahila Mandal/Youth club/sport club/sanskrutik mandal.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 80000/- per financial year for conducting minimum 2 and maximum 4 activities/programmes; Directorate provides 80% of programme cost, remaining 20% contributed by the NGO/SHG etc.

schemes.name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Funeral and Religious Ceremonies of ST Families under 'Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana'
schemes.target: Bereaved ST families
schemes.eligibility: Deceased or applicant must be ST with family income not above Rs. 3.00 lakh per annum; if applicant is non-ST and deceased is ST, applicant must establish first relationship with the deceased. Claim by next of kin within 12 months of death.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs. 20,000/- or actual cost whichever is less.
schemes.notes: Documents: Caste Certificate, Death (or death & burial) Certificate, Income Certificate, Ration card, Election Card, proof of relationship, Aadhar, vouchers/receipts, bank pass book.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Construction/Re-Construction of House under Atal Asra Yojana
schemes.target: ST families needing a new/rebuilt house
schemes.eligibility: Any individual from ST community of Goa with family income up to Rs. 3.00 lakhs per annum.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 3.00 lakhs for construction of new house / re-construction of existing house.
schemes.notes: Documents include affidavit, house tax receipt, income & ST certificates, IAY/RAY sanction order (if any), estimate from registered engineer/architect/contractor, bank details, photo, Aadhar, ration card, plus ownership documents/NOC and Construction License from Competent Authority.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Repairs of House under Atal Asra Yojana
schemes.target: ST families needing house repairs
schemes.eligibility: Any individual from ST community of Goa with family income up to Rs. 3.00 lakhs per annum.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs. 1.50 lakhs for repairs of existing house.
schemes.notes: Documents include affidavit, house tax receipt, income & ST certificates, estimate from registered engineer/architect/contractor, bank details, photo of existing house with applicant, Aadhar, ration card.

schemes.name: Scheme to Support Children of Widow belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community
schemes.target: Minor ST children of widows on DSS
schemes.eligibility: Widow who is a DSS beneficiary (ST, or non-ST with ST minor children) with minor children up to 18 years; benefit limited to 2 children.
schemes.benefit: Fixed maintenance allowance of Rs. 1500/- per month per child.
schemes.notes: Documents: marriage certificate, husband's death certificate, ST certificate of husband or children, children's birth certificates, DSS sanction order, children's Aadhar, joint bank account pass book (applicant + beneficiary).

schemes.name: Scheme to Support Orphan Child belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community
schemes.target: ST orphan children
schemes.eligibility: Orphan ST child up to 18 years under care of a guardian (grandparents or near relatives) or in a protective home/Dharmasala etc.
schemes.benefit: Fixed maintenance allowance of Rs. 2000/- per month per orphan child.
schemes.notes: Documents: parents' death certificates, child's ST and birth certificates, guardian's ration/election card, child's Aadhar, joint bank account pass book (applicant + orphan child).

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Community Level Action for Growth of Agriculture and Conservation Management Plan of Community Forest Resources under 'Sheti Samrudhi Yojana'
schemes.target: Tribal farmers' co-operatives and Forest Rights Act committees
schemes.eligibility: Tribal Farmers Co-operatives registered under the Co-operative Societies Act for improved productivity or marketing of farm/forest produce; Gram Sabha committees managing Community Forest Resources under FRA; Forest Right Committees under FRA; Village Panchayat in whose jurisdiction such co-operative/committees are constituted.
schemes.benefit: For running activities: (1) wages of one clerical assistant and one peon at Minimum Wages Act rates; (2) fixed Rs. 25,000/- per annum for stationery, printing etc.; (3) one-time Rs. 1,00,000/- for desktop computer, UPS, computer table, cupboard, tables and chairs etc.; (4) office rent per annum as per PWD (Bldg Division) rent certificate.
schemes.notes: Village Panchayats listed as eligible recipients. Documents include Village Panchayat/Gram Sabha resolution, survey records, FRC notification, ZAO recommendation, co-operative registration, member lists, ST certificates, rent certificates, project report, mandate form. Stray '45' in text after component (1) appears to be a page artefact.

schemes.name: Udyog Adhar Yojana - Value addition and skill development
schemes.target: ST producers/artisans and NGOs
schemes.eligibility: Individual or group of ST category with own capacity to produce/make/market the product for exhibition cum sale; NGOs working for ST people.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for value addition in products and skill development, maximum Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum. 50% advance as 1st instalment, balance on production of receipts/bills.
schemes.notes: Requires certificate from Sarpanch of Village Panchayat or Chairperson of Municipal Council/BDO that applicant is involved in production/marketing. Other documents: ST certificate, Aadhar, cost estimate, mandate form & bank pass book; NGOs: registration certificate, event report, two years audit report. Stray '47' in text is a page artefact.

schemes.name: Udyog Adhar Yojana - Preparatory work for exhibitions
schemes.target: ST producers/artisans and NGOs
schemes.eligibility: Individual or group of ST category with own capacity to produce/make/market the product; NGOs working for ST people.
schemes.benefit: Assistance for preparatory work (raw materials, making charges, labour charges etc.) for participating in or organising exhibition/fair/workshop, maximum Rs. 50,000/- per annum. 50% advance, balance on bills.
schemes.notes: Requires certificate from Sarpanch/Municipal Council Chairperson/BDO of involvement in production/marketing.

schemes.name: Udyog Adhar Yojana - Participation costs (transport, fees, daily allowance)
schemes.target: ST producers/artisans participating in exhibitions
schemes.eligibility: Individual or group of ST category with own capacity to produce/make/market the product.
schemes.benefit: Actual cost of transportation, participation fees and daily allowance, maximum Rs. 50000/- per annum, to participate in exhibition/fair/workshop. 50% advance, balance on bills.
schemes.notes: Requires certificate from Sarpanch/Municipal Council Chairperson/BDO of involvement in production/marketing.

schemes.name: Udyog Adhar Yojana - Organising exhibitions/fairs by NGOs
schemes.target: NGOs organising exhibitions for ST people
schemes.eligibility: NGOs working for the benefit of ST people organising exhibition/fair/workshop for ST people to participate.
schemes.benefit: Actual cost of organising exhibition/fairs/workshop, maximum Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum. 50% advance, balance on bills.
schemes.notes: NGOs must submit registration certificate, event and beneficiary report, two years audit report.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for Infertility of ST Couples by IVF under 'Matrutva Yojana'
schemes.target: ST couples with primary infertility
schemes.eligibility: Couples belonging to Scheduled Tribes; no income limit; only for cases of primary infertility.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 5,00,000/- (written as 'Rs.5,00,000/- lakhs only').
schemes.notes: Amount written ambiguously as 'Rs.5,00,000/- lakhs'; taken as Rs. 5,00,000. Documents: ST certificate, marriage certificate, doctor's certificate and reports, Aadhaar and birth certificates of both spouses, mandate form with bank pass book.

schemes.name: Scheme for Training under Driving School
schemes.target: ST youth learning to drive
schemes.eligibility: ST community of Goa; minimum age 18 years (non-professional license) or 21 years (professional license); bonafide student of the driving school; passed at least Std. VIII; not already a driving license holder; family income not above Rs. 1.00 Lakh.
schemes.benefit: Driving school training (amount not stated).
schemes.notes: Benefit amount not stated. Documents: ST Certificate, age proof, education certificate, 1 passport photo.

schemes.name: Caravan Tourism Policy
schemes.department: Department of Tourism, Government of Goa
schemes.target: Caravan tourism operators (new caravans registered in Goa with RTO and Department of Tourism)
schemes.eligibility: Caravan vehicles must be: Registered in RTO Goa, and Registered with the Department of Tourism, Government of Goa. | Caravans must be operational in Goa for atleast one year from the date of registration with Department of Tourism. | Incentives are limited to maximum of 10 Caravans per operator/entity. | Vehicles must be purchased during the operative period of the Policy and comply with Central Motor Vehicles Rules and Automotive Industry Standards (AIS-124/AIS-113). | Only new Caravans are eligible. | Incentives are available on a first-come-first-served basis, subject to limits specified in the policy.
schemes.benefit: Capital cost reimbursement: Up to ₹20 lakh (first 10 caravans), ₹10 lakh (11–30), and ₹5 lakh (31–50), or a percentage of cost, whichever is less. | Road tax reimbursement: 25%, 15%, or 10% of tax paid (based on caravan number), with per-vehicle caps. | Registration fee reimbursement: Actual fee or ₹1,000 per year (whichever is less) for 3 years, limited to first 50 caravans.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application mode: Online. 1. Log in to the UDP Goa website. 2. Select Caravan Tourism Policy from the list of schemes. 3. Click on the Apply button. 4. You will be automatically redirected to the Goa Online Portal to submit your application. Apply link: https://goaonline.gov.in/Appln/UIL/deptServices?__DocId=TOU&__ServiceId=TOU24 Contact: dir-tour.goa@nic.in
schemes.valid_period: Policy valid for 3 years from notification in the Official Gazette (9 Nov 2023), extendable at the discretion of the Department of Tourism
schemes.notified_on: 2023-11-01 (Notification 3/9(30)/Caravan)/2023-DT; Official Gazette Series I No. 32, 9 Nov 2023)
schemes.notes: max_rupees is the largest cap stated: capital cost reimbursement up to Rs 20 lakh for the first 10 caravans (or a percentage of cost, whichever is less); incentives limited to 10 caravans per operator. Scheme PDFs on the portal: Caravan Tourism Policy Details <https://api.msme.goa.gov.in//Schemes/DetailsAndDocuments/f7603169-572a-4c40-8f2f-34e04650d02b.pdf>

schemes.name: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India
schemes.target: Agencies setting up Livelihood/Technology Business Incubators; rural and agro-based entrepreneurs
schemes.eligibility: Any individual who wants to start a business, particularly in rural and agro-based industries, and is above 18 years old. | Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) with a valid Udyam Registration. | Technical institutes, universities, and research centers, especially those focusing on rural and agricultural sectors.
schemes.benefit: Maximum of INR 1 crore to Government agencies & INR 75 lakh to Private agencies for procuring plant and machinery. | Maximum of INR 1 crore. to Government and Private agencies as operational expenditure support towards manpower cost, running incubation and skill development programmers, etc.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application mode: Online. 1. The applicant organisation will select a Mentor Institute and upload the proposal through the selected Mentor Institute as per the prescribed format online at www.aspire.msme.gov.in. 2. The proposals in soft copy may be sent by the applicant organisation to the Mentor Institute and subsequently to the Ministry at js.ari@nic.in. 3. The list of the designated Mentor Institute along with their contact details will be available on the portal www.aspire.msme.gov.in. 4. For more support, reach out to DITC, Udyog Bhavan, Near Azad Maidan, Panjim, Goa-403001. Apply link: https://aspire.msme.gov.in/ASPIRE/AFHome.aspx Contact: js.ari@nic.in
schemes.notes: max_rupees = INR 1 crore cap for Government agencies (plant and machinery) and operational support. The 27-page ASPIRE guidelines PDF on the portal is a scanned image with no extractable text, so validity and dates could not be read. schemes.target: IT units in Goa recruiting freshers through campus placement from institutes in Goa

schemes.benefit: Recruitment assistance of INR 10,000 per Fresher | Subsidy provided as one-time rebate per Fresher | Subsidy provided only after Fresher completes minimum 6 months of continuous employment | Subsidy applicable only for campus recruitment done during policy period

schemes.eligibility: The Scheme covers artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 trades.viz | (i) Carpenter (Suthar/Badhai); (ii) Boat Maker; (iii) Armourer; (iv) Metalsmith/Metal Caster (Lohar); (v) Hammer and Tool Kit Maker; (vi) Locksmith; (vii) Goldsmith (Sonar); (viii) Potter (Kumhaar); (ix) Sculptor (Moortikar, stone carver), Stone breaker; (x) Cobbler (Charmakar)/ Shoesmith/Footwear artisan; (xi) Mason (Rajmistri); (xii) Basket/ Mat/Broom Maker/Coir Weaver; (xiii) Doll & Toy Maker (Traditional); (xiv) Barber (Naai); (xv) Garland maker (Malakaar); (xvi) Washerman (Dhobi); (xvii) Tailor (Darzi); and (xviii) Fishing Net Maker.
schemes.benefit: Recognition: Artisans receive PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card for formal recognition. | Skill Upgradation: Basic (5–7 days) and Advanced (15+ days) training with ₹500/day stipend and ₹1,000 transport allowance. | Toolkit Incentive: E‑voucher up to ₹15,000 for purchase of modern tools. | Credit Support: Collateral‑free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest with Government interest subvention. | Digital Incentive: ₹1 per digital transaction, up to 100 transactions per month. | Marketing Support: Assistance for branding, quality certification, e‑commerce (GeM) onboarding, and market linkages.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application mode: Online. 1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and required documents. 2. Complete online registration and application for the scheme with CSC assistance. 3. Submit the application and track status using the acknowledgement/reference number. 4. For more support, reach out to DITC, Udyog Bhavan, Near Azad Maidan, Panjim, Goa-403001. Apply link: https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in/Home/HowToRegister Contact: champions@gov.in
schemes.valid_period: Scheme benefits valid till 31 Mar 2026 (MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme Guidelines 2022)
schemes.notified_on: Guidelines 2022 (Quality Council of India / Ministry of MSME); exact date not in the PDF

Select Promotion and Marketing Assistance Scheme from the list of offline schemes. 5. Click on the Application Form button to download. 6. Enter your name, mobile number, email ID and district to show your interest. 7. Fill out the form and attach the required documents. 8. Upon incurring the eligible expenditure, submit the application to the concerned department in the prescribed format. Contact: dir-dit.goa@nic.gov.in

schemes.eligibility: Applicant must be a SITPC-certified start-up with a valid start-up certificate. | The start-up must not operate from a government-developed co-working space, incubator, or accelerator. | The Directors' bank accounts must be linked with Aadhaar. | Lease rental subsidy is available only to Local Start-ups for up to 2 years. | Only digitally paid expenditure incurred after the notification of the Goa Start-up Policy 2021 and within the policy validity is eligible for reimbursement. Expenditure through non-digital payments may be considered as per SITPC guidelines. | A Local Start-up is one in which at least 50% equity/shareholding has been held by one or more Goans since inception. | A Goan is a person born in Goa, domiciled in Goa for 10 years or more, or the spouse of a Goan through a marriage registered in Goa.
schemes.benefit: Privately owned premises: Reimbursement of up to ₹1 lakh per quarter towards internet connectivity, software licence fees, and cloud service charges for up to 1 year (available to 20 start-ups per year). | Rented premises: Reimbursement of up to ₹1 lakh per quarter towards internet connectivity, software licence fees, and cloud service charges for up to 1 year (available to 20 start-ups per year). | Lease rental subsidy: Eligible local start-ups operating from rented premises can receive a subsidy of up to ₹20 per sq. ft. per month, reimbursed quarterly for up to 2 years, subject to a maximum of ₹3 lakh per annum (available to 25 start-ups per year). | Benefit selection: A start-up can avail either reimbursement of operational expenses or the lease rental subsidy at any given time. | Approval: Benefits are subject to approval by SITPC and are not an entitlement.

schemes.name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
schemes.department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Government of India
schemes.target: Clusters of at least 50 traditional artisans (khadi, village and coir industries) implemented through NGOs, government bodies, PRIs or collectives via an SPV
schemes.eligibility: Coverage & Clusters: Supports Khadi, Village & Coir industries; min. 50 artisans per cluster; Regular (≤500) and Major (>500). | Grants: Up to ₹2.5 cr for Regular clusters and ₹5 cr for Major clusters. | Focus Groups: SC/ST, women, disadvantaged communities; priority to aspirational districts, endangered crafts, hilly & NE regions. | Implementing Structure: NGOs, govt bodies, PRIs, collectives; mandatory SPV with 2/3 artisan governance; private equity capped at 50%. | Funding Pattern: GoI grant covers 90–95%; balance by IA/SPV; land to be arranged by IA (min. 15-year lease). | Support & Approvals: Technical Agency prepares DPR and guides training/marketing; approval via PSC → SSC. | Timeline & Objectives: 12–18 months completion; aims to boost artisan income, competitiveness, market access, and green production.
schemes.benefit: Regular clusters (≤500 artisans): GoI grant up to ₹2.5 crore (95% NER/hilly, 90% others). | Major clusters (>500 artisans): GoI grant up to ₹5 crore. | Funding: Soft interventions 100% GoI; hard interventions 90–95% GoI. | Technical assistance fee: 40% on approval, 30% on functionalization, 30% on handover. | Implementing agency cost: 50% on approval, 50% after two-thirds fund use. | Grant release: 50% on approval; 50% after two-thirds utilization + UC.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application mode: Online. 1. Eligible agencies or organizations may submit the proposal online. The applicant agency or organization needs to visit the SFURTI Portal and register or sign up by entering their correct details. 2. The applicant or organization then needs to log in using their ID on the SFURTI Portal and fill out the application form completely. 3. Upload all the relevant documents, verify the details, and submit the application form. 4. For more support, reach out to DITC, Udyog Bhavan, Near Azad Maidan, Panjim, Goa-403001. Apply link: https://my.msme.gov.in/MyMsmeMob/MsmeScheme/Pages/1_3_7.html Contact: sfurti.kvic@gmail.com
schemes.notified_on: Revised SFURTI guidelines circulated by Ministry of MSME letter dated 9 Sep 2022 (earlier guidelines 6 Mar 2020)
schemes.notes: max_rupees = Rs 5 crore GoI grant cap for major clusters (Rs 2.5 crore regular clusters). Grant goes to the implementing agency/SPV, not to individual artisans. schemes.name: Co-Working Spaces / Incubators / Accelerators Subsidy Scheme
schemes.department: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
schemes.target: SITPC-certified start-ups taking seats at co-working spaces, incubators or accelerators listed by SITPC
schemes.eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC; payment to the listed co-working space/incubator/accelerator must be digital (SITPC may admit otherwise per guidelines); start-up bank account linked to Aadhaar; address proof of an operational office in Goa; bank account in Goa.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 50% of per-seat cost at SITPC-listed spaces: max INR 3,000 per seat at co-working spaces (up to 2 years), INR 5,000 per seat at incubators (up to 1 year), INR 6,000 per seat at accelerators (up to 3 months); cap of 8 seats per start-up; 100 co-working seats and 50 seats each at incubators and accelerators subsidised per year; SITPC may reimburse up to 100% for deserving start-ups per its internal guidelines. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT1901). DPIIT-recognised startups can apply directly for all Goa Startup Policy 2021 schemes via Startup India login on the portal.

schemes.name: Goa Startup Policy 2025 (policy document)
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
schemes.target: IT and non-IT startups in Goa; IT applications funded by DITE&C, non-IT applications funded by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.eligibility: Start-up as defined in the policy: up to ten years from incorporation/registration in Goa and/or operating in Goa; annual turnover not exceeding INR 100 crore in any preceding financial year; Private Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm or LLP; working on innovation/improvement of a product, process or service and/or a scalable business model; not formed by splitting up an existing business. In operation for at least three months before registration; grandfathering for startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies. Disbursements of INR 50,000 or less need the Director (ITE&C) approval for IT startups / Director of Industries for non-IT startups; all funds disbursed only on SITPC recommendation; quarterly financial, milestone and utilisation-certificate reports required.
schemes.benefit: Vision: Goa as creative capital and startup destination by 2028; mission 1,000 startups, 10,000 local jobs, 100 venture-funded startups, 50 government collaborations. Twelve schemes: Campus Innovation; Promotion and Marketing Assistance; Skill Enhancement; Women Entrepreneur Vitality; R&D Reimbursement; Salary Reimbursement; Lease Subsidy; Seed Capital Grant; Intellectual Property Rights; Trademarks Reimbursement; Co-working Space/Incubators Subsidy; Incubator Grant. Also Fund of Funds, 24x7 operation, inspection exemptions, single-window portal, 4-day certification.
schemes.how_to_apply: Single-window portal run by SITPC; SITPC due diligence (with a screening committee of experts) then Empowered Committee approval, except Campus Innovation, Promotion and Marketing Assistance and Women Entrepreneur Vitality which SITPC approves itself.

schemes.name: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 (policy document)
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa (Startup Promotion Cell)
schemes.target: Technology start-ups (pure-play innovation powered by engineering or internet-based software/technology)
schemes.eligibility: Start-up: up to seven years from incorporation/registration in Goa; annual turnover not exceeding INR 25 crore; pure-play technology innovation. Local start-up: at least 50% equity held by Goans since inception.
schemes.benefit: Seven funds (Idea-to-PoC, Seed Capital, Working Capital, One-time Grant, R&D, Student Innovation, Skill Development); financial incentives: stamp duty cap INR 100, incubator infrastructure loans up to INR 1 crore, interest-subsidised loans, interest grants, 25% matching grant, seed grant up to INR 10 lakh, convertible loan up to INR 10 lakh, 50% patent reimbursement (caps 2/5 lakh), 50% trademark reimbursement, salary reimbursement (fresher cap INR 10,000/month), premises expenses up to INR 1 lakh/quarter, lease subsidy INR 20/sq ft, 50% R&D reimbursement up to INR 5 lakh p.a.; technology fellowships; 50% procurement preference.
schemes.how_to_apply: Online single window run by the Startup Promotion Cell; incentives decided by a committee headed by the Chief Minister.
schemes.valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).

schemes.name: Land / Built Up Area Rebate Scheme, 2018
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa (Empowered Committee / Due Diligence Committee under Goa IT Policy 2018)
schemes.target: IT units buying land or built-up office space in Goa
schemes.eligibility: New and Existing IT Units with operations in Goa, constituted as a Proprietorship, Private Limited, Public Limited, Registered Partnership or LLP; registered with DoIT under Goa IT Policy 2018 (common application form Part 1). Units availing similar incentives under any other Goa policy are not eligible. Benefits subject to budgetary allocation. Existing units may claim for transactions up to 3 years before policy notification; new units for transactions after notification.
schemes.benefit: One-time rebate on land purchase of INR 40,000 per male employee (INR 50,000 per female employee) up to 60% of land cost, maximum INR 1.5 crore; or one-time rebate up to 20% of the cost of built-up office space, maximum INR 1 crore; one option per unit; employment proportional to space (up to 80 sq ft per employee) with employees on rolls 12 months; paid in three tranches after commercial operation. Disbursed pro-rata by share of Goan-origin employees or Goan graduates on rolls for at least one year: up to 30% of employees = 50% of incentive, 30-60% = 75%, above 60% = 100%.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit Common Application Form (Part 1) with documents by e-mail or on the web portal to obtain a unit registration number from DoIT; then Common Application Form (Part 2) plus incentive-specific forms to the Due Diligence Committee; claims quarterly/bi-annually/annually after incurring expenditure. Timeline: scrutiny D+30 days, Empowered Committee approval D+60 days, sanction/regret and disbursement D+90 days.
schemes.valid_period: Five years from Gazette notification of the scheme (scheme framed under Goa IT Policy 2018, notified 18/07/2018, No. 2(15)/DOIT/2017-18/Goa IT Policy-2018/624).
schemes.notes: Scheme for IT industry units under the Goa Information Technology Policy and Roadmap 2018, listed on the Startup Goa portal under Notifications ('Information Technology Policy Schemes 2018'); SITPC processes applications under the IT Policy as well as the Startup Policy. Smaller Business Unit = fewer than 50 IT professionals in Goa; Mega Business Unit = more than 200. Read from Wayback snapshot of ITPolicySchemes2018.pdf dated 2025-06-19.
